details.body: Be, v. i. BU 1 P, as 2 P, vft 1 A, vid 4 A; ‘b(e) it so’ Bavatu, evaM-taTA-astu. Being, s. BAvaH, avasTA, vftti f., astitvaM, sattA. 2 BUtaM, satvaHsattvaH-tvaM; ‘rational b(eing)’ sacetanaH, prARin m.; ‘corporal b(eing)’ SarIrin m., dehin m.; ‘Supreme B(eing)’ parameSvaraH, paramAtman m. 2 janman n., saMBavaH, utpatti f. a. sat, vartamAnaH ‘b(eing) that’ yataH, yasmAt; ex. by abl. or instr. of nouns.

BE: I As a logical copula:(1) Bavati (BU, c. 1), it is long-necked dIrDagrIvaH sa Bavati, U. iv.; the hearts of good men are always com- passionate karuRArdrARi satAM Kalu Bavanti sadA cetAMsi, K. N. B. It is often understood: the end of aims is beyond comprehension duraGigamA hi gatiH prayojanAnAm, Ki. x. 40.II Denoting existence, presence: asti, there was formerly a king named Śudraka AsIdrAjA SUdrako nAma, K.; and there are heaps of gems santi ratnanicayASca BUriSaH, Ki. xiii. 55. N. B. Note (a) that this verb is exclusively used for there is-, there was-, etc.; (b) that in this sense, it is gen. placed at the beginning of the sentence; and (c) that this verb is defective and its non-conjugational tenses are supplied by those of BU and hence we meet with phrases like aBUnnfpaH (-there was a king), B. i. 1.; (2) vartate, saM-, (vft, c. 1), in a moment you will be in your realm kzaRAt svAGikAraBUmO vartizyate, Sa. vii.: v. To be present. Ph.: here are we ime smaH, Sa. iv.; be it so evamastu, mavatu.III To become: q. v.: Bavati.

To BE , v. n. (To be in some state) as (c. 2. asti), As (c. 2. Aste). — (To enter into some state) BU (c. 1. Bavati, BavituM). — (To exist) as, vft (c. 1. varttate, varttituM), vid in pass. (vidyate), jan in pass. (jAyate). — (To be in or at) vft, sTA (c. 1. tizWati, sTAtuM); ‘be it so,’ evam astu. The verb ‘to be’ is often expressed by the use of the passive form of the Sanskrit verb, and is not unfrequently omitted altogether.
To BE ABLE , v. n. pf (c. 10. pArayati -yituM). Sak must take the 5th conj., unless used to give a pass. sense to the infin.

To BE ENAMOURED , v. n. anurAgavAn -vatI -vat or anuraktaH -ktA -ktaM or AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM BU or as with inst. c. or loc. c., anuraYj in pass. (-rajyate) AsaYj in pass. (-sajyate). with loc. c., sah [Page226-a+ 51] (c. 4. muhyati, mohituM); ‘he is enamoured with her,’ tayA anurAgavAn asti.

Beach, s. (samudra-)tIraM, kUlaM, velA, tawaM-wI. [Beach]y, a. tawayukta, kUlamaya (yI f.).
BEACH: (1) roGas (n.);(2) kUlam: v. Shore.
BEACH , s. samudratIraM, samudrakUlaM, samudratawaM, velA.
BEACHED , a. samudratIrasTaH -sTA -sTaM, uttaraNgaH -NgA -NgaM.
BEACHY , a. tIraviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, tawayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, kUlamayaH -yI -yaM.
Beacon, s. AkASadIpaH, maholkA.

BEACON , s. AkASadIpaH, unnataBUBAge sTApitA Satror Agamanasamaye jAjva- lyamAnA maholkA, samudragAminAM paTadarSanArTam uccIkftaM cihnaM.
Bead, s. gulI, guwikA; ‘a string of b(ead)s’ mAlA; hAraH; ‘a rosary of b(ead)s’; japa-akza-mAlA; ‘telling b(ead)s’ japamAlAM gaR 10. [Bead]man, s. japakaraRe niyukto janaH.
BEAD (subs.): (1) gulI;(2) gulikA;(3) guwI; (4) guwikA. A string of b. s mAlA; a rosary of b. s:(1) akzamAlA;(2) japamAlA.
BEAD , s. (Little globular body) gulikA, guwikA, gulI, varttulaH. [Page041-b+ 51] — (A string of beads) mAlA, hAraH. — (A rosary of beads) japamAlA.
BEAD , s. akzaH, maRiH -RI m. f.; ‘necklace of beads,’ maRimAlA.
Beadle, s. daMqaDaraH.

BEAM (subs.): Of a house: tulA, Si. iii. 50. II Of a balance:(1) tulAdaRqaH;(2) tulADAraH. III Of a loom:(1) veman (n.);(2) vApadaRqaH; (3) vAyadaRqaH.IV Of a carriage: Dur (f.): v. Pole.V A ray of light: (aMSuH;(2) kiraRaH: v. Ray.

(Piece of timber) sTURA, dIrGakAzWaM, kAzWaM, vfhatkAzWaM, nAsA, yazwiH m. — (Main support of a house) veSmasTURA. — (Ray of light) raSmiH m., marIciH m. f., kiraRaH, aMSuH m. — (Part of a balance) tulADAraH, tulAdaRqaM. — (Pole of a carriage) DUH f. (Dur), kUvaraH. — (Part of a weaver's loom) vAyadaRqaH, vApadaRqaH.
To BEAM , v. n. (To emit rays of light) sPur (c. 6. sPurati, sPurituM), aMSu (nom. aMSUyati -yituM), kiraRa (nom. kiraRAyate -yituM), dIp (c. 4. dIpyate, dIpituM), varccas (nom. varccAyate -yituM).
BEAMLESS , a. raSmihInaH -nA -naM, nistejAH -jAH -jaH (s), nizpraBaH -BA -BaM.
BEAMY , a. (Radiant) aMSumAn -matI -mat (t), aMSulaH -lA -laM, kiraRamayaH -yI -yaM, marIcimAlI -linI -li (n), praBAvAn -vatI -vat (t), dedI- pyamAnaH -nA -naM.
Bean, s. mAzaH, SiMbikaH.
BEAN: (1) SimbA;(2) SimbiH.
BEAN , s. SimbikaH, SimbA, mudgaH, mAzaH.

Bear, v. t. vah 1 P, nI 1 P. 2 Df 1 P, AlaMb 1 A, Bf 3 U (rAjyaBAramuvAha-baBAra). 3 sah 1 A, mfz 4 P, 10, kzam 1 A. 4 prasU 2 A; utpad c., jan c. (janayati); ‘Satyavati bore two sons to the king’ nfpeRa satyavatyAM putrO jAtO-utpAditO, nfpaH satyavatyAM putrAvajIjanat; the same sense ex. in sa nEzaDasya sutAyAM putramutpAdayAmAsa (R. xviii. 1) ‘he had a son by the daughter’ &c. 5 (Cherish) Bf 3 U, Df 1 P; ‘I b(ear) no malice to you’ tavopari dvezaM na DArayAmi, or na tvaM mama dvezapAtraM-sTAnaM; ‘he bore himself bravely on the occasion’ tasminnavasare tena sADu AcaritaM, DIraM vikAMtaM; ‘b(ear) witness’ sAkzyaM dA 3 P (with gen.); ‘b(ear) company’ sahacaraH (rI f.) BU 1 P; ‘b(ear) name’ nAma Bf 3 U, or Df 10; vyapadeSaM Baj 1 A; (evaMvyapadeSaBAjinaH U. 6); ‘b(ear) fruit’ saPalIBU, Pal 1 P; ‘b(ear) in mind’ citte avaDf 10, manasi kf, anusmf 1 P. s. fkzaH, BallUkaH, BAlukaH. Born, a. jAta, utpanna, prasUta, saMBUta; ‘to be b(orn)’ jan 4 A; utpad 4 A; prasU pass., udBU 1 P, saMBU; ‘was b(orn) in the form of a dwarf’ vAmanarUpeRa jAtaH-avatIrRaH. [Bear] back, v. i. parA-prati-ni-vft 1 A. [Bear] down, v. t. apAkf 8 U; parAji 1 A, nipat c.; ‘bore down all opposition’ sarvamaMtarAyamapAkurvan. [Bear] on, v. i. See Apply. [Bear] out, v. t. (fig.) dfQayati (D.); samarT 10. [Bear] up, v. udvah c., uttaMB c., as in Jawiti GawanottaMBitamiva (U. 3). 2 sah 1 A; ‘b(ear up) under grief’ duHKapratikAraM kuru, SokavaSaM mA gamaH. [Bear]er, s. vAhaH, haraH, vAhakaH, in comp. vArtAharaH ‘b(earer) of news’ [Bear]ing, s. avasTAnaM, sTiti f. 2 vftti f., vartanaM, AcaraRaM, rIti f.

BEAR (v. t.): I To carry: q. v.: vahati (vah, c. 1)II To sustain, support:(1) vahati, bore the bent down head with difficulty uvAha duHKena BfSAnataM SiraH, Si. i. 57.(2) biBarti (Bf, c. 3), easily bore the great burden of state mahAntaM taM rAjya- BAramanAyAsenEva baBAra, K.III. To suffer, endure: q. v.:(1) vahati, ut- (rare in this sense), surely distress...is very difficult to be borne duHKAni nUnamatimAtradurudvahAMni, Sa. iv.;(2) sahate, pra-, vi-, (sah, c. 1), could not b. the respect (paid to Kṛṣṇa) mAnamasahata na, Si. xv. 1.; the faculty of b. ing cold, heat and wind SItozRavAtaprasahi- zRutA, Ka. xv. 37.IV To bring forth, produce: q. v.:(1) vahati (very rare);(2) sUte (sU, c. 2), immediatlyimmediately the Aśoka tree bore flowers asUta sadyaH kusumAnyaSokaH, Ku. iii. 26.; (3) biBarti (rare), Ki. viii. 4. V. To cherish, q. v. Ph.; I. b. no hatred towards you tvayi mama dvezo nAsti or na vidyate etc.VI To behave: q. v.VII To admit: q. v. Ph.: to be. wit- ness sAkzyaM dadAti (dA, c. 3); to b company sahacaraH (rI, raM) Bavati (BU, c. 1) (with gen.); to b. a hand hastaM dadAti (?); to b. a name nAma biBarti M. ii. 157.; your good policy has borne fruit PalitA tava sunItiH. D. ii.

BEAR (subs.): I An animal:(1) BallaH;(2) Ballu (llU) kaH;(3) fkzaH;(4) acCaBallaH;(5) BAllUkaH.II A constellation: Ph.: the little b. SiSumAraH (?) V. p. The seven stars of the Great Bear:(1) saptarzimaRqalam; citraSiKaRqinaH.
BEAR , s. fkzaH, BallakaH, BallukaH, BallaH, BAllukaH, acCaH, acCaBallaH. — (The Great Bear, constellation) citraSiKaRqinaH m. pl.

To BEAR , v. a. (Carry) vah (c. 1. vahati -te, voQuM), sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM); ‘he bore his mother on his back,’ mAtaraM pfzWena avahat; ‘he is borne on a horse,’ aSvena uhyate or aSvena saYcarati. — (Support) Bf (c. 1. Barati -te, c. 3. biBartti, BarttuM), Gf (c. 1. Darati -te, DarttuM) or in caus. DArayati -yituM), Alamb (c. 1. -lambate -lambituM). — (Suffer, endure) sah, vizah, kzam (c. 1. kzamate, kzantuM), saNkzam; tij in des. (titikzate -kzituM), mfz (c. 4. mfzyati -te, marzituM, c. 10. marzayati -yituM); ‘that is not to be borne,’ na sahyaM tat. — (Per- mit) anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM). — (Admit) grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM). — (Produce) utpad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM), jan in caus. (janayati -yituM). — (Bring forth) su (c. 1. savati, c. 2. sOti, sotuM), prasu; prajan (c. 4. -jAyate -janituM) or jan in caus. — (Bear in mind) anusmf (c. 1. -smarati -smarttuM), anucint (c. 10. -cintayati -yituM). — (Bear witness) sAkzyaM dA (c. 3. dadAti, dAtuM). — (Keep afloat) plu in caus. (plAvayati -yituM). — (Bear fruit) Pal (Palati, PalituM). — (Possess) Bf, DA, Df in caus. — (Bear up) udvah. — (Bear away) apavah. — (Bear down) nipat in caus. (-pAtayati -yituM). — (Be capable of) utsah with inf. — (Bear on, incite) protsah in caus. (-sAhayati -yituM). — (Bear the blame) dozaM svIkf; ‘I will bear the blame,’ dozo mayi varttizyate. — (Bear one's self, behave) vft (c. 1. varttate, varttituM), kAYcid vfttim anuzWA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM). — (Bear ma- lice) druh (c. 4. druhyati, drohituM). When this verb occurs in phrases such as, ‘to bear company,’ ‘to hear aid,’ ‘to bear resemblance, see ‘to ACCOMPANY,’ ‘to AID,’ ‘to RESEMBLE.’

To BEAR , v. n. (To be patient) sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), soQ (nom. soQayate -yituM). — (To wait patiently) vilamb (c. 1. -lambate -lambituM). — (To be fruitful) Pal (c. 1. Palati, PalituM), PalaM dA (c. 8. dadAti, [Page042-a+ 51] dAtuM), saPalaH -lA -laM BU. — (To be situated towards) pratizWA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), diSyaH -SyA -SyaM as; as, ‘bearing towards the east,’ pUrvvadiSyaH. — (To bear up) manaHsTEryyaM kf.
BEAR , s. (Great) saptarzayaH m. pl. See URSA MAJOR, SAINT.
BEAR AGAINST: aBi-vartate (vft, c. 1), Ki. xii. 3.
BEAR BACK: parA-vartate (vft, c. 1): v. To retreat.
BEAR DOWN (v. i.): sannipatati (pat, c. 1): v. To hasten, approach.
BEAR ON, or UPON: I To press, affect: q. v.: (1) pIqayati (pIq, c. 10);(2) bADate (bAD, c. 1)II To have reference to: q. v.: lagati (lag, c. 1).
BEAR OUT: I To carry out: q. v.II Fig. to support: q. v.: draQayati (nomi).
BEAR UP: I Trans: v. To support.II Intrans.:(1) udvahati, (with acc.); could not b. under the weight DuramudvoQuM na SaSAka;(2) sahate (with acc.): v. To resist.
BEAR WITH: sahate (sah, c. 1): v. To endure.

Beard, s. SmaSru n., kUrcaM; muKaroman n.; ‘wearing long b(eard)s’ dIrGakUrcAH (pl.). 2 SUkaM, kiMSAruH. 3 PalaM, karRaH. v. t. nyakkf 8 U, samakzaM avajYA 9 U or nirBarts 10 A or a-Dikzip 6 P. [Beard]ed, a. saSmaSru; SmaSrula, kUrcaDara &c. [Beard]less, a. SmaSruhIna; ajAta-anudBinna-SmaSru. 2 aprAptavyavahAra.
BEARD (subs.): I Of men etc.:(1) SmaSru (n.); (2) kUrcam;(3) muKaroman (n.)II Of corn:(1) SUkam;(2) SuNgaH;(3) kiMSAruH.
BEARD (v. t.) I To seize by the beard: SmaSruRA or SmaSruRi gfhRAti (graha c. 9).II To defy openly; nyakkaroti (?): v. To insult.
BEARD , s. SmaSru n., mAsurI, muKajaM roma n. (n), muKaroma n. — (Of corn) SasyaSUkaM, SUkaM, kiMSAruH m. — (Barb of an arrow) PalaM, karRaH.

To BEARD , v. a. (To take by the beard) avajYAnAt paraSmaSru saNgrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM). — (To insult to the face) muKarIkf, pratimuKaM or pratyakze avajYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), avakzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM).
BEARD , s. dAQikA, kUrccaH. BEARDLESS, a. tUvaraH.

BEARDED (adj.) I Lit.:(1) SmaSrulaH (lA, laM); (2) kUrcaGaraH (rA, raM), even by long-b. goats pralamba- kUrcaDarESCAgErapi, K. Ph. a b. woman powA (rare) II As corn:(1) by comp. b. corn SukaGAnyam; (2) SuNgin (f. nI);(3) Sukavat (f. tI).III Bearded: q. v.

BEARDED , a. (Having a beard) saSmaSruH -SruH -Sru, SmaSrumAn -matI -mat (t), SmaSrulaH -lA -laM. — (As corn) SUkavAn -vatI -vat (t); ‘bearded corn,’ SUkaDAnyaM. — (As an arrow) karRI -rRinI -rRi (n). -(A bearded dart) prAsaH, kuntaH. — (Insulted) avajYAtaH -tA -taM.
BEARDLESS: (1) SmaSruhInaH (nA, naM);(2) anudBinna- SmaSru (mfn.);(3) ajAtaSmaSru (mfn.). N. B.(2) and(3) mean one whose beard has not come out.
BEARDLESS , a. SmaSruhInaH -nA -naM. — (A stripling) aprAptavyavahAraH, vawuH, mARavakaH.
BEARER: i. e. porter, carrier: q. v.: (1) vAhakaH; (2) vAhaH; (at the end of a comp.). Letter b. patravAhaH; corpse b.;(1) SavavAhaH;(2) pretaniharikaH.
BEARER , s. vAhakaH, vAhI m. (n). — (Of burdens) BAravAhaH -hanaH, BArahAraH, DuranDaraH; ‘one who carries out the dead,’ pretanirhArakaH; ‘letter-bearer,’ patravAhaH; ‘bearer of news,’ sandeSaharaH.

BEARING (subs.): I Gesture, mien: q. v.: cezwA; his b. is not as before asya cezwA nAmAyaTApUrvam D. viii.II Relation, reference: q. v. Ph. what b. has your argument on this subject *asya- vizayasya tavopapatteSca kaH sambanGaH.III Relative [Page061] situation: Ph. the b. of the cape is n. w. *asmAt paScimottarasTamantarIpam; ascertain the b. s of the lighthouse katamasmindigBAge dIpagfhamiti jYAyatAm.
BEARING , s. (The relative situation of a place) diSyaM, dik f. (S), avasTAnaM, avasTitiH f., sTAnaM. — (Behaviour) vfttiH f., darSanaM, rItiH f., gatiH f., BAvaH, varttanaM.
BEARISH , a. fkzaSIlaH -lA -laM, BallakasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM, aSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Beast, s. paSuH, mfgaH, jaMtuH; ‘b(east) of prey’ SvApadaH; ‘b(east) of burden’ DuryaH, DurIRaH; ‘b(east) in the form of man’ narapaSuH. [Beast]ful, [Beast]ly, a. paSutulya; jaGanya, paSuSIla.
BEAST: I An irrational animal:(1) paSuH; (2) tiryac (n.) (rare), a b. of prey: SvApadaH; a b. burden DuryaH: v. Animal.II A brutal man: paSuH, Ve.: v. Brute.

BEAST , s. paSuH m., jantuH m., tiryyaN (Yc). — (Four-footed beast) catuzpAt m. f. n. (d). — (Beast of prey) SvApadaH. — (Of burden) DurIRaH, DurIyaH, DuryyaH, BAravAhanaH. — (Applied to a man) puruzapaSuH m., durAcAraH.
BEAST , s. (Of burden) pfzWavAhyaH, pfzWavAw m. (h).
BEASTLINESS: jaGanyatA: v. Filthiness.
BEASTLINESS , s. paSutA -tvaM, pASavaM, paSuSIlatA, amanuzyatA.
BEASTLY: jaGanyaH (nyA, nyaM): V. Filthy.
BEASTLY , a. pASavaH -vI -vaM, paSuSIlaH -lA -laM, paSuvyavahAraH -rA -raM, amAnuzaH -zI -zaM.
BEASTLY , adv. paSuvat, paSuvyavahArAnusAreRa, mAnuzAcAravirudDaM.

Beat, s. AGAtaH, prahAraH; tAqanaM. 2 spaMdanaM, sPuraRaM. v. t. taq 10, prahf 1 P, tud 6 P, aBihan 2 P, Ahan 2 A, (AhatAyAM payARaBeryAM). 2 (defeat) viDvaMs c., BaMj 7 P, parAji 1 A, parABU 1 U. 3 Aluq c., cUrR 10. v. i. spaMd-kaMp-vep 1 A, sPur 6 P; ‘b(eat) very fast’ DamaDamAyate (D.). [Beat] down, nipat c.; (price) nyUnIkf. [Beat] into, tAqanena kf or nirmA 3 A; ‘I shall b(eat) thee into a good boy’ tAqayitvA tAqayitvA tvAmahaM vidvAMsaM karizyAmi. [Beat] off, vidru c., pratihan. [Beat] about the bush, (lit.) vanaM grah 9 P or Aluq 10; (fig.) aprastutamAlap 1 P; See Bush.

BEAT (v. t.): I To strike: q. v.:(1) tAqayati (taq, c. 10), b. ing her breast sorastAqam, Vi. vi.; to b. in return pratIpaM tAqayati, Mr. xi.; (2) hanti A-, aBi-, ni-, (han, c. 2), of un-b. en drums anAhatasya dunduBeH, Ki. xviii. 17.II To defeat: q. v.:(1) Banakti (maYj, c. 7), b. the king's troops in the battle rAjAnIkaM baBaYjAjO, Raj.;(2) KaRqayati, pari, (KaRq, c. 10), B. xii. 17.; being b. en by the enemy KaRqanAM prApya parAt, Ki. xvii. 60.
BEAT (v. i.): I To strike, knock; q. v.; tAqayati (taq, c. 10) (with acc.)II To palpitate: q. v.:(1) kampate (kamp, c. l); vepate (vep, c. 1).
BEAT , s. AGAtaH, GAtaH, prahAraH, pAtaH. — (Of the pulse or heart) spandanaM, sPuraRaM, vizpandaH; ‘at the beat of the drum,’ Ahatezu pawahezu.

To BEAT , v. a. taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), vitaq; han (c. 2. hanti, hantuM), nihan, aBihan; prahf (c. 1. -harati -te -harttuM), tud (c. 6. tudati, tottuM), Atud, vitud. — (With a stick) vetrAGAtaM kf. — (To conquer, ex- cel) parAji (c. 1. -jayati -te -jetuM), viji; aBiBU (c. 1. -Bavati -BavituM), atI (c. 2. atyeti, atyetuM). — (To mix by beating) Aluq (c. 1. -loqati -loqituM), manT (c. 1. maTati, maTituM). — (To bruise) cUrR (c. 10. cUrRayati -yituM), mfd (c. 9. mfdnAti, marddituM). — (To beat off, beat back) pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -hantuM). — (To beat down) nipat in caus. (-pAtayati -yituM). — (To beat down the price) mUlyaM nyUnIkf or hras in caus. (hrAsayati -yituM). — (To flap the wings) pakzAsPAlaM kf, pakzO cal in caus. (cAlayati -yituM). — (To rouse game by striking the bushes) mfgayAsamaye yaTA mfgAH svasTAnAni tyajanti taTA kolAhalena gulmAditAqanaM kf, mfgAnvezaRe yaTA mfmo nijASrayAt palAyate taTA gulmAdIn taq.
To BEAT , v. n. (To palpitate) spand (c. 1. spandate, spandituM), parispand; kamp (c. 1. kampate, karmpituM), sPur (c. 6. sPurati, sPurituM).
BEAT BACK or OFF: vi-drAvayati (c. of dru): v. To drive back.
BEAT DOWN: I To break, crush, or press down: q. v.II Of price: laGayati (nomi.): v. To lessen.
BEAT UPON: Ph. the foam of big waves b. ing upon the rocks upalAhatodDatataraNgaDftaM PenamapAm, Ki. vi. 10.
BEAT-OUT: Of metals: Perh. Ahanti (han, c. 2): v. To forge.
BEAT-UP: I To attack suddenly: alakzitam AkrAmati: v. To attack.II As eggs: Perh mfdnAti (mfd, c. 9) or Garzati (Dfz, c. 1).
BEATEN (adj.): (1) kzuRRaH (RRA, RRaM) from the b. track kzuRRAdvartmanaH, R. i. 17.;(2) prahataH (tA, taM) M. n.

BEATEN , part. a. AhataH -tA -taM, tAqitaH -tA -taM. — (Conquered) parA- jitaH -tA -taM: ‘beaten by the waves,’ uttaraNgaH -NgA -NgaM. — (One that deserves to be beaten) kaSyaH -SyA -SyaM, kaSArhaH -rhA -rhaM.

sanskrit.iast: mudgarādinā yaḥ suvarṇam atiśayena sūkṣmīkaroti svarṇakāraviśeṣa

details.body: BEATER , s. tAqayitA m. (tf), tAqakaH, GAtI m. (n). — (A gold-beater) [Page042-b+ 51] mudgarAdinA yaH suvarRam atiSayena sUkzmIkaroti svarRakAraviSeza; svarRapa- trakft. — (An instrument for comminuting) mudgaraH.
BEATIFIC: niHSreyasakaraH (rI, raM), Ki. xi. 19: Blessed, blissful.
BEATIFIC or BEATIFICAL, a. apavargadaH -dA -daM, paramasuKAvahaH -hA -haM, paramAnandakaraH -rI -raM.
BEATIFICATION: *divyajanatvAropaRam; sidDilABa- praKyApanam: v. Next art.
BEATIFICATION , s. amukasADujanaH svargaM or apavargaM or sidDiM prAptavAn iti GozaRApatreRa mahADarmmADyakzasakASAd vijYApanaM, svargIyalokamaDye AropaRaM.
BEATIFIED , p. p. gfhItApavargaH -rgA -rgaM, svargaprAptaH -ptA -ptaM, svargAropitaH -tA -taM.

sanskrit.slp1: sidDiM prAptavAn iti mahADarmmADyakzAjYayA GozaRApatraM pracar
sanskrit.word: सिद्धिं प्राप्तवान् इति महाधर्म्माध्यक्षाज्ञया घोषणापत्रं प्रचर्
sanskrit.iast: siddhiṃ prāptavān iti mahādharmmādhyakṣājñayā ghoṣaṇāpatraṃ pracar

details.body: Beatify, v. t. paramAnaMdaM dA 3 U. 2 amarezu gaRU 10, svargIyalokamaDye Aruh c. [Beatif]ic, a. apavargada, mokzaprada.
BEATIFY: I To bless, make happy: q. v.: suKayati.II t. t. in the Romish church *divaM- gataH (tA, taM) iti praKyApayati; divyajanatvam Aropa- yati.

To BEATIFY , v. a. (To make happy) suK (c. 10. suKayati -yituM), paramasuKaM or paramAnandaM dA (c. 3. dadAti -dAtuM). — (To proclaim pub- licly that a person is received into heaven) amukasADujanaH svargaM or sidDiM prAptavAn iti mahADarmmADyakzAjYayA GozaRApatraM pracar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM); svargIyalokamaDye Aruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM).
BEATING (subs.): I The act of striking:(1) tAqanA;(2) tAqanaB.II Of the heart: kampaH. Ph. b. time (in music): tAlaH.
BEATING , s. tAqanaM, AGAtaH, GAtaH, daRqaH. — (With a stick) vetrAGAtaH. — (Throbbing) spandanaM, sPuraRaM.
Beatitude, s. mokzaH, mukti f., niHSreyasaM, apavargaH, nirvARaM, paramA gatiH, kEvalyaM, ‘desirous of b(eautitude)’ mumukzuH.
BEATITUDE: (1) mokzaH;(2) muktiH;(3) apavargaH; (4) niHSreyasam;(5) sidDiH;(6) nirvARam.

BEATITUDE , s. muktiH f., mokzaH, nirvARaM, sidDiH f., apavargaH, svargaprAptiH f., paramAgatiH f., SreyaH n. (s) or niHSreyaH, amftatA, kEvalyaM. — (Feli- city) paramasuKaM, paramAnandaH, SreyastvaM, suKaM. — (Desirous of) mumukzuH.

BEATITUDE , s. The Hindūs divide final beatitude into four kinds, viz. 1. ‘absorption into the essence of the deity,’ brahmasAyujyaM; 2. ‘residence with him,’ salokatA; 3. ‘nearness to him,’ samIpatA; 4. ‘conformedness to his image,’ sarUpatA.
Beau, s. suveSaH, suBagaMmanyaH.
BEAU: (1) suveSin (m.);(2) suBagammanyaH;(3) suBagamAnin (m.): v. Fop.
BEAU , s. suveSI m. (n), suveSaH, suvastraparicCannaH, darSanIyamAnI m. (n).
BEAU-MONDE , s. nftyagItasvAdvannaBojanamadyapAnasuvastrapariDAnAdiBogatatparo lokaH, BogAsakto lokaH.
BEAUTEOUS: (1) sundaraH (rI, raM);(2) raByaH (myA, myaM); v. Beautiful.

BEAUTEOUS or BEAUTIFUL, a. cAruH -rvvI -ru, sundaraH -rA -rI -raM, ruciraH -rA -raM, sudfSyaH -SyA -SyaM, SoBanaH -nA -naM, kAntaH -ntA -ntaM, vAmaH -mA -maM, rUpavAn -vatI -vat (t), rUpI -piRI -pi (n), surUpaH -pI -paM, manoramaH -mA -maM, manojYaH -jYA -jYaM, lAvaRyavAn -vatI -vat (t), sADuH -DuH -DvI -Du, sOmyaH -myA -myaM, SrIyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, sumuKaH -KI -KaM, aBirAmaH -mA -maM, suzamaH -mA -maM, peSalaH -lA -laM, rucyaH -cyA -cyaM, maYjuH -YjuH -Yju, maYjulaH -lA -laM, vfndAraH -rA -raM. Often expressed by su; as, ‘a beau- tiful day,’ sudinaM. ‘A beautiful woman,’ rUpavatI, pramadA; ‘to be beautiful,’ SuB (c. 1. SoBate, SoBituM).
BEAUTEOUSLY or BEAUTIFULLY, adv. sADu, sundaraM, ruciraM, suzwu, sunda- raprakAreRa, su prefixed; as, ‘beautifully dressed,’ suveSI -SinI -Si (n).
BEAUTEOUSNESS , s. kAntatA, aBirAmatA, vAmatA, rUpavattvaM, ramaRIyatA, mugDatA.
BEAUTIFIED , p. p. SoBitaH -tA -taM, upaSoBitaH -tA -taM, kftaSoBaH -BA -BaM.
BEAUTIFIER: i. e. a lady's maid: (1) prasADikA; (2) YlaNkartrI.
BEAUTIFIER , s. SoBakft, SoBakaH, SoBayitA m. (tf), BUpaRaH.

BEAUTIFUL: (1) sundaraH (rI, raM);(2) ramaRIyaH (yA, yaM);(3) kamanIyaH (yA, yaM);(4) SoBanaH (nA, naM); (5) cAru (f. rvI);(6) kAntaH (ntA, ntaM);(7) peSalaH (lA, laM);(8) maYjulaH (lA, laM);(9) aBirAmaH (mA, maM); (10) manojYaH (jYA, jYaM);(11) by su in comp.; a girl with a b. face sumuKI; Ph.: oh, what a b. morning aho ramaRIyatA praBAtasya, Dh.; oh, what a b. place aho rAmaRIyakamasya, Na. I.
BEAUTIFULLY: (1) sundaram;(2) cAru;(3) SoBanam; (4) by the adj.
BEAUTIFY: (1) BUzayati (BUz, c. 10);(2) prasADa- yati (c. of sAG): v. To adorn.
To BEAUTIFY , v. a. SuB in caus. (SoBayati -yituM), upaSuB, alaNka, parizkf, BUz (c. 10. BUzayati -yituM), viBUz.

Beauty, s. sOMdaryaM, cArutA, lAvaRyaM, SoBA, kAMti f., rUpaM, ramaRIyatA, aBiKyA, manojYatvaM, SrIH, lakzmIH. Beautify, v. t. SuB c., BUz 10, alaMkf 8 U. Beautiful, Beauteous, a. suMdara (rI f.), ramya, ramaRIya, kAMta, manojYa, surUpa, lAvaRyavat, rucira, SoBana, cAru (rvI f.), maMjula oft., by su in comp.; sumuKaM-susTalaM. [Beautiful]ly, adv. sADu, suMdaraM, suzWu, su in comps.

BEAUTY: (1) sOndaryam;(2) cArutA (=loveliness); (3) ramaRIyatA (=pleasantness);(4) SoBA (splendour);(5) rUpam (=b. of person); (6) lAvaRyam (=prettiness);(7) aBiKyA (rare). Ph.: a. b. (=beautiful girl) sundarI; the b. s of poem. kAvyasya maDUni (?); enchanted with the b. s of nature prAkftikaSoBayAhftacittaH (ttA, ttaM); attained the b. of a bed SayanIyalakzmIM baBAra, Ki. viii. 57.; vying with the b. of the ocean payoDi- lakzmImuzi, N. i. 117.: N. B. In the same sense SrI, which is more common in comps.
BEAUTY , s. sOndaryyaM, cArutA, SoBA, kAntiH f., rUpaM, lAvaRyaM, rUpalAvaRyaM, SrIH, ABA, aBiKyA, dyutiH f., CaviH f., maYjimA m. (n), suzamA.
BEAUTY-SPOT , s. tilakaH -kaM, sOndaryyavardDakaM cihnaM, kAntidAyakam aNkaM.
Beaver, s. SirastrARaBAgaH.
BEAVER: I Aṇ animal: *vivaraH, vivareSayaScatu- zpAdajantuBedaH.II A b. hat: *vivaralomanirmitamiyu- rUpIyajanaBftaSiraskam.III Of a helmet: *Sira- skasyapa civukapracCAdakaBAgaH.

BEAVER , s. (An animal) sTalajalacarajantupraBedo yallomanirmmitaM Siraskam aDunAtanajanEr Briyate. — (A hat) pUrvvoktajantulomanirmmitaM SiraskaM or SirastrARaM. — (Part of a helmet) SirastrARasya yo BAgaS civukadeSaM or muKasya aDoBAgaM pracCAdayati.
BECAFICO: drAkzAdiPalaBakzako kzudrapakzimedaH.
BECAFICO , s. aYjIradrAkzAdiKAdako videSIyapakziBedaH, aYjIrapratudaH.
Becalm, v. t. nirvAta a. kf 8 U, praSam c. (Samayati); See Calm.
BECALM (v. t.): Samayati, pra-, upa-, (c. of Sam): v. To appease.
To BECALM , v. a. (To still the elements) nirvvAtaM -tAM -taM kf, vAyuM nivft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM), nistaraNgaM -NgAM -NgaM kf. — (To quiet) Sam in caus. (Samayati -yituM), upaSam, praSam.
BECALMED , p. p. nirvvAtaH -tA -taM, nirvegaH -gA -gaM, nistaraNgaH -NgA -NgaM.
BECAME , the preterite of ‘become;’ which see. Sometimes expressed by jAtaH -tA -taM.

sanskrit.iast: vinā prāptakāle sānnidhyaṃ karttavyam iti āgato'smi

sanskrit.word: रनिमित्तं दुःखं दृष्टमिति तस्यैव प्रव्रजितस्य तदेव दुःखं भवति
sanskrit.iast: ranimittaṃ duḥkhaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tasyaiva pravrajitasya tadeva duḥkhaṃ bhavati

details.body: Because, conj. iti, hi (not at the beginning of a statement); yataH, yat; more oft. ex. by kutaH, kasmAt with abl.; by abl. or instr.; ‘b(ecause) he is liable to the charge of inequality and cruelty’ (neSvaro jagataH kAraRamupapadyate) kutaH vEzamyanErGfRyaprasaMgAt ‘b(ecause) of’ ex. by instr. or abl.; hetoH, kAraRAt; ‘b(ecause) of this’ iti hetoH.

BECAUSE (conj.): (1) iti; poems are not good b. old, nor faultly b. new purARamityeva na sADu sarvaM na cApi kAvyaM navamityavadyam, Mal. I. N. B. Note the position of iti;(2) hi (never at the begin- -ning of a sentence), b. you see that a rich man feels pain at the loss of his wealth (you cannot conclude that) he will have the same pain when he assumes mendicancy na hi Danino DanApahA- ranimittaM duHKaM dfzwamiti tasyEva pravrajitasya tadeva duHKaM Bavati, S. i. 4.: v. For. N. B. Observe that na hi is the best way of expressing because...not. (3) kutaH or kasmAt (=why) with abl.: here the word Ayatana means something else, b. we hear that it is the bridge of ambrosia tatrArTAntaraM kima- pyAyatanaM syAditi prAptam, kasmAt? amftasyEza seturiti SravaRAt, S. iii. 1.

BECAUSE , conj. yatas, yat, yena, yasmAt, iti hetoH, yatohatoH, hi. ‘Because’ may be often expressed by the abl. or inst. c. of the abstract noun; as, ‘because it had no deepness of earth,’ mfdalpatvAt; ‘because he was a just man,’ sajjana- tvAt; ‘because he was a friend,’ mitratayA. It may even be expressed by iti; thus, ‘I am come, because a ser- vant ought to be present at the fitting occasion,’ anujI- vinA prAptakAle sAnniDyaM karttavyam iti Agato'smi.

BECAUSE OF , prep. (By reason of) hetoH, hetO, kAraRAt. — (For the sake of) arTaM, arTe, kfte, nimitte affixed to a crude noun; ‘because of that,’ anena hetunA, iti hetoH. ‘Because of’ is often expressed by the abl. c. of the noun; as, ‘be- cause of their unbelief,’ tezAm aviSvAsAt.
Beck, s. saMjYA; saMketaH. [Beck]on, v. t. SirasA-hastena saMjYAM-saMketaM dA 3 U. 2 saMjYayA Ahve 1 P.
BECK (subs.): (1) saNketaH;(2) saMjYA;(3) iNgitam.
BECK , s. saNketaH, iNgitaM. — (With the hand) karasaNketaH.
BECKON (v. i.): saMjYAM, saNketaM or iNgitaM dadAti (dA, c. 3).
BECKON (v. t.): iNgitena or saMjYayA Ahvayati, samA-, (hve, c. 1).
To BECKON , v. n. SirasA or hastena saNketaM or iNgitaM dA (c. 3. dadAti, dAtuM) or kf. — (To summon with a sign) iNgitena samAhve (c. 1. -hvayati -hvAtuM).

Become, v. i. BU 1 P, saMpad 4 A; vft 1 A, jan 4 A; in majority of adjectives ex. by nouns with gam, prAp &c.; ‘became dejected’ vizAdaM gataH, vizaRRo baBUva; ‘b(ecome)s hated’ dvezyatAM yAti; ‘became amazed’ vismayamApede; ‘b(ecom)ing curious’ samupajAtakutUhalaH; ‘what became of the queen Sita’ sItAdevyAH kiM vfttaM (U. 2), kimaBavat. v. t. yuj pass., upapad 4 A, (with loc.); gen. ex. by anurUpa, sadfSa (SI f.), ucita, upapanna (all with gen.); ‘does this b(ecome) thy matted hair’ kimidaM jawAnAmanurUpaM, yukta-sadfSaM &c. [Becom]ing, a. ucita, anurUpa, yukta, upapanna; ‘it is b(ecoming)’ sAMprataM. [Becom]ingly, adv. yaTocitaM, yaTArhaM, yuktaM, anurUpaM.

BECOME (v. i.): Bavati (BU, c. 1), what in the forest became of the deer-eyed (damsel) kimamavat vipine hariRIdfSaH, U. iii. (2) sampadyate (pad, c. 4). (rare) Me. i. 16. N.B. This verb in conne- -xion with adj. s, is (a) often expr. by verbs of motion with corres. sub. s.: became very sorry paraM vizAdamagamat. P. i. 2.; b. s an object of hatred to the people dvezyatAM yAti loke, P. i. 3.; b. s of no use vrajati vyarTakatAm, Si. xvi. 43. (b) and by verbs meaning to produce: b. ing very sorry samupajAtaSokA, K. (his) face became terrible AnanaM krUramajani, Si. xv. 8. (c) and sometimes by verbs meaning to obtain: became surprised vismayamApede, K. (d) by incep- -tive verbs: to b. congealed GanIBavati.

BECOME (v. t.): (1) yujyate (pass. of yuj) (with) gen.);(2) upa-padyate (pad, c. 4) (with gen.). Better by the adj. s anurUpaH (pA, paM), sadfSaH (SI, SaM); upapannaH (nnA, nnaM); yuktaH (ktA, ktaM), etc. (with gen. or in comp.): we are going to act in a way, b. ing our prowess gacCAmo vayaM vikramAnurUpamAcaritum, Ve. i.; and what b. s such love IdfSasya cAnurAgasya sadfSam, R.; this does not b. men like you anupapannamidaM BavadviDAnAM, Ve. iii.

To BECOME , v. n. BU (c. 1. Bavati, BavituM), samBU; sampad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), pratipad, vft (c. 1. varttate, varttituM), saMvft, jan (c. 4. jAyate), saYjan. The pass. part. of jan (jAta) is often used in the sense ‘became,’ Ahf in caus. (-hArayati -yituM) with acc.
To BECOME , v. a. (Suit) yuj in pass. (yujyate), upapad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM) with loc.
BECOMING (adj.): (1) ucitaH, samucitaH (tA, taM); (2) upayuktaH, yuktaH (ktA, ktaM): v. Suitable.
BECOMING, IT IS: sAmprataM, is not b. (for me) to speak now sampratyasAmprataM vaktum, Si. ii. 70.
BECOMING , a. yuktaH -ktA -ktaM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, yaTAyogyaH -gyA -gyaM, ucitaH -tA -taM, yaTocitaH -tA -taM, samucitaH -tA -taM, samaYjasaH -sA -saM.
BECOMINGLY , adv. yaTAyogyaM, yaTocitaM, yuktaM, yaTArhaM, yaTAtaTaM, yaTAyaTaM, yogatas.

Bed, s. SayyAgataH (tA, taM) or SayyAgrastaH (stA, staM); (2) SayanIyam;(3) talpam;(4) saMstaraH;(5) Sayanam, got out of b. SayanAntAdutTitaH (tA, taM) Si. xi. 7. (more commonly) suptotTitaH (tA, taM) Sa.; (6) OSIram (rare). Ph. defiler of a preceptor's b. gurutalpagaH; defiler of other's beds pAratalpikaH, D.; to go to b. Sete (SI, c. 2): v. To sleep. II Marriage: q. v.: vivAhaH.III Stratum, layer: q. v.: BittiH (?), in gold b. ed sum- mits kAYcanaBittizu sAnuzu, Ki. v. 8.IV Bottom of a stream:(1) talam;(2) aDoBAgaH V. Gar- -den-bed: prastaraH or saMstaraH.

Sete, SayituM); ‘gone to bed,’ SayyAgataH, KawvArUQaH -QA -QaM. — (To make a bed) SayyAM prastutIkf or upastf (c. 5. -stfRoti -starituM -starItuM), Astf. — (To lie down in bed) SayyAm aDiSI. — (Channel of a river) garBaH, nadImaDyaM, nadIvahanapaTaH, nadIrayapaTaH. — (Garden-bed) sTalaM, udyAne puzpotpattiyogya Izadunnato BUBAgaH. — (Marriage) vivAhaH. — (A layer) PalakaH.

BEDEWED , p. p. klinnaH -nnA -nnaM, ArdraH -rdrA -rdraM, prokzitaH -tA -taM, timitaH -tA -taM.

BEE: (1) kzudrA;(2) saraGA;(2) maDumakzikA; as b. s follow their queen yaTA maDukararAjaM maGumakzikA anu- vartante, D. s.

BEFALLEN , p. p. ApatitaH -tA -taM, upasTitaH -tA -taM, samupasTitaH -tA -taM, samApannaH -nnA -nnaM, upapannaH -nnA -nnaM, GawitaH -tA -taM, vfttaH -ttA -ttaM.

Before, prep. (Time) prAk, pUrvaM, arvAk, (with abl.). 2 (Place) puraH, purataH, agre, agrataH, purastAt (with gen.); samakzaM, sAkzAt, pratyakzaM. adv. (place) See above. 2 (Time) pUrva in comp.; ‘not heard b(efore)’ aSrutapUrva. conj. yAvat na-tAvat; ‘study your lesson b(efore) he comes’ yAvadasO nAgacCati tAvatpAWamaDIzva; ekasya duHKasya na yAvadaMtaM gacCAmi tAvadadvitIyaM samupasTitaM me; ‘b(efore) hand’ prAgeva, pUrvameva; praTamameva, agre; ‘b(efore) mentioned’ pUrvokta, prAgukta; ‘as b(efore)’ yaTA purA, yaTApUrvaM; pUrvavat, ‘in times gone b(efore)’ purA, gatakAle.

BEFORE (prep.): I In front of:(1) puras, b. him puro'sya, Si. i. 12.;(2) purataH, b. the army sEnyasya purataH, Vi. vii.;(3) agre, I will quit my life b. you tavAgre prARamokzaRaM karomi, P. ii. p.; (4) agrataH, Ku. iv. 26.;(5) aBitaH, Ki. ii. 59.; N.B. Note that the first four are const. with gen., but(5) with the acc. Ph.: b. the wind anuvAtam.II Before the eyes of: samakzam (with gen., or in comp. or absol). b. Umā umAsamakzam; b. her two friends saKyoH samakzam, b. her own eyes samakzam, Ku. iii. 64., 75.; v. I. III Of time, succession, etc.:(1) prAka (with abl.), b. Chandragupta's entry prAk candra- guptapraveSAt, Mu. ii.;(2) pUrvam (with abl.), after daughter's son, but b. the mother dOhitrAtpa- rato mAtftaSca pUrvam, Da.

BEFORE (adv.): I Of space:(1) puras, from b. purastAt, K.:(2) purataH;(3) agrataH;(4) agre.II Of time:(1) purA (=formerly: q. v.): (2) pUrvam not seen or known or felt b. apUrvaH (rvA, rvaM); not heard b. aSrutapUrvaH (rvA, rvaM). N.B. Ob- -serve the cons. of yAvat na...tAvat.. b. the Demons laughed in this way, his (step) found measure in the sky yAvaditTamahasanna dAnavAstAvadasya na mamO naBastale, Si. xiv. 75.; see also B. xii. 4., Si. i. 12.

BEFORE , prep. and adv. pra, aBi prefixed. — (In the front of, not behind) agre, agratas, puras, puratas, purastAt, aBitas, pratimuKaM, aBimuKaM; ‘going before,’ purogaH -gA -gaM, agresaraH -rA -raM; ‘before the fire,’ aDyagni. — (In the presence of) sAkzAt, pratyakze, agre, samakzaM, pratimuKaM; ‘he took them before the king,’ tAn rAja- samIpam AnItavAn. — (In the sight of, before the face) samakzaM, pratyakzaM, pratyakzatas, sAkzAt, sammuKaM; ‘before many persons,’ bahu- janasamakzaM. — (Earlier in time, sooner than) prAk, pUrvvaM, with the abl. c.; agre; ‘before offering the cakes,’ piRqadAnAt pUrvvaM; ‘before the appointed time,’ nirUpitasamayAt pUrvvaM or prAg vi- hitakAlAt; ‘he knows your necessities before you ask,’ yat tava prayojanaM tad yAcYAtaH pUrvvaM jAnAti; ‘before dinner,’ Boja- nAt pUrvvaM; ‘before the event,’ prAg GawanAt; ‘before me,’ madagre. — (In time past) purA, pUrvvaM, pUvvakAle. — (As yet, hitherto) adya yAvat, adyaparyyantaM, etat kAlaM yAvat, adyApi. — (Already) tatpUrvvaM, prAg varttamAnakAlAt; ‘before mentioned,’ pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, prAguktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvacoditaH -tA -taM; ‘the day before yesterday,’ aparedyus; ‘before and after,’ pUrvvottaraM.
BEFORE , l. 14. for pUvvakAle, read pUrvvakAle.
BEFORE-HAND: (1) prAgeva;(2) pUrvameva;(3) praTama- meva;(4) AdAveva.
BEFORE-HAND , adv. pUrvve, agre, pUrvvaM, agratas, pUrvvatas; ‘determining beforehand,’ agranirUpaRaM; ‘to taste beforehand,’ pUrvvasvAdanaM kf.
BEFORE-MENTIONED: pUrvoktaH (ktA, ktaM); (2) prAguktaH (ktA, ktaM);(3) pUrvoditaH (tA, taM).
BEFORE-TIME , adv. purA, pUrvvaM, pUrvvakAle, gatakAle.

(kzamayati -yituM) with acc. of the pers.
To BEG , v. n. Bikz (c. 1. Bikzate, BikzituM), BEkzyaM car (c. 1. carati, carituM), BikzAwanaM kf.

BEGETTING (subs.): (1) jananam;(2) prajananam; (3) utpAdanam.

BEGGAR (subs.): I A mendicant:(1) BikzuH; (2) BikzukaH (kI, f.).II A very poor person: (1) daridraH (drA, draM);(2) akiYcanaH (nA, naM): v. Indigent.III One who begs:(1) yAcakaH; (2) vanIyakaH: v. Solicitor.
BEGGAR (v. t.): daridraH (drA, draM) or niHsvaH (svA, svaM) karoti (kf, c. 8)

BEGGAR , s. (One who lives on alms) BikzuH m., BikzukaH -kI f., BikzopajIvI m. (n), BikzAcaraH, daridraH. — (A petitioner) prArTakaH, arTI m. (n), -rTinI f., prArTayitA m. (tf), yAcakaH, yAcanakaH, mArgaRaH -RakaH, vanIyakaH. — (In ragged garments) karpawI m. (n).
To BEGGAR , v. a. daridrIkf, sarvvasvaM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM), DanAd BraMS in caus. (BraMSayati -yituM).

BEGGARED , a. daridritaH -tA -taM, DanacyutaH -tA -taM, hftasarvvasvaH -svA -svaM, parikzIRaH -RA -RaM, gatavittaH -ttA -ttaM, nazwArTaH -rTA -rTaM, gataviBavaH -vA -vaM, [Page044-b+ 51] gatalakzmIkaH -kA -kaM, gataSrIkaH -kA -kaM; ‘he is beggared,’ SramaRAyate.
BEGGARLY (adj.) kfpaRaH (RA, RaM) (?): v. Mean, contemptible.
BEGGARLY , a. (Indigent) daridraH -drA -draM, nirDanaH -nA -naM, durgataH -tA -taM, kfpaRaH -RA -RaM, dInaH -nA -naM. — (Mean) tucCaH -cCA -cCaM, nIcaH -cA -caM, apakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
BEGGARLY , adv. kfpaRaM, kArpaRyena, dInaM, nIcaprakAreRa.
BEGGARY: dAridryam: v. Poverty, indigence.
BEGGARY , s. (Indigence) daridratA, dAridraM -dryaM, nirDanatA, parikzIRatA, kArpaRyaM, arTitA, dInatA.
BEGGED , p. p. prArTitaH -tA -taM yAcitaH -tA -taM BikzitaH -tA -taM.
BEGGING (subs.): (1) BikzA;(2) BikzaRam;(3) BikzAwanam (going about b.)
BEGGING , (Act of) s. BikzA, BikzAwanaM, BEkzacaryyA, arTanA, aByarTanA, yAcanA, yAcYA, prArTanaM -nA, arddanA, aBiSastiH f.

Begin, v. t. A-prA-raB 1 A; pra-upa-kam 1 A, prastu 2 U, (prastUyatAM BoH), pravft 1 A; ‘the wind began’ vAtogresaroBUt. [Begin]ner, s. ArabDf m., navacCAtraH. [Begin]ning, s. AraMBaH, upakramaH. 2 Adi m.; ‘having no b(eginning)’ anAdi. 3 mUlaM, yoni f., praBavaH; ‘b(eginning) with’ Adi-Adya- in comp.; ‘in the b(eginning)’ AdO; ‘from the b(eginning)’ AmUlAt, AditaH; ‘God has neither b(eginning) nor end’ anAdyanaMta ISvaraH.

BEGIN (v.): (1) AraBate, prA-, samA-, (rama, c. l) the low people do not b. from fear of obstacles prAraByate na Kalu viDnaBayena nIcEH, Mu. ii.;(2) pravartate (vft, c. l) (with. inf. or loc.), began to weep rodituM pravfttA, Sa. v.; the singing is begun pravfttaM saNgItakam, Mal. i.(3) upa-, kramate, pra-, (kram, c. l) (gen. with inf.), began thus to speak vaktumitTamu- pacakrame vacaH, Ki. xiii. 36;(4) pra-stOti (stu, c. 2) (rare), b. the holy ceremony prastutaM karma Darmyam, B. ii. 28;(5) pra-kurute (kf, c. 8) (rare), began to speak udIrayituM pracakre, N. xiii. 15.

To BEGIN , v. a. and n. AraB (c. 1. -raBate -rabDuM), aByAraB, prAraB, samAraB, prakram (c. 1. -kramate -kramituM), upakram, samupakram, pravft (c. 1. -varttate -varttituM); prakf, samprakf; prastu (c. 2. -stOti -stotuM); ‘he be- gan to cut,’ CettuM pravfttaH.
BEGINNER: I One who begins:(1) ArabDf (f. bGrI);(2) upakrantf (f. ntrI).II A novice: q. v.: navacCAtraH (f. trI).
BEGINNER , s. (One who begins) ArabDA m. (bDf), AramBakaH, upa- krantA m. (ntf), upakramitA m. (tf), upakramakArI m. (n). — (A novice) navaCAtraH, nUtanaSizpaH, prATamakalpikaH.
BEGINNER , s. nUtanAByAsI m. (n), navaSizyaH, prakrantA m. (ntf).

BEGINNING (subs.): I Commencement:(1) AramBaH;(2) prAramBaH;(3) samArammaH.II The first cause: AdiH, you are the b. of the world but you yourself have no b., you are the end of the world, but you yourself have no end jagadAdi- ranAdistvaM jagadanto nirantakaH, Ku. ii. 9.: v. Cause, origin.III The first state: AdiH, in the b. (God) created water apa eva sasarjAdO, M. i. 8.; I want to hear from the b. AditaH SrotumicCAmi, Mu. ii.; from the b. to the end AdyantaH (ntA, ntaM).IV Rudiments: q. v.

BEGINNING , s. AramBaH, prAramBaH, samAramBaH, prArabDiH f., AdiH m. upakramaH, prakramaH, udGAtaH, upodGAtaH, aByAdAnaM. — (Origin, source) mUlaM, yoniH m. f., udBavaH, praBavaH, garBaH, janma n. (n). — (Rudiments) AramBaH. — (Elementary property) kAraRaguRaH; ‘without be- ginning,’ anAdyaH -dyA -dyaM; ‘from beginning to end,’ AdyantaM, ApraTamAt SezaM yAvat; ‘beginning, middle, and end,’ Adima- DyAvasAnaM; ‘beginning with,’ Adi, Adya affixed.
Begird, v. t. parivezw 1 A or c., avaruD 7 U, A-pari-vf 5 U; valaya, rasanA, in comp.; samudrarasanA-udaDivalayA-pfTvI ‘earth begirt by sea’.
BEGIRD (v. t.): I To gird: q. v,II To en- -compass: q. v.: parivezwate.
To BEGIRD , v. a. parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -vezwituM), avaruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM).
BEGIRT , p. p. parivezwitaH -tA -taM, parigataH -tA -taM, valayitaH -tA -taM, AvftaH -tA -taM; ‘begirt with the sea,’ samudrameKalaH -lA -laM.
Begone, interj. apehi, apasara, apayAhi.
BEGONE (interj.): apehi apasara, etc. (imper. dual sing.).
BEGONE , interj. apEhi, apasara, dUram apasara.
BEGOTTEN , p. p. janitaH -tA -taM, utpAditaH -tA -taM, prasUtaH -tA -taM.
Begrease, v. t. vasayA lip 6 P, or snigDIkf 8 U.
To BEGREASE , v. a. vasayA or snehena or tElena or Gftena lip (c. 6. limpati -leptuM), snigDIkf.
To BEGRIME , v. a. malena duz in caus. (dUzayati -yituM), malina (nom malinayati -yituM), kaluza (nom. kaluzayati -yituM), kalaNka (nom. kala Nkayati -yituM).
BEGRIMED (adj.): kaluzitaH (tA, taM); (2) dUzitaH (tA, taM). B. with dust DUliDUsaritaH (tA, taM).
BEGRIMED , p. p. maladUzitaH -tA -taM, kaluzitaH -tA -taM, kalaNkitaH -tA -taM
To BEGRUDGE , v. a. spfh (c. 10. spfhayati -yituM), asUya (nom. asUyati -yituM).
Beguile, v. t. vinud c., ativah c. (of time) (kaTABirdivasamatyavAhayat). 2 vyAmuh c., vaMc 10, vipralaB 1 A, Akfz 1 P; pra-vi-luB c.
BEGUILE (v. t.): I To cheat, deceive: q. v. vi-pralaBate (laB, c. l).II Of time: Ph. b. d the day with various anecdotes kaTABirvinodyamAnastaM divasamavAhayat, K.

To BEGUILE , v. a. muh in caus. (mohayati -yituM), vipramuh, vyAmuh, vaYc in caus. (vaYcayate -yituM), parivaYc, pravaYc, Bram in caus. (Bramayati -yituM), pralaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), vipralaB, Akfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM -karzituM). — (To beguile the time) vinud in caus. (-noda- yati -yituM).
BEGUILED , p. p. mohitaH -tA -taM, vimohitaH -tA -taM, vaYcitaH -tA -taM, vipralabDaH -bDA -bDaM, vimUQaH -QA -QaM, prapaYcitaH -tA -taM, praloBitaH -tA -taM, viloBitaH -tA -taM, pratAritaH -tA -taM.
BEGUILER: vaYcakaH: v. Deceiver.
BEGUN , p. p. ArabDaH -bDA -bDaM, prArabDaH -bDA -bDaM, upakrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
Behalf, (on or in) arTaM, arTe, hetoH, kAraRAt, kfte (with gen.).

BEHALF , s. (In behalf of) arTaM, arTe, hetoH, hetO, kAraRAt, nimitte, kfte, generally affixed to the crude of a noun; ‘on my behalf,’ matkfte or madarTe; ‘on behalf of (his) son,’ putrahetoH. — (Favour) anugrahaH, prasAdaH.
BEHALF OF, IN OR ON: (1) arTam, on my b. mada- rTam;(2) kfte (with gen.) on b. of the Śudra vfzalasya kfte: v. For, on account of.
Behave, v. i. Acar 1 P, vft 1 A, vyavahf 1 P; See Act. 2 vfttiM kf 8 U, anuzWA 1 P; ‘well b(ehav)ed’ sadAcAraH. Behaviour, s. AcAraH, vftti f., vyavahAraH, cezwitaM, caritaM AcaraRaM.

BEHAVE (v. t.): (1) Acarati (car, c. l), the king b. d very ungentlemanly towards Śakuntalā tena rAjYA SakuntalAyAmanAryamAcaritam, Sa. iv.;(2) vartate (vft, c. l) (with loc.) b. politely towards him asmin vinayena vartatAm, U. vi.; b. towards the other wives as dear friends kuru priyasaKIvfttiM sapatnIjane Sa. iv.;(3) vyavaharati (hf, c. l), what (he) b. s towards me by (asking for) an interchange of acts kaTaM kAryavinimayena mayi vyavaharati, Mal. i.;(4) yatate, pra-, (yat, c. l) (to b. persistently), you should b. in such a way that she will be soon your worthy attendant taTA prayatitavyaM yaTeya- maticiramucitA paricArikA te BavatIti, K.

To BEHAVE , v. n. car (c. 1. carati, carituM), Acar, samAcar, vft (c. 1. [Page045-a+ 51] varttate, varttituM); sometimes vfttiM is added; as, ‘in whatever way you behave towards them,’ yAM vfttiM tezu varttase. vfttim anuzWA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), vyavahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM). — (Well-be- haved) sadAcArayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, sadAcAravAn -vatI -vat (t).
BEHAVIOUR: (1) vfttiH;(2) AcAraH;(3) vyava- hAraH.
BEHAVIOUR , s. vfttiH f., vfttaM, AcAraH, rItiH f., vyavahAraH, caritraM, caritaM, AcaraRaM, gatiH f., cezwitaM, sTitiH f.
Behead, v. t. SiraH (n.) Cid 7 P or kft 6 P. [Behead]ing, s. SiracCedaH; ‘worthy of b(eheading)’ SIrzacCedyaH.
BEHEAD (v. t.): SiraH or mUrDAnaM or SIrzaM Cinatti (Cid, c. 7) or kfntati (kft, or c. 7) or lunAti (lu, c. 5) (with gen.).
To BEHEAD , v. a. SiraH or mastakaM Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM), vimastaka (nom. vimastakayati -yituM).
BEHEADED , p. p. vimastakitaH -tA -taM, CinnamastaH -stA -staM, -stakaH -kA -kaM.
BEHEADING (subs.): (1) SiraSCedaH;(2) SIrza- SCedaH;(3) BUrDacCedaH.
BEHEADING (act of) s. SIrzaCedaH. — (Worthy of) SIrzaCedyaH -dyA -dyaM.
BEHELD , p. p. AlokitaH -tA -taM, dfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, AlocitaH -tA -taM, IkzitaH -tA -taM, IkzyamARaH -RA -RaM.
BEHEST (subs.): (1) AjYA;(2) nideSaH: v. Command.
BEHEST , s. AjYA, AdeSaH, nirddeSaH, nideSaH, SAsanaM, vaSaM.

Behind, prep. paScAt, pfzWataH, (with gen.) anu (with acc.); ‘concealing his body b(ehind) the creepers’ latAMtarita-latAvyavahitavigrahaH; ‘he is far b(ehind) (back ward)’ maMdaH, maMdaDIH; ‘b(ehind) the scenes’ nepaTye. adv. pfzWataH; ‘from b(ehind)’ paScAdetya, pfzWenAgatya. 2 avarataH, aDastAt. 3 dUre, dUrataH; ‘b(ehind) part’ paScAddeSaH, pfzWaM, nitaMbaH.

BEHIND (prep.): I At the back of:(1) pfzWataH (with gen.);(2) anu (with acc.);(3) paScAt (with gen.), b. them tAsAM paScAt, Ku. Ph. from b. the bushes latAvyavahitaH (tA, taM), [Page065] Sa. iii.II In a state of inferiority to:(1) nIcaH (cA, caM):(2) aDaHsTaH (sTA, sTaM): v. Inferior.

BEHIND (adv.): (1) pfzWataH (=on or from the back), shuts the king's eyes from b. pfzWenAgatya rAjYo locane saMvfRoti, V. iii.;(2) paScAt, from b. paScAdetya. V. iii.; putting b. paScAtkriyA, Ki. xviii. 42.

BEHIND , prep. or adv. paScAt, anu prefixed. — (Behind the back, at the back of) pfzWatas; ‘following behind,’ anugAmI -minI -mi (n). — (Below, inferior) aDastAt, aDarastAt. — (Posterior) avaratas, avaramnAt. — (At a distance) dUratas, dUre. — (The hinder part) pfzWadeSaH, paScAddeSaH, pfzWaM, nitambaH.
BEHIND , adv. paScAdBAge, pAScAtyaBAge, pfzWaBAge, paScimaBAge, paratas, utta- ratas; ‘behind the mirror,’ darpaRapAScAtyaBAge.
BEHINDHAND , adv. atItakAlaH -lA -laM, vilambI -mbinI -mbi (n), dIrGakAlInaH -nA -naM. — (Surpassed by another) atikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
Behold, v. t. dfS 1 P, Ikz 1 A; See See. [Behold]en, a. upakfta, kftopakAreRa parADIna. [Behold]er, s. prekzakaH, darSakaH, drazwf m.
BEHOLD (v. t.): (1) paSyati (dfS, c. l);(2) ava-lokayati, vi-, (lok, c. 10); v. To see, look at.
BEHOLD (interj.) paSya or paSya paSya (imper. dual sing).

To BEHOLD , v. a. dfS (c. 1. paSyati, drazwuM), aBidfS, vidfS, sandfS; Ikz (c. 1. Ikzate, IkzituM), samIkz, vIkz, aBivIkz, prekz, aBiprekz, samprekz, udIkz, avekz, anvIkz, avalok (c. 10. -lokayati -yituM, c. 1. -lokate -lokituM), Alok, samAlok, vilok, lakz (c. 10. lakzayati -te -yituM), Alakz, samAlakz, upalakz, saMlakz; Aloc (c. 10. -locayati -yituM).
BEHOLD , interj. paSya, prekzasva

To be BEHOLDEN , v. n. kftopakArasmaraRena parADInaH -nA -naM or parAyattaH -ttA -ttaM BU, prAptopakArahetor badDaH -dDA -dDaM or nibadDaH -dDA -dDaM BU or as, kftopakAraM jYA (c. 9. jAnAti, jYAtuM), pratyupakAraH karaRIya iti jYA, AprAptopakAramokzAt paravaSaM jYA.
BEHOLDER: (1) prekzakaH;(2) darSakaH;(3) drazwwa (m.)
BEHOLDER , s. prekzakaH, drazwA m. (zwf), prekzamARaH, darSI m. (n), paSyan m. (t).
Behoof, s. arTaH, PalaM, vfdDi f., lABaH.
BEHOOF (subs.) lABaH: v. Advantage, benefit.
BEHOOF , s. arTaH, PalaM, lABaH, vfdDiH f., vivfdDiH f., PalodayaH.
Behove, v. t. Ex. by pot. pass. part. pot. mood, or arh 1 P; ‘it b(ehove)s thee to assist me’ tvayA mama sAhAyyaM kartavyaM, sAhAyyaM kartumarhasi &c.; See Become, v. t.
BEHOVE (v. impers.): Expr. by the future pass. part: it b. s you to forgive this fault ayamaparADo BavatA marzayitavyaH, Sa. iv.: v. Ought.
BEHOVEFUL , a. yaTocitaH -tA -taM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, arTakaraH -rI -raM.

It BEHOVES , v. imp. Expressed by the future passive parti- ciple; as, ‘it behoves you to marry the damsel,’ tvayA kanyA voQavyA; or by the potential mood, as, tvaM kanyAM vaheH; or by the use of the verb arh (c. 1. arhati), as tvaM kanyAM voQum arhasi; ‘to act as it behoves one,’ yaTocitaM kf.

BEING (subs.): I Existence:(1) astitvam; (2) sadBAvaH;(3) satvam,(4) sattA, endowed with b. by birth janmanA labDasattAkasya, S. i. 2.II That with exists:(1) BUtam, of mortal and immortal b. s martyAmartyasya BUtagrAmasya, U. vii.;(2) satvaH; (3) vivekin (m.) (=rational b.);(4) cetanaH (=sentient b.); (prARin, prARaBft (m.) (=one endowed with life);(6) SarIrin, dehin (m.) (=corporeal b.) Ph. the Supreme B. parameSvaraH.

BEING , s. (A being) BUtaM, sattvaH. — (A sentient being) prARI m. (n), prARaBft m. f. n., SarIrI m. (n), dehI m. (n), jantuH m., janyuH m., cetanaH, janmI m. (n). — (Existence) prARaDAraRaM, asuDAraRaM, niSva- sanapraSvasanaM, samBavaH, asti ind., vfttiH f., sattvaM. — (Particular state) BAvaH, avasTA, daSA, vfttiH f. — (Supreme Being) parameSvaraH. — (Pres. part.) san satI sat (t), varttamAnaH -nA -naM.
BEING , l. 1. for sattvaH, read sattvaM.

BEING THAT , conj. (Since) yatas, yasmAt, yena, iti hetoH, yatohetoH. ‘Being,’ is often expressed by the loc. c. of sat, as, ‘the man being gone,’ puruze gate sati; ‘it being so,’ evaM sati, taTAtve, evamBUtvA. ‘Being’ may also be expressed by the abl. c. of the abstract noun in such phrases as ‘he being a good man,’ sajjanatvAt.
BEITSO , evamastu, taTAstu, Bavatu, astvevaM.
BELABOUR: tAqayati (taq, c. 10): V. To beat, cudgel.
To BELABOUR , v. a. taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), han (c. 2. hanti, hantuM), aBihan aByAhan, samAhan; prahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM). — (With a stick) vetrAGAtaM kf.
Belate, v. i. cirAya or ciray D.
Belay, v. t. prati-upa-ruD 7 U.
To BELAY , v. a. (Block up) pratiruG (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM), uparuD.
Belch, v. i. udvam 1 P, udgF 6 P. [Belch]ing, s. udvamanaM, udgiraRaM, udgAraH.
BELCH (v.): (1) ut-vamati (vam, c. l); ut-girati (gF, c. 6).
BELCH, BELCHING (subs.): (1) (udvamaH;(2) udvamanam;(3) udgAraH;(4) udgiraRam.
To BELCH , v. a. udvam (c. 1. -vamati -vamituM), udgF (c. 6. -girati -garituM -garItuM).
BELCH , BELCHING, s. udvamaH, udvamanaM, udgAraH, udgiraRaM.
BELDAM: vfdDA: v. Old woman, hag.
BELDAM , s. vfdDA strI, jariRI, jarApariRatA strI, kuwwinI, kurUpI.
BELEAGUER (v. t.): ruRadDi, ava-, upa, (ruD, c. 7): v. To besiege, blockade.
To BELEAGUER , v. a. (To besiege) ruD (c. 7. ruRadDi, rodDuM), avaruD, uparuD; parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -vezwituM).
BELEAGUERED , p. p. parivezwitaH -tA -taM, uparudDaH -dDA -dDaM, bADitaH -tA -taM.
BELFOUNDER , s. GaRwAkArI m. (n), GaRwAnirmmARakarttA m. (rttf), kAMsyakAraH.
BELFRY: *GaRwASfNgam; yasmin prAsAdaSfNge vAdanAya GaRwA sTApyate.
BELFRY , s. GaRwAtAqanayogyaM prAsAdaSfNgaM, GaRwAsTAnaM, GaRwASAlA.
Belie, v. t. asatyaM Aruh c. (ropayati); miTyABiyogaM kf 8 U; pari-apa-vad 1 A.

BELIE (v. t.): I To show to be false: expr. by(1) vyanakti (vyaYj, c. 7);(2) vi-vfRoti (vf, c. 5);(3) prakASayati (nomi.) etc. (=to show: q. v.) the (wanton sword of) language of bad men b. s their heart hfdayaM nigUhataH sPurannasADorvivfRoti vAgasiH, Ki. xiv. 12.II To calumniate, misrepresent: q. v.: apa-vadati (vad, c. l).

To BELIE , v. a. (To counterfeit, imitate) Cal (c. 10. Calayati -yituM), Cadma or CadmaveSaM kf, anukf (c. 8. -karoti -karttuM). — (To charge any one with falsehood, to argue) anftaM or asatyaM or miTyAvAdaM kasmEcid Aruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), piSuna (nom. piSunayati -yituM). — (To calumniate) parivad (c. 1. -vadati -vadituM), apavad, kalaNkaM kf, miTyABiyogaM kf.

BELIEF (subs.): I Credence:(1) viSvAsaH, worthy of b. viSvAsayogyaH (gyA, gyaM): v. Credi- -ble;(2) pratyayaH.II Religious faith:(1) SradDA; (2) viSvAsaH;(3) Astikyam;(4) AstikyabudDiH III Doctrine, opinion: q. v. matam.IV The object of belief: expr. by the verb: ghosts are the belief of fools *mUrKA BUtezu viSvasanti.

BELIEF , s. (Credence) pratyayaH, viSvAsaH, viSramBaH, pramARaM. — (Religious belief) SradDaM -dDA, BaktiH f., viSvAsaH. — (Opinion) matiH f., budDiH f., boDaH — (The thing believed in, tenet) mataM; ‘my belief is,’ manye.
BELIEVABLE , a. viSvAsyaH -syA -syaM, SradDeyaH -yA -yaM, viSvAsayogyaH -gyA -gyaM.

sanskrit.iast: maurye bhūṣaṇavikrayaṃ narapatau ko nāma sambhāvayet

details.body: Believe, v. t. viSvas 2 P, (with loc.). SradDA 3 U (with loc. of person and acc. of thing); prati-i 2 P, (with acc.). 2 saMBU c., tark 10, man 4 A. [Believ]er, s. viSvAsin m., SradDAluH, SradDAnvitaH. Belief, s. viSvAsaH, viSraMBaH, pratyayaH. 2 SradDA, AstikyabudDi f. 3 mati f., budDi f., ‘it is my b(elief)’ iti me matiH or mataM, ityahaM manye.

BELIEVE (v. i.): I To have faith in:(1) viSvasiti (Svas, c. 2.) (with loc.) when does a virgin b. in man puMsi viSvasiti kutra kumArI, N. v. 100.(2) pratyeti (i, c. 2.) (with acc.) every body b. s in the existence of his self sarvo hyAtmAstitvaM pratyeti, S.II To think, suppose: q. v.:(1) samBAvayati;(2) manyate (man, c. 4.).

BELIEVE (v. t.): (1) pratyeti, if you don't b. me yadi mama vacane na pratyezi, Ra.;(2) viSvasiti, so that his Highness would b. me yaTA mAM viSvased viBuH, A. r.;(3) SraddaDAti or SradDatte (DA, c. 3) who will b. the real fact kaH SradDAsyati BUtArTam, Mr. iii.; (4) samBAvayati (c. of BUH =to think possible), who will b. that the Maurya king sold the ornament mOrye BUzaRavikrayaM narapatO ko nAma samBAvayet, Mr. v. Ph. I dont b. this atra me'pratyayaH.
To BELIEVE , v. a. (To give credit to) pratI (c. 2. pratyeti, pratyetuM), pratyayIkf. — (To have religious belief in) viSvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -SvasituM) with loc. c.

To BELIEVE , v. n. (To exercise religious faith) SradDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), viSvAsaM kf, pratyayaM kf. — (To believe in, hold as an object of faith) viSvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -SvasituM) with loc. c. — (To think) man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM).
To BELIEVE , v. a. satyamiti man. BELIEF, s. AstikatA.
BELIEVED , p. p. viSvasitaH -tA -taM, viSvastaH -stA -staM, pratItaH -tA -taM.
BELIEVER (subs.): (1) SradDAluH;(2) viSvAsin (m.);(3) AstikaH (a religious b.).
BELIEVER , s. SradDAnvitaH, AstikaH, pratyayI m. (n), viSvAsI m. (n).
BELIEVING , a. SraddaDAnaH -nA -naM, SradDAluH -luH -lu, SrAdDaH -dDA -dDaM, SradDA- -vAn -vatI -vat (t), jAtaviSvAsaH -sA -saM, viSvAsI -sinI -si (n), pratyayI -yinI -yi (n).
Belike, adv. api nAma, kiMsvit.
BELIKE , adv. apinAma, kiMsvit, kila, syAt.
Belittle, v. t. laGUkf 8 U.
Bell, s. GaMwA; ‘small b(ell)’ kiMkiRI; ‘b(ell) metal’ kAMsyaM, pItalohaM; ‘b(ell) clapper’ GaMwAvAdakaH.
BELL: GaRwA, to ring a b. GaRwAM vAdayati (c. of vad); small tinkling b. s kiNkiRI, B. man: v. Bell- -ringer.

BELL , s. GaRwA, GaRwikA, GanaM. — (Tinkling ornaments) kiNkiRI; ‘to ring a bell,’ GaRwAM han (c. 2. hanti, hantuM) or taq (c. 10. tAqayati yituM) or vad in caus. (vAdayati -yituM); ‘bell-shaped,’ GaRwAkAraH -rA -raM.

sanskrit.slp1: Sirasko musalAkAra AyasakIlo yena itastato lolamAnA GaRwA vAdyate
sanskrit.word: शिरस्को मुसलाकार आयसकीलो येन इतस्ततो लोलमाना घण्टा वाद्यते
sanskrit.iast: śirasko musalākāra āyasakīlo yena itastato lolamānā ghaṇṭā vādyate

details.body: BELL-CLAPPER , s. GaRwAvAdakaH, GaRwAkoRaH, GaRwAByantare lambamAna itastato dolAyamAnas tadvAdanayogyo lavaNgAkAraH koRaH; GaRwAByantare lagnaH sTUla- Sirasko musalAkAra AyasakIlo yena itastato lolamAnA GaRwA vAdyate
BELL-FOUNDER: *GaRwAkAraH.
BELL-FOUNDRY: *GaRwAsanDAnaSAlA.
BELL-METAL: *GozaH; tAmratrapumiSritopaDAtuBedaH, kAMsyam (properly an alloy of copper and zinc).
BELL-METAL , s. kAMsyaM, GaRwASabdaM, GozaH, tAmbArdDaM, GorapuzpaH, pItalohaM.
BELL-RINGER: (1) GaRwAvAdakaH;(2) GaRwAtAqaH; (3) GARwikaH.
BELL-RINGER , s. GaRwAtAqaH -qakaH, GaRwAvAdakaH, GaRwAvAdayitA m. (tf).
Belladonna, s. kaMwakArikA.
Belle, s. suMdarI, rUpavatI strI; suBagaMmanyA.
BELLE: (1) sundarI;(2) mattakASinI;(3) varavarRinI.
BELLE , s. sundarI f., surUpI f., rUpavatI f., suveSinI f., pramadA.
BELLES-LETTERS: alaNkArAdiSAstram: v. Litera- -ture.
BELLES-LETTRES , s. alaNkAravidyA, rasavidyA, rasikA vidyA, vANmayaM.
Belles letters, s. vANmayaM.
Bellicose, a. kalahapriya-SIla, raRotsuka, yuyutsu.
Belligerent, a., s. badDasamara; yoDanaSIla, yuyutsu.
BELLIGERENT: (1) yuDyamAnaH (nA, naM);(2) raRABi- yuktaH (ktA, ktaM).
BELLIGERENT , a. yuDyamAnaH -nA -naM, raRaSIlaH -lA -laM, yuyutsuH -tsuH -tsu.
BELLIPOTENT , a. raRavIraH -rA -raM, vikramI -miRI -mi (n), mahAvIryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM.
Bellow, v. i. nad 1 P, ninad, garj 1 P, ras 1 P, raw 1 P, nard 1 P. [Bellow]ing, s. garjita, ninAdaH, garjanaM, rasitaM.
BELLOW (v. i.); nardati (nard, c. l.): v. To roar, sound.

To BELLOW , v. n. garj (c. 1. garjati, garjituM), nard (c. 1. nardati, nardituM), vinard, ras (c. 1. rasati, rasituM), ru (c. 2. rOti, ravituM), viru, saMru; raw (c. 1. rawati, rawituM), gaj (c. 1. gajati, gajituM), hamBa (nom. hamBAyate -yituM).
BELLOWED , p. p. garjjitaH -tA -taM, nardditaH -tA -taM, praRardditaH -tA -taM.
BELLOWING (subs.): (1) narditam;(2) nardanam; (3) garjanam: v. Roaring.
BELLOWING , s. garjjanaM, nAdaH, rutaM, nardanaM, narditaM.
Bellows, s. BastrA, dfti f., BastrI, carmaprasevikA.
BELLOWS: (1) BastrA, a black-smith's b. karmakAra- BastrA, H.;(2) dftiH;(3) carmaprasevikA.
BELLOWS , s. BastrA f., BastrI, BastrakA, carmmaprasevakaH -vikA, vyajanaM, dftiH f.
BELLUINE , a. pASavaH -vI -vaM, paSuSIlaH -lA -laM, amAnuzaH -zI -zaM.

Belly, s. udaraM, jaWaraM, tuMdaM, kukziH; ‘b(elly) ache’ udaraSUlaH-laM; ‘b(elly) full’ AkaMWaM; udarapUraRaM (s.); ‘b(elly) bound’ AnadDa; badDodara; ‘b(elly) god’ udaraMBariH, OdarikaH; ‘b(elly) worm’ krimiH; kfmiH.
BELLY (subs.): I. Of an animal: (1) udaram; (2) kukziH; (3) tundam, A.; (4) piciRqaH, A. one who has a big b. tuRqilaH or piciRqilaH (lA, laM). II The womb: q. v.: kukziH. III The stomach: q. v.
BELLY , s. udaraM, jaWaraM -rA, kukziH m., piciRqaH, picaRqaH, tundaM, tundi n.
To BELLY or BELLY-OUT, v. n. (To swell out, bulge out) udaravat or udararUpeRa lamb (c. 1. lambate, lambituM) or pF in pass. (pUryyate).
BELLY-ACHE: udaraSUlam, Śr.; udaravedanA.
BELLY-ACHE , s. udaravedanA, udarAmayaH.
BELLY-BAND: udaratrARam: v. Girth.
BELLY-BAND , s. udaratrARaM, udaradAma n. (n), avasaktikA.
BELLY-BOUND , a. AnadDaH -dDA -dDaM, nibadDaH -dDA -dDaM, badDodaraH -rA -raM.
BELLY-FUL (adv.): AkaRWam (=up to the neck), they ate b. amIBirAkaRWamaBoji, N. xvi. 92.
BELLY-FULL , s. udarapUraRaM, piciRqapUraRaM, jaWarapUraRaM.
BELLY-GOD , s. udaramBariH m., kukzimBariH m., OdarikaH, udarakAmukaH, AtmamBariH m.
BELLY-WORMS , s. pl. udarAvezwaH, mIvA, kfmiH m., krimiH m.
BELMAN , s. GozakaH, GaRwADaraH, GaRwAtAqanapUrvvakaM GozaRAkarttA m., vEboDikaH.

Belong, v. i. as 2 P, vid 4 A, BU 1 P, with gen.; or by an adj. from noun; ‘this book belongs to me’ mamedaM pustakaM, or madIyametat pustakaM, ‘b(elong)ing to spring’ vAsaMtika (kI f.); ‘b(elong)ing to the king’; rAjakIya. 2 saMbaMD pass.; ‘this does not b(elong) to you’ nAyaM tava vyApAraH.

BELONG (v. i.): I To be the property of: expr. by the gen. with BU gen. understood: it is said that a field b. s to him who clears the jungle sTAnucCedakasya kedAramAhuH, M. ix. 44: v. Belonging to, have.II To relate to, con- -cern: q. v.

To BELONG , v. n. (To be one's own property) AtmIyaH -yA -yaM or svakIyaH -yA -yaM or svADInaH -nA -naM as. But the sense of ‘belonging’ is more usually expressed by the use of the roots as or BU or vid with the gen. c.; as, ‘money be- longs to me,’ mama DanaM vidyate or asti. — (To have relation to) sambanD in pass. (-baDyate). — (To be fit, or becoming) yuj in pass. (yujyate); ‘this belongs to me,’ i. e. ‘this is my busi- ness,’ mama ayaM vyApAraH.
BELONGING , part. sambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), sambanDakaH -kA -kaM.
BELONGING , a. aDInaH -nA -naM; ‘to another,’ parADInaH -nA -naM.

BELONGING TO (as adj.): (1) by- Iya deriv. b. to another anyadIyaH (yA, yaM): b. to a king rAjakIyaH;(2) by- a der.: b. to the season ArtavaH (vI, vaM); b. the next world pAralOkikaH (kI, kaM);(3) by- ya der.: b. to one's father pitryaH (tryA, tryaM); b. to a cow gavyaH (vyA, vyaM).
Beloved, a. priya, izwa, dayita, vallaBa; ‘b(eloved) person’ dayitajanaH, &c.
BELOVED (adj.): (1) priyaH (yA, yaM), o, my b. ayi priye, N.;(2) izwaH (zwA, zwaM);(3) vallaBaH (BA, BaM);(4) dayitaH (tA, taM); v. Dear (II)

BELOVED , a. priyaH -yA -yaM, supriyaH -yA -yaM, dayitaH -tA -taM, izwaH -zwA -zwaM, aBIzwaH -zwA -zwaM, izwatamaH -mA -maM, prezWaH -zWA -zWaM, prItaH -tA -taM, hfdyaH -dyA -dyaM, vallaBaH -BA -BaM, aBIpsitaH -tA -taM. — (Dear as one's life) asusamaH -mA -maM, prAREr garIyAn -yasI -yaH (s).
BELOVED , a. kAntaH -ntA -ntaM, suBagaH -gA -gaM; ‘by all,’ sarvvapriyaH -yA -yaM.

Below, prep. aDaH, aDastAt, tale, (with gen.). 2 Una in comp. 3 ayogya, anarha, ananurUpa, asadfSa (SI f.); ‘the gods are b(elow) Hari’ anu hariM surAH (S. K.). adv. aDaH, aDastAt; aDoBAge loke (in hell). 2 nIce, avarataH. 3 iha, iha loke.

BELOW (prep.): I Of place:(1) aDaH or aDastAt (with gen.);(2) tale (with gen.), b. the bed paryaNkatale, H.: v. Beneath, under. II Less than: Ph.: b. two years Unadvi- vArzikaH, M. v. 68.; v. Under.III Of rank or dignity: anu (with acc.): v. Beneath.
BELOW (adv.): I Of place:(1) aDas;(2) aDastAt (from b.)(3) aGoBAge (not of motion); (4) nIcEH: v. Down.II In the regions of the dead:(1) aDoloke;(2) aDoBuvane.III To those regions: aDolokam etc.

BELOW , prep. (Under in place) aDas, aDastAt, tale, nIce, aDo'Das; ‘below the bed, KawvAtale or KawvA'DaH. — (Inferior, beneath) avaraH -rA -raM, aDaHsTaH -sTA -sTaM, avaratas, avarastAt, aDareRa, aDarAt, aDaratas, aDarastAt. — (Unworthy of) ayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, anarhaH -rhA -rhaM. — (Subject to) aDInaH -nA -naM. — (Less than) UnaH -nA -naM; ‘below two years of age,’ UnadvivArzikaH or aprAptadvitIyavarzaH.
BELOW , adv. aDas, nIce, nIcakEs, aDaHsTAne, aDoBAge, aDaHsTaH -sTA -sTaM. — (On earth, as opposed to heaven) ihaloke, iha. — (In hell) aDoloke, aDoBuvane.
BELROPE , s. GaRwArajjuH m., GaRwAsUtraM, aDunAtanagfhezu GaRwAvAdane prayuktaM sUtraM.
Belt, s. meKalA, rasa(Sa)nA, kAMcI. v. t. meKalArUpeRa parivf 5 U or parivezw 1 A.
BELT (subs.): meKalA (also=sword-belt): v. Girdle.
BELT , s. meKalA, kAYcI, kawisUtraM, SfNKalaM -lA, rasanA.
To BELT , v. a. meKalArUpeRa parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -vezwituM).

sanskrit.word: कारेण च मेपयृथम् एकत्र करोति सः
sanskrit.iast: kāreṇa ca mepayṛtham ekatra karoti saḥ

sanskrit.slp1: yo mepaS caran caran kaRWalagnAM GaRwAM vAdayati evampra-
sanskrit.word: यो मेपश् चरन् चरन् कण्ठलग्नां घण्टां वादयति एवम्प्र-
sanskrit.iast: yo mepaś caran caran kaṇṭhalagnāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ vādayati evampra-

details.body: BELWETHER , s. yo mepaS caran caran kaRWalagnAM GaRwAM vAdayati evampra- kAreRa ca mepayfTam ekatra karoti saH; mepayUTAgragaH, mepayUTapaH.
BELWETHER , s. gaqqarikA. BENEDICTION, s. kalyARavacanaM, SreyovAdaH.
To BEMANGLE , v. a. vraSc (c. 6. vfScati, vraScituM, vrazwuM), pravraSc, KaRqaSaH kf, KaRqaM KaRqaM kf, SakalIkf, vyavaCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM).
Bemire, v. t. paMkena malinayati (D.). or duz c. (dUzayati).
To BEMIRE , v. a. malina (nom. malinayati -yituM), kaluza (nom. kaluza- yati -yituM), paNkena or malena duz in caus. (dfzayati -yituM).
BEMIRED , p. p. maladUpitaH -tA -taM, malazaNkI -NkinI -Nki (n).

BEMOAN (v. t.): (1) vi- lapati (lap, c. l.), b. s. the loss of his son putraSokena vilapati; b. s. the death of his brother BrAtfmaraRAt vilapati or BAtf- maraRaSokena vilapati;(2) anuSocati (Suc, c. l.) (rare) I b. my fate BAgyamanuSocAmi;(3) paridevayati (dev, c. 10.) (rare) v. To lament, bewail. N.B. Observe that only(2) takes a direct object.
To BEMOAN , v. a. vilap (c. 1. -lapati -lapituM), anuSuc (c. 1. -Socati -SocituM), paridev (c. 1. -devate devituM), lap in freq. (lAlapyate).
BEMOANING , s. vilapanaM, vilApaH, paridevanaM, kranditaM, anuSocanaM, rodanaM
Bench, s. pIWaM; PalakaH; ‘b(ench) of justice’ DarmAsanaM, vyavahArAsanaM.
BENCH I A seat: no equiv.: pIWaH; pawwaH; PalakaH, etc. may be used.II The seat of justice: (1) DarmAsanam (the personal seat);(2) aDikaraRa- maRqapaH, Mr. ix.;(3) vyavahAramaRqapaH, Mr. ix.
BENCH , s. dIrGAsanaM, dIrGapIWaM, AsanaM, PalakaH -kaM; ‘carpenter's bench,’ udGanaH. — (Seat of justice) DarmmAsanaM, vicArAsanaM.
BENCHER (of an inn of law): *saBAsad.
BENCHER , s. vicArakarttFRAM saMsarge jyezWaH or uttamapadaprAptaH, saByaH, saBAsad m. — (Judge) prAqvivAkaH.

Bend, v. t. nam c. (na-nA-mayati), ava-A-nam c. (namayati), namrIkf 8 U, Avfj 10, vakrIkf, Buj-, vi-A-°, 6 P; ‘bent under the load of breasts’ kucaBArAnamitA, stanaBareRa namratAmAnItA, stanaBAreRAvajiMtA; ‘b(end) the brow’ BrUBaMgaM kf; he ‘bent his mind again to his task’ sa punarapi svakArye manonyadaDAt-babaMDa-nyaveSayat; ‘b(end) to oneʼs will’ vaSIkf. v. i. A-ava-pra-nam 1 P, namra-lIna- a. BU 1 P, ‘trees b(end) down under the load of fruits’ BavaMti namrAstaravaH PalAgamEH (S. 5). Bent, a. Anamita; nA-na-mita, ABugna; pravaRa, prahva, Avarjita; ‘b(ent) on’ kftaniScaya, suniScaya, kftasaMkalpa, vihitapratijYa; ‘eagerly b(ent) on killing each other’ parasparavaDodyatO. s. nati f., vakratA, jihmatA. 2 vaMkaH, puwaBedaH. 3 SIlaM, vAMCA, niSrayaH, pravftti f., aBiniveSaH. [Bend]ing, s. nati f.; namanaM, avanamanaM.

BEND (v. t.); I To inflect:(1) namayati, A-, -ava-, (c. of nam), a bow not bent before Danuranamita- pUrvam, R. xi. 72.;(2) Avarjayati (vfja, c. 10), b. ing the boughs Avarjya SAKAH, R. xvi. 19.; (3) vakrIkaroti (kf, c. 8) (=to curve);(4) Bujati, A-, vi-, (Buj, c. 6.), b. ing his neck viBujya kaRWaM, N. xi. 12.;(5) jihmayati (nomi.) (rare), Ph. (a bow that has been) bent: cakrIkftam, Ku.; maRqalIkftam or AvirmaRqalam, Ki. (DanuH). II Fig.: To subdue: q. v.:(1) namayati, R.;(2) Avarjayati, D.III To apply or exert: q. v. Ph. to b. one's mind mano dadAti (dA, c. 3.); to b. the brow BrUBaNgaM karoti.

BEND (v. i.) I To crook or be curving:(1) namati, ava-, A-, (nam, c. l.)(2) by Bavati and any one of the adj.s given under crooked, curved.II To bow: q. v.: namati.III To be closely directed. Ph. bent on revenge praticikIrzu (mfn); bent on mischief jiGAMsu (mfn.) or hiMsAparAyaRaH (RA, RaM); bent on religion DarmaparAyaRaH (RA, RaM).
BEND (subs): of a river: (1) vakram;(2) vaNkaH; (3) puwaBedaH (vakrIkaraRam).

To BEND , v. a. (To bow, inflect) nam in caus. (nAmayati -yituM), avanam, Anam; namrIkf. — (To make crooked) vakrIkf, jihma (nom. jihmayati -yituM), aYc (c. 1. aYcati, aYcituM). — (To direct towards) Avfj in caus. (-varjayati -yituM). — (To bend a bow) Danur visPur in caus. (-sPArayati -yituM) or Ayam (c. 1. -yacCati -yintuM). — (To bend the brow) BrUBaNgaM kf. — (To bend the mind) manaH praviS in caus. (-veSayati -yituM). — (To subdue) vaSIkf.

To BEND , v. n. (To be incurvated) nam (c. 1. namati, nantuM), avanam, Anam; namrIBU, vakrIBU. — (To jut over) praRataH -tA -taM, as; pralamb (c. 1. -lambate -lambituM). — (To be bent or resolved on) kftaniScayaH -yA -yaM or dfQaniScayaH -yA -yaM or suniScitaH -tA -taM as. — (To be submissive) AnataH -tA -taM or vaSyaH -SyA -SyaM BU.
BEND , s. (Incurvation) natiH f., vakratA, jihmatA, vakrimA m. (n), kuYcanaM, avakuYcanaM, BaNgI. — (Bend of a river) vakraM, vaNkaH, puwaBedaH, BaNguraH.
BEND DOWN: I Trans.: ava-namayati, A-, (c. l. of nam).II Intrans.: ava-namati A-, (nam, c. 1.); [Page067] head much bent down with sorrow duHKena BfSAnataM SiraH, Si.
BENDING (subs): (1) natiH;(2) namanam; ava-, A-,;(3) Avarjanam.
BENDING (adj.): i. e. overhanging: pralambaH (mbA, mbaM).

BENEATH (prep): I Under:(1) aDaH or aDastAt (with gen.) or by the adj. aDasTaH (sTA, sTaM), b. the banyan tree nyagroDasyADastAt, P. iii. 4.; (2) tale in comp., b. the bed paryaNkatale, H. Ph. b. a. tree vfkzamUle, V. s.II Fig.: Ph, our country sinks b. his yoke *tasya pIqanenADogacCatyasmaddeSaH. III Lower in rank etc.: anu (with acc.) the gods are b. Viṣṇu anuhariM surAH, S. k.: v. Low, inferior.IV Unbecoming, unworthy of: expr. circum.: he thinks it b. his dignity to converse with me *sa mAM samBAzaRasyAyogyaM manyate.
BENEATH (adv.): (1) aDaH;(2) aDastAt: v. Below.

BENEATH , prep. (Lower in place) aDas, aDastAt, tale, nIce, aDo'Das, aDarastAt, aDaratas, aDarAt; ‘beneath the tree,’ vfkzatale or vfkzasyADastAt; ‘the water beneath the earth,’ DaraRyA aDaHsTaM toyaM. — (Inferior) avaraH -rA -raM, avaratas, avarastAt. — (Unbeseeming) ayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, anarhaH -rhA -rhaM.
BENEATH , adv. aDas, nIce, aDaHsTAne, nIcasTAne, aDaHsTaH -sTA -sTaM; ‘the earth beneath,’ nIcasTA pfTivI.
Benedict, s. navoQaH, navapariRItaH.

To BENEFIT , v. n. upakAraM or PalaM or lABaM or hitaM prAp (c. 5. -Aptoti -AptuM).
BENEFITTED , p. p. upakftaH -tA -taM, kftopakAraH -rA -raM, kftalABaH -BA -BaM.

BENEVOLENCE: (1) hitEzitA;(2) paropakAritA: v. Generosity.
BENEVOLENCE , s. parahitecCA, hitecCA, prema n. (n), dayAlutvaM, paropakA- raSIlatA, hitakAmyA, sOjanyaM, paravAYCApUraRaM, dayA, kfpA.
BENEVOLENT: I As applied to persons:(1) hitEzin (f. RI); paropakArin (f. RI): v. Gener- -ous.II As applied to acts, institutions, etc.(1) hitakaraH (rI, raM);(2) hitakArin (f. RI.)

BENEVOLENT , a. hitakAmaH -mA -maM, parahitEzI -ziRI -zi (n), paropakA- raSIlaH -lA -laM, hitaprepsuH -psuH -psu, priyEzI -ziRI -zi (n), parahitaH -tA -taM, upakAraparaH -rA -raM, dayAluH -luH -lu, suSIlaH -lA -laM, suhfdayaH -yA -yaM.
BENEVOLENTLY: (1) hitecCayA;(2) kfpayA (= kindly: q. v.).
BENEVOLENTLY , adv. suSIlavat, premnA, priyaM, dayApUrvvaM, sadBAvAt, kfpayA.
BENGAL , s. (The country) baNgaH. — (Belonging to it) bANgaH -NgI -NgaM.
BENGAL , s. aNgaH. BERRY, s. akzaH.
Benight, v. t. tamasA AcCad 10. [Benight]ed, a. tamovft, nESatamasAkrAMta; (fig.) ajYAnatamovfta.

BENIGHTED , p. p. niSAkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, rAtrigrastaH -stA -staM, tamovftaH -tA -taM, tamoBUtaH -tA -taM, santamasaH -sA -saM, tamasAcCannaH -nnA -nnaM.

BENIGNITY: I Kindness: q. v. dayAlutA.II Salubrity: q. v.

(BraMSayati -yituM). — (To be bereaved) hA in pass. (hIyate), parihA in pass. with inst. c., BraMS (c. 4. BraSyati, BraMSituM) with abl. c., viyuj in pass. (-yujyate).

To BESCATTER , v. a. avakF (c. 6. -kirati -karituM, karItuM), paryavakF.

BESEECHED , p. p. vinayena prArTitaH -tA -taM, aByarTitaH -tA -taM, yAcitaH -tA -taM.

BESEEMLY , a. yuktaH -ktA -ktaM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, yaMTocitaH -tA -taM.
Beset, v. t. ruD 7 U, AkulIkf 8 U, Akram 1 U, 4 P, saMbAD 1 A, upapIq 10, aBiBU 1 P. a. Akula, aBiBUta; ‘b(eset) with difficulties or dangers’ saMkawAkula, anarTasaMbADa, vipadaBiBUta.

(To besiege) ruD (c. 7. ruRadDi, rodDuM), uparuD, Akram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM). — (To surround) parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -vezwituM), upavezw, saMvezw; parizWA (c. 1. -tizWati -te -sTAtuM), paryyupasTA. — (To embarrass) AkulIkf, bAD (c. 1. bADate, bADituM), parikliS (c. 9. -kliSnAti -klezwuM).

Beshrew, v. t. amaMgala prArT 10 A, Sap 1 A.
To BESHREW , v. a. durBAgyaM or amaNgalaM prArT (c. 10. -arTayate -yituM), Dikkf.

Beside, prep. pArSve, samIpaM-pe; aBitaH, paritaH (acc.); nikawaM-we (gen.). 2 asaMbadDa a.; ‘b(eside) oneself with joy’ AnaMdaparavaSaH, AnaMdena vigatacetana iva BUtvA; ‘this is b(eside) the question’ aprAstAvikaM-aprAsaMgikaM-etat, aprakftaM.

BESIDE or BESIDES, prep. (At the side of) pArSve, pArSvatas, nikawe, samIpe, sanniDAne, aBitas; ‘beside the river,’ nadItIre, nadIsamIpe. — (Over and above) aDikaM, vyatiriktaM, antareRa, muktvA. — (Except) fte with abl. or acc., vinA with inst. or acc. — (Beside one's self) hatajYAnaH -nA -naM, upahatabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, unmattaH -ttA -ttaM.
BESIDE or BESIDES, adv. aparaYca, aparaM, anyacca, apica, kiYca, aDikantu, aDikaM; ‘are there any here besides?’ kim atra apare santi.
BESIDE ONE'S SELF: (1) hatajYAnaH (nA, naM);(2) vigatacetanaH (nA, naM).
Besides, prep. Ex. by Binna, vyatirikta, apara, itara, in comp., or with abl. adv. aparaMca, anyacca, kiMca, apica, aDikaM.

BESIDES (prep.): (1) by a comp. with BinnaH (nnA, nnaM) or vyatiriktaH (ktA, ktaM) b. this, another misfortune has befallen us etadBinnaM or etad- vyatiriktaM vyasanamaparamasmAkamApatitam;(2) vihAya, apahAya, etc. (with acc.), I have no other friend b. you tvAmapahAya mamAparo banDurnAsti.

BESIDES , prep. Often expressed by anya or itara with abl. c., or crude form.; as, ‘besides the above marks there are others,’ pUrvvoktacihneByo'nyAni Bavanti.
Besiege, v. t. ruD 7 U, ava-upa-ruD, parivezwf 1 A or c., Akram 1 U, 4 P. [Besieg]er, s. ava-upa-roDakaH. [Besieg]ing, s. upa-ava-roDaH, roDanaM.
BESIEGE (v. t.): ruRadDi, upa-, ava-, (ruD, c. 7.), b. d Champā ruroDa campAm, D. ii.; let (the Yadavas) b. Māhiṣmati mAhizmantImuparunDantu, Si. ii. 64.
To BESIEGE , v. a. ruD (c. 7. ruRadDi, rodDuM), avaruD, uparuD, parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -vezwituM), Akram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), bAD (c. 1. bADate, bADituM).
BESIEGED , part. a. rudDaH -dDA -dDaM, parivezwitaH -tA -taM, bADitaH -tA -taM.
BESIEGER: (1) avaroDakaH;(2) avarodDf (m.) (?); (3) roDin (m.) (?).
