BESMEAR (v. t.): limpati, vi-, A-, samA-, upa-, anu-, (lip, c. 6.): v. To anoint.
To BESMEAR , v. a. lip (c. 6. limpati -te -leptuM), Alip samAlip, upalip, aYj (c. 7. anakti, aMktuM), or caus. (aYjayati -yituM), didvaM (c. 2. degDi, degDuM), pradih.

BESMEARED , p. p. liptaH -ptA -ptaM, viliptaH -ptA -ptaM, upalizwaH -ptA -pta, aByaktaH -ktA -ktaM, digDaH -gDA -gDaM; ‘besmeared with blood,’ raktAktaH -ktA -ktaM, SoRitAktaH -ktA -ktaM, SoRitokzitaH -tA -taM.
Besmirch, v. t. See Besmear. 2 malinI kf 8 U.
Besom, s. mArjanI, SoDanI.
BESOM (subs.): sammArjanI: v. Broom.
BESOM , s. mArjanI, sammArjanI, SoDanI, vimArgaH, UhanI, samUhanI.
Besort, v. i. yuj pass., upapad 4 A.
To BESORT , v. a. yuj in pass. (yujyate), upapad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM).
Besot, v. t. muh c., jaqIkf 8 U. [Besot]ted, a. mUQabudDi, mUQAtman.
BESOT (v. t.): mohayati (c. of muh): v. To stupefy, infatuate.
To BESOT , v. a. muh in caus. (mohayati yituM), jaqIkf, mUQIkf.
BESOTTED , p. p. mUQacetAH -tAH -taH (s), mUQabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, mUQAtmA -tmA -tma (n), pramUQasaMjYaH -jYA -jYaM, mohitaH -tA -taM, jaqIkftaH -tA -taM.
BESOTTEDNESS , s. mohaH, sammohaH, mUQatA, jaqatA, jaqimA m. (n)
Bespangle, v. t. nakzatrAkArarBUzaREH anuvyaD 4 P or upa-SuB c. or BUz 10.
To BESPANGLE , v. a. nakzatrAkArEr BUpaREr anuvyaD (c. 4. -viDyati -vyadDuM) or SuB in caus. (SoBayati -yituM), upaSuB.
Bespatter, v. t. malena sic 6 P, malinayati (D.), kaluzayati (D.).
BESPATTER (v. t.): (1) aByukzati (ukz, c. l.); (2) aBiziYcati (sic, c. 6.).

To BESPATTER , v. a. paNkena or malena sic (c. 6. siYcAta -te, sektuM), avasic or avakF (c. 6. -kirati -karituM -karItuM), aByavakF or ukz (c. 1. ukzati ukzituM), prokz; malina (nom. malinayati -yituM), kalupa (nom. kaluzayati -yituM), kalaNka (nom. kalaNkayati -yituM).
BESPATTERED , p. p. maladUzitaH -tA -taM, kalaNkitaH -tA -taM, kaluzitaH -tA -taM.
Bespeak, v. t. sUc 10, dfS c., kaT 10; See Indicate; AkftirevAnumApayatyamAnuzatAM (Ka. 132) ‘b(espeak)s its being superhuman’.

BESPEAK (v. t.): I To order before hand: Ph. I bespoke a vessel to carry me to London *pUrvameva mayAdeSi yAnaM yAnAya laRqane: v. To encageengage, hire.II To be taken: q. v.:(1) kaTayati Śr.;(2) vadati (vad c. 1.), (these signs) b. this death taM vadanti gatAyuzam, Śr.;(3) Avedayati (c. of vid), K.III. To address: q. v. BAzate (mAz., c. l.)

To BESPEAK , v. a. (To order beforehand) praKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -KyAtuM), pUrvvAdeSaM kf; agranivedanaM kf; mama pUrvvaBuktiH syAditi vad (c. 1. vadati, vadituM). — (To betoken, indicate) sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), pradiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM). — (To forebode) agranirUpaRaM kf, pradfS in caus. (-darSayati -yituM).
To BESPECKLE , v. a. citr (c. 10. citrayati -yituM), SavalIkf, karvvurIkf.
To BESPIT , v. a. nizWIv (c. 1. -zWIbati -zWevituM), avanizWIv.
BESPOKEN , p. p. praKyAtaH -tA -taM, pUrvvAdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, agraniveditaH -tA -taM. — (Any commodity bespoken) praKyAtaBARqaM.
BESPREAD , p. p. AstIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, AvftaH -tA -taM, paricCannaH -nnA -nnaM.
BESPRINKLE (v. t.): (1) aBiziYcati;(2) aByukzati: v. To sprinkle.

To BESPRINKLE , v. a. sic (c. 6. siYcati -te, sektuM), avasic, nipic, saMsic, avakF (c. 6. -kirati -karituM -karItuM), aByavakF, paryavakF, samavakF, ukza (c. 1. ukzati, ukzituM), aByukz, prokz; klid in caus. (kledayati -yituM).
BESPRINKLED , p. p. siktaH -ktA -ktaM, ukzitaH -tA -taM, prokzitaH -tA -taM.

Best, a. praSastatama, uttama, SrezWa, parama, parArDya; ‘to the b(est) of oneʼs capacity or power’ yaTASakti, yAvacCakyaM; ‘to the b(est) of oneʼs belief’ yaTAmati; ‘b(est) of’ ex. by ratna or vara in comp.; strIratnaM, munivaraH.
BEST (adj.): Super. of good: q. v. Ph.: to the b. of one's ability yAvacCaktitaH.

BEST (superl. of good), a. sarvvottamaH -mA -maM, uttamaH -mA -maM, anuttamaH -mA -maM, sattamaH -mA -maM, SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, sarvvaSrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, paramaH -mA -maM, paraH -rA -raM, BadratamaH -mA -maM, arhattamaH -mA -maM, pravaraH -rA -raM, praSastaH -stA -staM, agrimaH -mA -maM, parArdDyaH -rdDyA -rdDyaM; ‘which is the best of these?’ etezAM ko BadratamaH; ‘best beloved,’ izwatamaH -mA -maM. Any thing the best of its kind may sometimes be expressed by ratnaM.
BEST (superl. of well), adv. uttamaM, SrezWaM, sattamaM, SrezWatas.
BESTAINED , p. p. kalaNkitaH -tA -taM, dUzitaH -tA -taM, parimalitaH -tA -taM.
Bestead, v. t. lABAya BU 1 P, hitAya kxp 1 A.
To BESTEAD , v. a. (To profit) PalAya or lABAya BU or as.
BESTIAL , a. pASavaH -vI -vaM, paSuSIlaH -lA -laM, paSuvyavahAraH -rA -raM, paSusadfSaH -SI -SaM, amAnupaH -pI -paM, krUrAcAraH -rA -raM.
BESTIALITY: i. e. unnatural connection with a beast: (1) paSugamanam;(2) paSuzu mETunAcaraRam, V. s.
BESTIALITY , s. paSutA -tvaM, paSuSIlatA, amanupyatA, krUrAcAratvaM, paSugamanaM.
To BESTIALIZE , v. a. paSUkf, paSusadfSaM -SIM -SaM kf.
BESTIALLY , adv. paSuvat, paSurUpeRa, paSuvyavahArAnusArAt, mAnuzAcAravirudDaM.
Bestir (oneself), cezw 1 A, Gaw 1 A, prayut 1 A, udyamaM kf 8 U, vyavaso 4 P.
To BESTIR , l. 3. for vyavaso c. 1., read vyavaso c. 4.

To BESTIR ONE'S SELF , v. r. cezw (c. 1. cezwate, cezwituM), vicezw, AtmAnaM cezw in caus. (cezwayati -yituM), yat (c. 1. yatate, yatituM), prayat, Gaw (c. 1. Gawate, GawituM), vyavaso (c. 1. -syati -sAtuM), udyamaM or utsAhaM kf.
BESTIR ONESELF: (1) yatate, pra-, (yat, c. l.); (2) Gawate (Gaw, c. l.): v. To exert.

Bestow, v. t. dA 1 P, 3 U, pradA, pratipad c., (with dat.) vitF 1 P (with loc.). 2 prayuj 7 A, 10, nikzip 6 P; ‘b(estow)ing wealth on proper persons’ vittasya pAtre vyayaH, ‘great care seems to be b(estow)ed on this picture’ idamAleKyaM prayatnataH-sunipuRaM-nirmitamiti anumIyate; ‘b(estow) oneself’ sev 1 A, AsTA 1 A, mano niviS c. [Bestow]al, s. dAnaM, pratipAdanaM. [Bestow]er, s. dAtf m., pradaH in comp.

BESTOW (v. t.): I To give, grant: q. v.: dadAti (dA, c. 3.).II To give in marriage: dadAti, pra-: she should be. b. ed on him whom she fancies yaM cABilazet sAmuzmE deyA, D. vi.III To [Page069] apply, use: q. v.: pra-yunakti (yuj, c. 7.).IV To deposit, store: q. v.: ni-daDAti (DA, c. 3.).

To BESTOW , v. a. (To give) dA (c. 3. dadAta, c. 1. yacCati, dAtuM), pradA, aBidA, anudA, vitF (c. 1. -tarati -tarituM -tarItuM), pratipad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM), upapad; nikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM); upAkf. — (To apply, lay out) prayuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yuMkte yoktuM), upayuj; niDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM). — (To give in marriage) kanyAM pradA
To BESTOW ONE'S SELF , v. r. (Attend to) sev (c. 1. sevate, sevituM). upasev; AsTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), mano niviS in caus. (-veSa- [Page048-b+ 51] yati -yituM).
BESTOWAL: (1) dAnam;(2) pradAnam;(3) prati- pAdanam.
BESTOWED , p. p. dattaH -ttA -ttaM, pradattaH -ttA -ttaM, prattaH -ttA -ttaM, nihitaH -tA -taM, viSrARitaH -tA -taM, pratipAditaH -tA -taM, nikziptaH -ptA -ptaM, vitIrRaH -rRA -rRaM.
BESTOWER: (1) dAtf or pradAtf (f. trI);(2) da or prada (f. dA), in comp.; b. of money DanadaH (dA, daM).
BESTOWER , s. dAtA m. (tf), pradAtA m. (tf), pradaH or daH in comp.
Bestraught, a. vyagra, ciMtAkula; See Anxious.
BESTRAUGHT , p. p. cintAkulaH -lA -laM, vyagraH -grA -graM, upahatabudDiH -dDiH -dDi.
Bestrew, v. t. AstF-stf 5, 9 U.
BESTREW (v. t.): stfRoti (stf, c. 5.): v. To strew.
To BESTREW , v. a. AstF (c. 5. -stfRoti -starituM -starItuM).
Bestride, v. t. pAdO pfTak kftvA A-aDiruh 1 P or aDikram 1 U, 4 P.
BESTRIDE (v. t.): Ph. to b. a horse aSvamArohati (ruh, c. l.): v. To stride.
To BESTRIDE , v. a. (A horse) pAdO or jaNGe pfTakkftvA aSvam Aruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM), aDiruh, aDyAruh; aDikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM); ‘bestriding a horse,’ aSvArUQaH.
Bestud, v. t. anuvyaD 4 P, Kac 10.
To BESTUD , v. a. gaRqAdiBUpaREr anuvyaD (c. 4. -viDyati -vyadDuM) or Kac (c. 10. Kacayati -yituM).
BESTUDDED , p. p. anuvidDaH -dDA -dDaM, KacitaH -tA -taM, pratyuptaH -prA -ptaM.
Bet, s. paRaH, pratijYA. v. t. paR 1 A (with gen. of thing staked); Satasya paRate (S. K.)
BET (sub.): (1) paRaH;(2) glahaH (rare).
BET (v. t.) paRaM karoti (kf, c. 8.); (2) paRatAM nayati (nI, c. l.), Ki. xi. 47.
BET , s. (Wager) paRaH, pratijYA, AkzikapaRaH.
To BET , v. n. paR (c. 1. paRate, paRituM), vipaR; div (c. 4. dIvyati, devituM).
Betake (oneself to), v. t. ADi 1 U, aMgIkf 8 U; araRyavAsamaMgIcakAra ‘betook himself to forest residence’.

BETAKE (v. i.): (1) A-Srayati, saBA-, upA-, (Sri, c. l.), b. n to Malayaketu malayaketumASritaH (tA, taM), Mu. iii.(2) majati, -te, (Baj, c. l.), shall I b. to quiet SAntiM BajAmi, Ma. n.IV 50.: v. Recourse to, have.
To BETAKE ONE'S SELF , v. r. ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -te -SrayituM), aBiSri, upASri, saMSri, samupASri.
BETAKEN (v. t.): sUcayati, A-vi-, (sUc, c. 10.): v. To forebode.
Betel, s. (tree) tAMbUlI, punnAgavallI, nAgalatA; ‘b(etel) box’ tAMbUlakaraMkaH, pUgapAtraM, ‘b(etel) nut’ pUgaM, tAMbUlaM; ‘b(etel) box bearer’ tAMbUlakaraMkavAhin.
BETEL (subs.): (1) tAmbUlI;(2) nAgavallI;(3) nAgalatA;(4) kuhalI. The prepared b. tAmbUlam. B. -seller tAmbUlikaH. B. -box = -bearer tAmbUla- karaNkavAhinI, K.

BETEL , s. (Nut) tAmbUlaM, pUgaM, udvegaM, pUgaPalaM. — (The plant) tAmbUlI, tAmbUlavallI, nAgavallI. — (A seller of it) tAmbUlikaH. — (Relating to it) tAmbUlI -linI -li (n). — (Betel box) pUgapAtraM, tAmbUlapewikA. — (Betel-bearer) tAmbUlavAhakaH, tAmbUladaH, vAgguliH m.
BETEL-NUT: (1) pUgam;(2) guvAkam;(3) tAmbUlam. B. tree:(1) pUgaH;(2) kramuH;(3) guvAkaH.
Bethink, v. t. anuDyE 1 P, vimfS 6 P; See Think.

To BETHINK ONE'S SELF , v. r. anucint (c. 10. -cintayati -yituM), saYcint, anuDyE (c. 1. -DyAyati -DyAtuM), vimfS (c. 6. -mfSati -marzwuM -mbazwuM), anubuDa (c. 4. -buDyate -bodDuM), anusmf (c. 1. -smarati -smarttuM).
BETHINK ONESELF: saMcintayati (cint, c. 10): v. To remember, reflect.
To BETHUMP , v. a. taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), prahf (c. 1. -harAta -harttuM).
Betide, v. t. Apat 1 P, upasTA 1 U, (gen.) See Befall, ‘may woe b(etide) him’ aBadraM tasya BUyAt.

To BETIDE , v. n. samBU (c. 1. -Bavati -BavituM), upasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), nipat (c. 1. -patati -patituM), sampad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), Gaw (c. 1. Gawate, GawituM); ‘may good betide you,’ BadraM te BUyAt; ‘woe betide you,’ avagrAhaste or ajIvaniste or akaraRiste BUyAtt.
Betimes, adv. praBAte, prAtaH, pratyUze. 2 yaTAsamayaM, velAyAM, yaTAvasaraM.
BETIMES (adv.): I Seasonably: q. v.: samaye. II Soon: q. v.: SIGram.
BETIMES , adv. praBAte, sakAlaM, prAtar, vyuzwaM, pratyUze, samayA, samaye, upa- yuktasamaye, velAyAM.
Betise, n. mOrKyaM, mUQatA. 2 mOrKyavilasitaM.
Betoken, v. t. sUc 10, dfS c.; See Indicate.

To BETOKEN , v. a. sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), pradiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), sandiS; aBidfS in caus. (-darSayati -yituM). — (To foreshew) pradfS in caus.; ‘betokening,’ sUcakaH -kA -kaM, vAcakaH -kA -kaM.
To BETOSS , v. a. kzuB in caus. (kzoBayati -yituM), kzip (c. 6. kzipati, kzeptuM).

Betray, v. t. Satrukarezu f c. (arpayati), viSvAsaGAtena f c. 2 Bid 7 U; ‘b(etray)ed the secret’ rahasyaM biBeda. 3 Indicate, q. v. 4 vaMc 10; See Cheat; ‘b(etray) themselves’ AtmasvarUpaM prakawayaMti. [Betray]er, s. viSvAsaGAtakaH, vaMcakaH.

BETRAY (v. t.): I To give up treacherously: Ph. b. ed the fleet to the pirates *saviSrammBaGAtaM potAvalIM dasyuhaste samarpayAmAsa (c. of f); do not b. your trust mA viSvAsaM vaDIH (han, c. 2.) or BAMkzIH (BaYj, c. 7.).II To disclose: q. v.: Binatti (Bid, c. 7.), b. ed the secret rahasyaM biBeda.III To mislead, expose, or indicate: q. v.IV To deceive: q. v.

To BETRAY , v. a. parahastezu or Satrukarezu or SatrupARizu or anyezAM karezu samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM), parAdA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM), pradA, vaYc (c. 10. vaYcayate -yituM), viSvAsaGAtaM or viSvAsaBaNgaM kf, KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), SatrorAyattaM -ttAM -ttaM kf. — (To shew, discover) sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM); dfS in caus. (darSayati -yituM), piSuna (nom. piSunayati -yituM), vyaktIkf, prakawIkf. — (To betray secrets) gopyAni prakAS in caus. (-kASayati -yituM), mantraBedaM kf.
BETRAYAL: Ph. the b. of a city Satruhaste nagara- samarpaRam: v. To betray.
BETRAYED , p. p. SatruhastArpitaH -tA -taM, vaYcitaH -tA -taM, parAdattaH -ttA -ttaM.

BETRAYER: (1) viSvAsaGAtakaH (=traitor);(2) vaYcakaH (=deceiver). Ph. where is the b. of the city kva sa viSvAsaDAtakaH, yo nagaraM Satruhaste samarpayA- mAsa. N.B. Note that in such cases(1) or (2) simply will not do.
BETRAYER , s. parahastArpakaH, vaYcakaH, viSvAsaGAtakaH, pradAtA m. (tf).
Betrim, v. t. BUz 10, alaMkf 8 U.
To BETRIM , v. a. BUz (c. 10. BUzayati -yituM), alaNkf, parizkf.
Betroth, v. t. (vAcA) dA 3 U, pratipad c., pratiSru 5 P, (dat.). [Betroth]al, s. vAgdAnaM, vAkpradAnaM
BETROTH (v. t.): (1) dadAti (dA, c. 3.) (only of b. al by the father or guardian of the girl), I apprehend she is already b. ed dattapUrvetyA- SaMkyate, Ma.;(2) pratipAdayati (c. of pad), Si.
To BETROTH , v. a. vAgdAnaM kf, niyamapatreRa vivAhapratijYAM kf, pratijYApatreRa vivAhasambanDaM kf.
BETROTHAL: (1) vAgadAnam (=verbal b. of a girl by her father or guardian);(2) vivAha- sambanDaH.

BETROTHED (adj.): (1) dattA or vAgdattA (a girl b. by her father or guardian) Da. com.; (2) pratipAditA, b. ed wife pratipAditA vaDUH, Si. xvi. 49.(3) pratiSrutaH (tA, taM) (=engaged, promised). N.B. The person to whom one is b. is put in the dat.
BETROTHED , p. p. vAgdattaH -ttA -ttaM, pradattaH -ttA -ttaM, prattaH -ttA -ttaM, prati- jYAvivAhitaH -tA -taM. — (Woman) vAgdattA, prattA.
BETROTHMENT , s. vAgdAnaM, kanyApradAnaM.
To BETRUST , v. a. paridA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM), niyuj in caus. (-yojayati [Page049-a+ 51] -yituM), samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM).

sanskrit.slp1: varaM mOnaM kAryaM na ca vacanamuktaM
sanskrit.word: वरं मौनं कार्यं न च वचनमुक्तं
sanskrit.iast: varaṃ maunaṃ kāryaṃ na ca vacanamuktaṃ

details.body: Better, a. Sreyas, Badratara, garIyas, praSastatara, sADIyas; ‘b(etter) than’ varaM-na; ‘better death than disgrace (I prefer death to disgrace)’ varaM mftyurna punarapamAnaH. 2 (In health) ex. by viSezaH; ‘I am b(etter) to-day’ asti me viSezo'dya (S. 3). adv. varaM, SreyaH, BadrataraM, aDikataraM, aDikaM. 2 (With verbs) ex. by tarAM; ‘he cooks b(tter) than Rāma’ rAmAtpacatitarAM. s. SrezWatA, pramuKatvaM, varcasvaM; ‘get the b(etter) of’ aBiBU 1 P, atiric pass., See Excel. v. t. vfD c.; kf with (a.). Betters, SrezWAH (pl.).

BETTER (adj.): I Comparative of good: q. v.II Preferable; Ph. b. (to have) a learned enemy than a stupid freindfriend paRqito'pi varaM Satrurna mUrKo hitakArakaH, P. i. 21.; b. to die than to mix with low people varaM prARatyAgo na punaraDamAnAmupagamaH, H. i.; b. to keep silence than to utter a lie varaM mOnaM kAryaM na ca vacanamuktaM yadanfnam; H.III. In improved health: Ph.: are you b.? Oh, yes, a little b. api te laGu- santApAnyaNgAni? aho asti viSezaH, Sa. iii.

BETTER (subs.): I Advantage or victory: q. v.: Ph. to get the b. of an enemy SatrUmaBiBavati (BU, c. l.).II Improvement: q. v.III In pl. superiors guravaH (m. pl.): Ph. your b. s in knowledge tvadaDikajYAnasampannAH.
BETTER (adv.): v. Well. Ph.: I love you b. than self *tvayyahaM prARemyo'DikamanuraktaH.

BETTER , (compar. of good) a. BadrataraH -rA -raM, SreyAn -yasI -yaH (s), SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, garIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), praSastaH -stA -staM, arhattaraH -rA -raM, sADIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), jyAyAn -yasI -yaH (s).

BETTER (compar. of well) adv. varaM, praSastaM, Sreyas, BadrataraM, BadrataraprakAreRa, SrezWaM. — (More) aDikaM, aDikataraM, atiriktaM. — (The better, the superiority) SrezWatA, SreyastvaM, praDAnatA, pramuKatvaM. — (To get the bet- ter) aBiBU, atiric in pass. (-ricyate).

To BETTER , v. a. BadrataraM -rAM -raM kf, SreyAMsaM -yasIM -yaH kf. — (To ad- vance) vfD in caus. (varDayati -yituM), saMvfD, parivfD, eD in caus. (eDayati -yituM), sameD. — (To surpass) atiric in pass. (-ricyate), aBiBU.
BETTERS , s. pl. (Superiors) SrezWAH m. pl., praDAnapuruzAH m. pl., utta- mapuruzAH m. pl.
BETTING , s. paRanaM, paRakaraRaM, paRArpaRaM, AkzikapaRakaraRaM, pratijYAnaM.
BETTOR , s. paRakarttA m. (rttf), paRakaH, paRArpakaH.
BETTY , s. dvArakapAwAdiBaYjane sanDicOrEH prayuktaM lohayantraM.

Between, Betwixt, prep. maDye, aByaMtare, aMtare, maDyasTAne; oft. ex. by gen. of nouns; daMSayoraMtaraM ‘distance b(etween) the two countries’; ‘b(etween) joy and sorrow (tears)’ SokAnaMdamaDyavartinI (Ka. 318).

BETWEEN, BETWIXT (1) by the gen. (not of time), the distance b. the Hemakūta and the Vindhyas is very great viprakfzwamantaraM hemakUwavinDyA- calayoH, K.; the space b. the divine rivers Sarasvati and Drishadvati sarasvatIdfzadvatyordeva- nadyoryadantaram, M. ii. 17.; enmity b. us tasya ca [Page070] mama ca vEram, D. ii.; the conflict b. the two im- portant duties vipratizeDaM taM guruRoraTa kAryayoH, Si. ii. 6.;(2) maDye or antare (with gen.) (of time and occasionally of other relations): middle age is b. sixteen and seventy years zoqaSa- saptatyorantare maDyaM vayaH. Śr.

BETWEEN or BETWIXT, prep. maDye, aByantare, antareRa, antare, antar, antarA, maDyatas, maDyasTAne; ‘the mediator between God and man,’ ISvarasya mARuzARAYca maDye maDyasTaH. Between is sometimes expressed by the gen. or inst. c.; as, ‘there is a great difference between a master and a servant,’ sevyasevakayor mahadantaraM; ‘great is the difference between thee and the ocean,’ tvayA samudreRa ca mahadantaraM; ‘I will put enmity between thee and the woman,’ tvayA nAryyA ca vEritAM janizpAmi; ‘I am in a strait betwixt two,’ uBAByAM saNkucito'smi; ‘they parted the paternal inheritance between them,’ dAyaM pitryaM parasparaM vyaBajan.
BEVER , s. mADyandinaBojanAnantaraM prAgrAtriBojanAt tatkAlAntare laDvAhAraH or ardDASanaM.
Beverage, s. pAnaM, peyaM, pAnIyaM; ‘b(everage) of the Gods’ amftaM.
BEVERAGE: pAnIyam: v. Drink.
BEVERAGE , s. pAnIyaM, peyaM, pAnaM, payaH n. (s). — (Of the gods) amftaM.
Bevy, s. gaRaH, saMGaH, samavAyaH.
BEVY: I Of ladies etc.: gaRaH.II Of birds: kulam: v. Flock.
BEVY , s. gaRaH, saNGaH, samavAyaH, yUTaM, kulaM; ‘a bevy of young lasses,’ taruRIgaRaH.
Bewail, v. t. vilap 1 P, Suc 1 P; See Lament. [Bewail]ing, s. SokaH, vilApaH, paridevanaM.
BEWAIL (v.): vi-lapati (lap, c. l.), what are you b. ing for kimarTaM vilapasi: v. To lament, weep, grieve.

To BEWAIL , v. a. and n. vilap (c. 1. -lapati -lapituM), Suc (c. 1. Socati, SocituM), anuSuc, paridev (c. 1. -devati -te -devituM); ‘to grieve exceedingly,’ Suc in freq. (SoSucyate), pariSuc in freq., lap in freq. (lAlapyate).
BEWAILABLE , a. SocyaH -cyA -cyaM, SocanIyaH -yA -yaM, vilapanIyaH -yA -yaM.
BEWAILING (subs).: (1) vilApaH;(2) paridevanam; (3) krandanam: v. Lamentation.
BEWAILING , s. vilapanaM, vilApaH, paridevanaM, anuSocanaM, krandanaM.

Beware, v. i. sAvaDAna-apramata-avahita a. BU 1 P; ‘b(eware) of your enemies’ Satruvizaye sAvaDAno Bava; ‘b(eware) lest you will be seduced by pleasures’ sAvaDAno Bava nocedvizayEH praloByeTAH; or taTA prayateTA yaTAnAkzipyase vizayEH (Ka. 109).

BEWARE: no exact equiv.: b. of him tasmin badDaviSvAso mA Bava; b. of your servants that they may not deceive you taTA prayateTAH yaTA na vaYcyase sevakEH; b. of your steps sAvaDAnaM parikrAma: v. Care.

To BEWARE , v. n. avaDA (c. 3. -Datte -DAtuM), sAvaDAnaH -nA -naM BU, avaDAnaM kf. — (Abstain from, avoid) parihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vfj in caus. (varjayati -yituM), vivfj, parivfj; ‘beware of men,’ sAnu- zeByo'vaDatta; ‘beware of too great avarice,’ atiloBAt sAva- DAno Bava; ‘beware lest any one deceive you,’ sAvaDAnA Bavata ko'pi yuzmAn na Bramayet.
To BEWEEP , v. a. rud (c. 2. roditi, rodituM), anuSuc (c. 1. -Socati, SocituM).
To BEWET , v. a. klid in caus. (kledayati -yituM), sic (c. 6. siYcati, sektuM),

Bewilder, v. t. AkulIkf 8 U, viklavIkf, vyA-saM-muh c., saMBram c. (Bramayati), jaqIkf. [Bewilder]ed, a. viklava, AkulIBUta, A-vyA-kula, vimUQa, vihvala, saMBrAMta; ‘b(ewildered) what to do’ kiMkartaDyatAmUQaH, pratipattimUQaH. [Bewilder]ment, s. saMBramaH, vEklavyaM, saMmohaH, vyAkulatvaM.
BEWILDER: (1) saM-mohayati (c. of muh);(2) jaqI- karoti (kf, c. 8.) or jaqayati (nomi.);(3) saM- Bramayati (c. of. Bram);(4) viklavIkaroti (kf, c. 8.).
To BEWILDER , v. a. muh in caus. (mohayati -yituM), vyAmuh, parimuh, vipramuh; AkulIkf, vyAkulIkf, viBram in caus. (-Bramayati -yituM), samBram.
BEWILDERED: (1) samBrAntaH (ntA, ntaM);(2) viklavaH (vA, vaM);(3) kiMkartavyatAmUQaH (QA, QaM) (=not to know what to do);(4) saMmugDaH (gDA, gDaM).

BEWILDERED , p. p. AkulaH -lA -laM, vyAkulaH -lA -laM, AkulitaH -tA -taM. AkulIkftaH -tA -taM, samBrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, kAtaraH -rA -raM, vyagraH -grA -graM. [Page049-b+ 51] mohitaH -tA -taM, mugDaH -gDA -gDaM, vimUQaH -QA -QaM, vimugDaH -gDA -gDaM, vyastaH -stA -staM, parivihvalaH -lA -laM.
BEWILDERMENT: (1) samBramaH;(2) vEklavyam;(3) sammohaH: v. Perplexity.
BEWILDERMENT , s. vyAkulatA, AkulatvaM, vyagratA, vEklavyaM, samBramaH, kAtaratA.

Bewitch, v. t. muh c., saM-vi-pari-°, vaSIkf 8 U, mad c. (mano madayaMti ye Mal. 2); maMtreRa vaSIkf. 2 mano hf or Akfz 1 P. [Bewitch]ing, a. mohana (nI f.), hArin [Bewitch]ment, s. mohanaM, mohaH, vaSIkaraRaM, mAyA, AkarzaRaM.

BEWITCH: I To charm or fascinate:(1) mohayati, pari-, vi-, saM-, (c. of muh,), let not Cupid b. you mA mUmuhat Kalu BavantamananyajanmA, Ma. i.; (2) madayati (c. 10. mad), which b. the heart mano madayanti ye, Ma. i.II To fascinate by magic:(1) mohayati;(2) mantreRa vaSIkaroti (kf, c. 8.).
To BEWITCH , v. a. mantradvArA vaSIkf or muh in caus. (mohayati -yituM), mohaM kf, aBimantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM). — (To captivate) mano hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM).
BEWITCHED , p. p. mohitaH -tA -taM, vaSIkftaH -tA -taM, aBimantritaH -tA -taM.
BEWITCHER , s. mohakaH, mohanaH, mAyI m. (n), vaSIkarttA m. (rttf), mAyAkft.
BEWITCHING (adj.): mohanaH (nI or nA, naM): v. Charming.
BEWITCHING , a. mohI -hinI -hi (n), mohanaH -nI -naM, manohArI -riRI -ri (n), manoharaH -rA -raM, praloBakaH -kA -kaM, AkarzikaH -kI -kaM, mAyI -yinI -yi (n).
BEWITCHINGLY , adv. yaTA mano hriyate or vaSIkriyate taTA, manoharapra- kAreRa, yaTA moho jAyate taTA, mAyayA, praloBanAya.
BEWITCHMENT , s. vaSIkriyA, vaSiH m., vaSitA, vaSIkaraRaM, mohanaM, parimohanaM, vimohanaM, sammohaH, mohaH, mAyA, kArmmaRatvaM.
To BEWRAY , v. a. (To betray) parAdA (c. 3. -dadAti -dAtuM), pradA; Satruhastezu samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM). — (To indicate) sUc (c. 10. (sUcayati -yituM), piSuna (nom. piSunayati -yituM).

Beyond, prep. parataH (with abl.) atikramya, atItya, (with acc.); ‘b(eyond) the forest is the Kailāsa’ tadaraRyamatikramya kElAsagiriH (Ka. 121); ‘Oh! Change b(eyond) belief’ aho viSvAsAtikrAMto (aviSvAsyaH) daSAviparyAsaH; ‘b(eyond) comprehension’ agamya, durjYeya, durboDa; ‘b(eyond) expectations’ manoraTAnAmaBUmiH (S. 7); gen. ex. by ati pr.; aDikaM, ‘b(eyond) measure’ atimAtraM; ‘b(eyond) human power’ atimAnuzaM; ‘b(eyond) this continent’ dvIpAMtare; ‘lives b(eyond) his means’ AyADikaM vyayaM karoti. adv. dUre, pAre-raM; ‘go or pass b(eyond)’ atikram 1 U, ati-i 2 P.

BEYOND (prep.): I On the further side of: Ph: b. it a desolate forest and b. that the mount Kailāsa tataH parato nirmAnuzamaraRyaM, taccAtikramya kElAsagiriH, K.; b. the range of speech and mind atItya vAcAM manasAM ca gocaram, Ki. xviii. 41. II Further than, past: Ph. this is b. us idamasmAkamasADyam; it was even b. my expectations manoraTAnAmapyaBUmiH, Sa. vii.; b. measure atIva; who is b. our senses atIndriyAya, M. n.; naturally b. any one's comprehension nisargadurboDaH (DA, DaM) Ki. Ph.: b. the seas: i. e. out of the country: dvIpAntare (not samudrapAre, which = on the coast of the sea).
BEYOND (adv.): i. e. yonder: q. v.: dUre, from b. dUrAt.
BEYOND, GO or PASS: (1) atikrAmati (kram, c. l.) (with acc.);(2) atyeti (i, c. 2.) (with acc.).

BEYOND , prep. and adv. ati prefixed. — (On the farther side) pAraM, pAre; ‘beyond the sea,’ samudrapAraM; ‘from beyond,’ pArAt; ‘to go beyond,’ atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), aticar (c. 1. -carati -carituM). — (In front) agre. — (Superior to) atirekI -kiRI -ki (n), viSizwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (More than) aDikaM, or expressed by ati prefixed; as, ‘beyond mortal strength,’ atimAnuzaH -zA -zaM; ‘beyond's one's power,’ atiSakti; ‘beyond mea- sure,’ atiSayaM, atIva; ‘passed beyond the range of sight,’ cakzurvizayam atikrAntaH. — (At a distance) dUre.
BEZEL: *ratnADAraH; aNgurIyakasya ratnapraRiDAnaBAgaH.
BEZEL or BEZIL, s. ratnADArayogyo' NgurIyakaBAgaH, aNgurIyakasya yatsTAne maRiH svacyate or praRiDIyate tat.

BHAVĀNĪ , s. (The wife of the god Śiva, and the goddess of destruction; called Bhavānī in her amiable form) BavAnI, umA, mahAdevI, devI. — (The pure one) gOrI. — (As terrible in form and irascible in temper) durgA, kAlI, caRqI, caRqikA. — (As daughter of Himālā, the sovereign of the snowy mountains) pArvvatI, hEmavatI. — (As wife of Śiva) SivA, ISvarI, rudrARI, sarvvARI, mfqAnI. — (The all-auspicious) sarvvamaNgalA. — (The mother) ambikA. — (As the performer of austerities) kAtyAyanI, aparRA.
BIANGULATED , a. dvikoRaH -RA -RaM, dvyasrakaH -kA -kaM, koRadvayaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Bias, s. spfhA, aBilAzaH. 2 SIlaM, BAvaH. 3 pakzapAtaH, pakzapAtitvaM. 4 protsAhanaM, pravartana. v. t. pravft c., praRud 6 P, protsah c. 2 sAcIkf 8 U; duz c. (dUzayati).
BIAS (subs.): I Inclination: q. v. pravaRatA. Partiality: q. v.: pakzapAtaH.
BIAS (v. t.): (1) Avarjayati (c. of vfj), M. n.; (2) prahvIkaroti (kf, c. 8.), my heart is b. ed by (your) good qualities prahvIkftaM me hfdayaM guRODEH, Ki. iii. 12.

BIAS , s. (Inclination) BAvaH, SIlaH, SIlatvaM, vAYCA, svaBAvaH, icCA, aBilAzaH, saNkalpaH, CandaM, cikIrzA, spfhA, aBiprAyaH. — (Inclination to go on one side) pArSve gasanecCA. — (Partiality) vakzapAtaH, pakzapAtitA, sAcIkftaM. — (That which biasses, or induces to act) pravarttaH -rttakaH, praRodaH, protsAhaH -hakaH, prayojakaH.

To BIAS , v. a. pravft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM), Avfj in caus. (-varjayati -yituM); sAcIkf; praRud (c. 6. -Rudati -RottuM), Akfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), cezw in caus. (cezwayati -yituM), protsah in caus. (-sAhayati -yituM), Akf in caus. (-kArayati -yituM), pakzapAtIkf.
BIASSED , p. p. pravarttitaH -tA -taM, protsAhitaH -tA -taM, praRoditaH -tA -taM, sAcIkftaH -tA -taM, AkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (In favour of a side) pakzotAhI m. (n).
BIB: (*bAlakasya) uraSCadaH.
BIB , s. bAlakasya vakzassTalaCAdanayogyaM kzOmInirmmitaM uttarIyavastraM.
Bibber, s. madyapAyin m., surApaH, madyapaH
BIBBER (subs.): (1) surApaH (pA, paM);(2) madyapaH (pA, paM): v. Drunkard.
BIBBER , s. surApI m. (n), surApaH, madyapAyI m. (n), pAnaparaH, madyapAH m.
BIBLE: *kfzwIyaDarmapustakam.
BIBLE , s. DarmmapustakaM, ISvaravAkyaprakASako granTaH.
BIBLICAL (adj.): expr. by comp., b. erudition *bAibalapARqityam.
BIBLICAL , a. DarmmapustakavizayaH -yA -yaM, DarmmapustakasambanDakaH -kA -kaM.
BIBLIOGRAPHER: pustakavidyAviSAradaH and sim. comp. s.
Bibliography, s. pustakavidyA.
BIBLIOGRAPHY: pustakavidyA; pustakAnAM mudrANkanAdi- nirRAyakaSAstram.
BIBLIOGRAPHY , s. granTavidyA, granTavidyAnusevanaM.
Bibliomania, s. durlaBapustakasaMgrahaRonmAdaH or -vyagratA.
BIBLIOMANIA: *durlaBapustakasaMgrahaRonmAdaH and sim. comp. s.
BIBLIOMANIA , s. prAcInapustakaprApaRe vyagratA, durlaBagranTAnvezaRe vyagratA.
BIBLIOMANIAC: *durlaBapustakasaMgrahaRonmAdin (f. nI) and sim. comp. s.
BIBLIOPOLIST: *pustakavikretf (f. trI): v. Book- -seller.
BIBLIOTHEKE , s. pAWArTaM surakzito granTasamUhaH, vidyAnusevanArTaM granTakuwI.
Bibulous, a. jalaSozaka.
BIBULOUS: (1) jalaSozakaH (kA, kaM);(2) jalacozakaH (kA, kaM) (?).
BIBULOUS , a. jalaSozakaH -kA -kaM, jalanipAnaSIlaH -lA -laM.
BICAPSULAR , a. vIjakoSo dvEDIkfto yasya, dviDABUtavIjakoSaH -SA -SaM.
Bicentenary, a. dviSatasAMvatsarika.
BICIPITAL , a. dvimurdDaH -rdDA -rdDaM, dviSIrzakaH -kA -kaM, dviSirAH -rAH -raH (s).
BICIPITAL , for dvimurdDaH, read dvimUrdDaH.
Bicker, v. i. kalahaM kf 8 U, vivad 1 A, vAgyudDa kf. [Bicker]ing, s. kalahaH, vivAdaH, kaliH. 2 qiMbAhavaH.
BICKER (v. i.): vi-nvadate (vad, c. l.): v. To wrangle.
To BICKER , v. n. (To skirmish) qimbAhavaM kf; kalaha (nom. kalahAyate -yituM), kalahaM kf. — (To wrangle) vivad (c. 1. -vadate -vadituM), vAgyudDaM kf. — (To quiver) sPur (c. 6. sPurati, sPuritaM).
BICKERING (subs.): (1) kalahaH;(2) vivAdaH; (3) dvandvam.
BICKERING , s. kalahaH, vipralApaH, vivAdaH, dvandvaM, vAgyudDaM. — (Petty warfare) qimbaH, qimbAhavaH.
BICKERN , s. sUcyAkArAgrayuktaH SUrmmiBAgaH, karmmakArasevitaM lohayantraM.
BICORNE , a. dviSfNgaH -NgA -NgaM, SfNgadvayaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Bicycle, s. dvicakraM vAhanaM.

Bid, v. t. A-vyA-diS 6 P, AjYA c., (jYApayati). 2 mUlyaM KyA c. (KyApayati) or udGuz 10. 3 nimaMtr 10 A; ‘b(id) welcome’ svAgataM vad 1 P, or vyAhf 1 P; ‘b(id) adieu or farewell’ AmaMtr 10 A, ApracC 6 A; ‘b(id) defiance’ Dfz 5 P, Ahve 1 A. [Bid]der, s. kretf m. [Bid]ding, s. ASA, AdeSaH, SAsanaM. 2 mUlyaKyApanaM, arGaGozaRA.

BID (v. t.): I In auction: *vadati (vad, c. l.): [Page071] I. will b. even hundred rupees for the horse *SatarUpyamudrayApyaSvaM krIRAmiti vadAmi.II To request, tell: q. v.: Ph. to b. defiance: v. To defy; to b. welcome svAgatamiti vadati; to b. adieu: v. Adieu.

To BID , v. a. (To invite) nimantr (c. 10. -mantrayati -te -yituM), Ahve (c. 1. -hvayati -hvAtuM). — (To command) AjYA in caus. (-jYApayati -yituM), prer (c. 10. prerayati -yituM), AdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), samAdiS. — (To offer a price) amukamUlyaM ditsAmIti or dAtumicCAmIti vad (c. 1. vadati, vadituM) or KyA in caus. (KyApayati -yituM) or Guz (c. 10. Gozayati -yituM) or aBiDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM). — (To bid welcome) svAgatamiti vad. — (To bid adieu) Amantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM), anumantr; ApracC (c. 6. -pfcCate -prazwuM). — (To bid defiance) Ahve, samAhve.
BIDDEN , p. p. (Commanded) AjYAtaH -tA -taM, preritaH -tA -taM, coditaH -tA -taM, deSitaH -tA -taM, AdizwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Invited) nimantritaH -tA -taM, ketitaH -tA -taM, AhUtaH -tA -taM.
BIDDER (subs.): (1) *vAdin (f. nI);(2) cikrIrzu (mfn.).
BIDDER , s. kretA m. (tf), krAyakaH, mUlyaditsuH m., prakASakrayasamaye amukamUlyaM ditsAmIti or dAsyAmIti KyApayati yo janaH.
BIDDING (subs.): *vAdaH; cikrIzAvAdaH.
BIDDING , s. (Command) AjYA, preraRaM, AdeSaH, nirddeSaH, SAsanaM. — (Offer of a price) mUlyaditsAKyApanaM, amukamUlyaM ditsAmIti KyApanaM, mUlyaditsA.
Bide, v. t. sTA 1 P, vft 1 A. v. t. pratIkz 1 A. 2 sah 1 A.

To BIDE , v. a. and n. (To remain) sTA (c. 1. tizWati -te, sTAtuM), vft (c. 1. varttate, varttituM), vas (c. 1. vasati, vastuM). — (To expect) pratIkz (c. 1. -Ikzate -IkzituM), uddfS (c. 1. -paSyati -drazwuM). — (To endure) sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), mfz (c. 4. mfzpati, marzituM).
Bidental, a. dvidat, dvirada.
BIDENTAL , a. dvidan -datI -dat (t), dvidantaH -ntI -ntaM, dviradaH -dA -daM.
Biennial, a. dvivArzika (kA f.), dvivarzIRa, dvEvarzika.
BIENNIAL (adj.): (1) dvivarzIRaH (RA, RaM);(2) dvivArzikaH (kI, kaM).
BIENNIAL , a. dvEvarzikaH -kI -kaM, dvivarzaH -rzI -rzaM, dvivarzIRaH -RA -RaM, dvi- varzamAtrasTAyI -yinI -yi (n), vatsaradvayamAtrajIvI m. (n).
Bier, s. SavayAnaM, kawaH, KAwaH-wI.
BIER (subs.): (1) SavayAnam;(2) SavavAhanam;(3) kawaH
BIER , s. SivikA, SavavAhanaM, SavayAnaM, kawaH, KawwiH m., KAwaH, vAruWaH, pretavAhanasADanaM svawvAdi.
BIESTING , s. peyUzaH -zaM, pIyUzaH -zaM, prasavAnantaraM praTamagodugDaM.
BIESTINGS (subs.): (1) pIyUza (mn.);(2) peyUza (mn.).
BIFID , BIFIDATED, a. dviKaRqIkftaH -tA -taM, dvEDIkftaH -tA -taM.
Bifold, a. dviguRa, dvEDa (DI f.).
BIFOLD , a. dviguRaH -RA -RaM, dvEDaH -DI -DaM, dviHprakAraH -rA -raM.
Biformed, a. dvirUpa.
BIFORMED , a. dvirUpaH -pA -pI -paM, dvimUrttimAn -matI -mat (t).
Bifurcate, v. t. dviDA kf 8 U, viBid 7 P or c. [Bifurcat]ed, a. dvyagra. 2 viSlezita, dviDA kfta.
BIFURCATED , s. dvyagraH -grA -graM, agradvayaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.

sanskrit.slp1: nadI dUyoH pravAhayoH praviBaktA tasya samIpe
sanskrit.word: नदी दूयोः प्रवाहयोः प्रविभक्ता तस्य समीपे
sanskrit.iast: nadī dūyoḥ pravāhayoḥ pravibhaktā tasya samīpe

details.body: BIFURCATION: Ph. near the b. of the river yatra nadI dUyoH pravAhayoH praviBaktA tasya samIpe.

Big, a. mahAkAya, bfhatkAya (of animate creatures); mahApramARa, atipramARa, sTUla, vipula, bfhat, pfTu (TuH, TvI f.). 2 Pregnant, q. v. 3 saMkula, pUrRa, saMkIrRa; AkIrRa; ‘as b(ig) as’ parimARa, parimita, mAtra, in comp. bilvamAtra ‘b(ig) as Bilwa’. [Big]ness, s. sTUlatA, vEpulyaM &c. 2 parimARaM, pramARaM.

sanskrit.iast: yādṛśaṃ ḍīyamānena pakṣiṇā kriyate tādṛśaṃ darśanaṃ

details.body: BIRD'S-EYE-VIEW , s. yAdfSaM qIyamAnena pakziRA kriyate tAdfSaM darSanaM, uccEHsTAnAd avalokanaM.
BIRD'S-NEST , s. nIqaH -qaM, kulAyaH, pakziSAlA.

Birth, s. janman n., udBavaH, saMBavaH, utpatti f., jani f., utpAdanaM, prasUti f.; ‘rich from his b(irth)’ garBeSvaraH; ‘high or noble b(irth)’ kulaM, kulInatA, aBijAtatA, aBijanaH, kule janma. 2 vaMSaH, kulaM, anvayaH. 3 yoni f., mUlaM; ‘pride of b(irth)’ kulABimAnaH; ‘blind from b(irth)’ jAtyaMDa, janmAMDa, januzAMDa. [Birth]day, s. janmadivasaH-dinaM. [Birth]place, s. janmasTAnaM-BUmi f. [Birth]right, s. janmato labDoDikAraH; pEtfkaM svatvaM.

BIRTH (subs): I Coming into life:(1) janman (n.) (the best equiv.), blind from b. janmAnDaH (nDA, nDaM);(2) janyam;(3) jananam;(4) janiH; (5) udBavaH;(6) utpattiH;(7) BavaH;(8) samBavaH; (9) sUtiH; Ph. lordship from b. garBeSvaratvam, K. II Lineage, discentdescent: q. v.:(1) kulam,(2) anvayaH; Ph. proud of one's b. kulABimAnin (f. nI), Ki.; of high b. aBijanavat (f. tI), Sa iii. The act of giving birth:(1) prasavaH;(2) prajananam.IV That which is born: v. Creature.
BIRTH, TO GIVE: (1) sUte (sU, c. 2.);(2) janayati (c. of jan): v. To bring forth.

BIRTH , s. janma n. (n), jAtiH f., janiH f., jananaM, janimA m. (n), utpattiH f., udBavaH, samBavaH, BavaH, januH n. (s). — (The act of bringing forth) prasavanaM, prasavaH, utpAdanaM, prasUtiH f. — (Extraction, lineage) vaMSaH, kulaM, anvayaH, jAtiH f. — (Rise, origin) yoniH m. f., mUlaM, udBavaH. — (Rank, high birth) kulInatA, kOlInaM; ‘of good birth,’ kulInaH -nA -naM, kulakaH -kA -kaM, kOleyaH -yI -yaM, sujanmA -nmA -nma (n), mahAkulaprasUtaH -tA -taM, mahAkulaH -lA -laM; ‘pride of birth,’ kulABimAnaM; ‘blind from birth,’ janmAnDaH -nDA -nDaM, jAtyanDaH nDA -nDaM. — (To give birth to) su (c. 1. savati, c. 2. sOti, sotuM), prasu, jan in caus. (janayati -yituM), saYjan.

BIRTH , s. praBavaH; ‘former b.,’ pUrvvajanma n. (n), prAgjanma n.; ‘an- other b., past or future,’ janmAntaraM, anyajanma n.; ‘by birth,’ janmataH; ‘from b.,’ janmapraBfti, janmAraBya, janmataH; ‘sickly from b.,’ [Page853-b+ 51] janmarogI m.; ‘poor from b.,’ janmadaridraH; ‘blind from b.,’ garBAnDaH; ‘fortunate from b.,’ garBaSrImAn; ‘high birth,’ ABi- jAtyaM, aBijAtatA, ABijanaM; ‘acquired in some preceding b.,’ pUrvvajanmArjitaH -tA -taM; ‘untimely b.,’ akAlajanma n.; ‘star of one's b.,’ janmanakzatraM, janmaBaM.
BIRTH-DAY: (1) janmadinam;(2) janidivasam, Vi. vi.; and sim. comp.s.
BIRTH-PLACE: (1) janmaBUmiH;(2) janmasTAnam; and sim. comp. s.
BIRTH-RIGHT: (1) janmanaH svatvam or aDikAraH;(2) by circumlo., sold his b. for a morsel of bread *apUpaKaRqArTaM pitfsampattyAdO sarvaM svatvaM vyakrIRIta.
BIRTH-RIGHT , s. janmamUlakADikAraH, janmahetukADikAraH.
BIRTHDAY , s. janmadinotsavaH, janmadivasaH, janmatiTiH m., janmadinaM.
BIRTHPLACE , s. janmaBUmiH f., janmasTAnaM, janmadeSaH.
BIRTHRIGHT , s. jyezWatvaM, jyEzWyaM, jyezWADikAraH, jyezWaBAgaH, pEtfkaM.
Biscuit, s. apUpaH, pizwakaH, pUpaH.
BISCUIT: iyurupIyapizwakaviSezaH.
BISCUIT , s. pizwakaH, pUpaH, apUpaH, sukAndavo goDUmAdicUrRamayaH pizwakaH.
Bisect, v. t. samAMSadvayena viBaj 1 U, dviKaMqIkf 8 U, dviDA Cid 7 P.
BISECT: (1) dvEDIkaroti or dviDAkaroti (kf, c. 8.); (2) samAMSadvayena viBajati (Baj, c. l.).
To BISECT , v. a. dvEDIkf, dviBAgIkf, dviKaRqIkf, dviDA kf or Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM) or kft (c. 6. kfntati, karttituM).
BISECTED , p. p. dvEDIkftaH -tA -taM, dviKaRqIkftaH -tA -taM, dviDA CinnaH -nnA -nnaM.
BISECTION: (1) dviDAkaraRam;(2) dvEDIkaraRam;(3) samAMSadvayena viBAgaH.
BISECTION , s. dviDAkaraRaM, dvEDIkaraRaM.
Bishop, s. DarmADyakzaH. [Bishop]ric, a. DarmADikAraH.
BISHOP: *kfzwIyasampradAyezu praDAnAcAryaH.
BISHOP , s. DarmmADipatiH m., DarmmADyakzaH.
BISHOP , s. (A beverage) madyanAgaraNgarasAdinirmmitaM pAnIyaM.
BISHOPRIC: I A bishop's office: praDAnAcArya- padam.II Bishop's district *praDAnAcAryasyADikAraH; b. of London *laRqanasya praDAnAcAryasyADikAraH.
BISHOPRIC , s. DarmmADipatipadaM, DarmmADyakzADikAraH.
BISMUTH: AlohitaSuklaDAtupraBedaH.
BISMUTH , s. atidfQaH SuklavarRo videSIyaDAtupraBedaH.
Bison, s. vanavfzaBaH.
BISON: emerIkAdeSIyo mahizAkAro'raRyajantuviSezaH.
BISON , s. araRyavfzaBapraBedaH.

sanskrit.slp1: miti parigaRayanti . sa ca ekADikadivaso varzastEra
sanskrit.word: मिति परिगणयन्ति . स च एकाधिकदिवसो वर्षस्तैर
sanskrit.iast: miti parigaṇayanti . sa ca ekādhikadivaso varṣastaira

details.body: BISSEXTILE: vEzuvavatsareREkyArTaM pAScAtyapARqitAScaturTe caturTe varze PevruvArImAsamekADikadivasamUnatriMSaddivasAtmaka- miti parigaRayanti . sa ca ekADikadivaso varzastEra “visekazwAil”, “lipa iyAra” cABiDIyate.
BISSEXTILE , s. caturTaH saMvatsaro yasmin aDidivaso niveSyate.

Bit, s. KalInaH-naM, kavikA. 2 KaMqaH, lavaH, BAgaH; ‘not a b(it)’ na mamAgapi, na stokAMSenApi; gaMDaH (kriyAyAH gaMDamAtrasyApi anupraveSa iha nopapadyate S. B. 74). 3 piMqaH, grAsaH. v. t. KalInena niyaMtr 10.
BIT (subs.): I Of the bridle:(1) KalIna (mn.);(2) kavikaH or kavikA;(3) valgA.II A small piece:(1) KaRqaH;(2) grAsaH (=a mouthful). Not a b. na manAgapi.
BIT (v. t.); To b. a horse aSvasya muKe KalInaM dadAti, Mu. or KalImaM prakzipati (kzip, c. 6.), P. iv. 7.

BIT , s. (Part of a bridle) KalInaH, kavikA -kaM, valgA, muKayantraRaM, laNKanI. — (A piece) KaRqaM, BAgaH, BinnaM, BittaM, BittiH f.; ‘in bits,’ KaRqaSas, BAgaSas, KaRqaM KaRqaM. — (A mouthful, morsel) piRqaH -RqaM, grAsaH; ‘a tit bit,’ svAdvannaM, BojanaviSezaH; ‘not a bit,’ na manAgapi, na kiYcidapi, na sUkzmamapi; ‘a bit bigger,’ kiYjitsTUlataraM.
To BIT , v. a. KalIna (nom. KalInayati -yituM), aSvamuKaM KalInena yantr (c. 10. yantrayati -yituM).
BIT , s. (Morsel) lavaH, leSaH. — (Of a bridle) karziRI.
BIT , l. 5. for kiYjitsTUlataraM, read kiYcitsyUlataraM.
BIT-LOBEN , BIT-NOBEN, s. viwlavaRaM, kAlalavaRaM. See under SALT, s.
Bitch, s. SunI, kukkurI, saramA.
BITCH: I Lit.:(1) kukkurI;(2) SunI;(3) saramA.II As a term of reproach: banDakI.
BITCH , s. SunI, kukkurI, saramA, kulAkzutA. — (A name of reproach) banDakI.

Bite, v. t. daMS 1 P; ‘bit off a large piece’ daMtErmahAKaMqaM saMdazwavAn-carvitavAn; utpad 10, carv 1 P, KAd 1 P. 2 SItena pIq 10. 3 aDikzip 6 P; See Censure. 4 pIq 10, ard 1 P, 10. s. daMSaH, daMSanaM. 2 daMtapadaM, daSanAMkaH. [Bit]ing, s. daMSanaM; ‘b(iting) of conscience’ manasonutApaH. a. daMSaka. 2 pIqAkara (rI f.).

BITE (v. t.): I With teeth etc.: daSati, vi-, saM-, (danS, c. l.): Ph. one should not b. off one's nails dantErnotpAwayen (c. of paw) naKAn, M. iv. 69.; one who b. s his nails naKaKAdI, M.; to b. the lips ozWO daSati or KaRqati, vi-, (KaRq c. l.), Si. xvii. 2., or nirviBunakti (Buj, c. 7.) (poet) II To produce a keen, pungent sensation: jvalayati (c. of jval,)III To adhere to: q. v.
BITE (subs.): I The act of biting: daMSaH; poisonous b. savizo daMSaH, U.II. The wound made by biting: daMSaH.III A cheat or one who cheats q. v.

To BITE , v. a. daMS (c. 1. daSati, daMzwuM), vidaMS; ‘to bite the lips,’ daSanacCadaM or dantAn sandaMS. — (To gnaw) carv (c. 1. carvati, carvituM); ‘to bite the nails,’ naKAn KAd (c. 1. KAdati, KAdituM). — (To pain by cold) SItArttaM -rttAM -rttaM kf. — (To rail at) avakzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM). — (To vex) pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM). — (To defraud) vaYca (c. 10. vaYcayati -te -yituM).
BITE , s. daMSaH, daMSanaM, dantAGAtaH; ‘the mark of the teeth,’ daSanANkaH.
BITER , s. daMSakaH, KAditA m. (tf), daMzwA m. (zwf), vaYcakaH.
BITING , a. daMSakaH -kA -kaM, daMSeraH -rA -raM, pIqAkaraH -rA -raM.
BITTEN , p. p. dazwaH -zwA -zwaM, sandazwaH -zwA -zwaM, daMSitaH -tA -taM.

Bitter, a. kawu, tikta. 2 (Touching) marmaBid-Cid. 3 ugra, nizWura, paruza, tIkzRa, kaWora. [Bitter]ly, adv. nizwuraM, paruzaM. 2 atyaMtaM. 3 pramuktakaMWaM (‘weeping b(itterly)’). [Bitter]ness, s. kawutA, SuktatA, tIkzRatA. 2 duHKAtirekaH, ugraSokaH; ‘in b(itterness) of soul’ durmanAyamAnacitta a. samanyunA cetasA. 3 kaWoratA, paruzatA, nizWuratA. 4 mAtsaryaM, pESunyaM.

BITTER (adj.): I Of the taste: tiktaH (ktA, ktaM). II Harsh, stern:(1) kawu. (mfn.) even by the b. words of Śiśupāla kawunApi cEdyavacanena. Si. xv. 40.;(2) marmAviD (mfn.) (Lit. piercing the vital parts);(3) nizWuraH (rA, raM) (prop= cruel.), we are very b. ly reviled ati nizWuramupA- labDAH smaH, U. iv.III Painful, severe: q. v.: udvejanakaraH (rI, raM): Ph. b. cold atyantaSItam. IV Mournful, distressing, pitiable: q. v.

BITTER , a. tiktaH -ktA -ktaM, tiktasvAdaH -dA -daM, tiktarasaH -sA -saM. — (Pun- gent) kawuH -wuH -wvI -wu, tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, tigmaH -gmA -gmaM. — (Griev- ous) ugraH -grA -graM, AtyayikaH -kI -kaM. — (Cruel, severe) kaWoraH -rA -raM, nizWuraH -rA -raM, pIqAkaraH -rA -raM. — (Malicious) matsaraH -rA -raM, piSunaH -nA -naM.
BITTERGOURD , s. indravAruRikA, aruRA.
BITTERLY: I Severly, cruelly: q. v.: nizWuram. II Sorrowfully, piteously: q. v.: Ph. wept b. BfSaM or atyantaM ruroda.
BITTERLY , adv. ugraM, nizWuraM, ugratayA; ‘one who grieves bitterly,’ ugraSokaH -kA -kaM.
BITTERN: krOYcajAtIyapakziBedaH.
BITTERN , s. krOYcajAtIyaH pakziBedaH, krOYcaH, kruqaH, kalikaH.

BITTERNESS: I Of taste:(1) tiktatA;(2) tiktatvam.II Keenness of reproach, sarcasm: (1) kawutA;(2) nizWuratA.III Deep distress of mind: duHKam.IV Impious feeling: pAzaRqa- budDiH. v. Malice, hatred: q. v.: vidvezaH.

BITTERNESS , s. tiktaH, tiktatvaM, tiktarasaH. — (Pungency) kawutA, tigmatA, tIkzRatA. — (Malice) asUyA, mAtsaryyaM. — (Severity) ugratvaM -tA, ni- zWuratA, kaWoratA. — (Sorrow) SokaH, ugraSokaH, duHKaM.
Bitumen, s. SilAjatu n., giripuzpakaM, gEreyaM, girijaM, aSmajaM, arTyaM.
BITUMEN: (1) SilAjatu (n.);(2) giripuzpakam;(3) SilAdadruH.
BITUMEN , s. SilAjatu n., aSmajatukaM, SilAdadruH m., giripuzpakaM, SElaM, SElaniryyAsaH.
BITUMINOUS: SilAjatuSAlin (f. nI) (?) (=con- -taining bitumen).
BITUMINOUS , a. SilAjatumayaH -yI -yaM, SilAjatuguRaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Bivalve, a. dvikoza.
BIVALVE , a. dvikapAwaH -wA -waM, dvikozaH -zA -zaM. — (Bivalve shell) kambuH m., SambuH m., SambukaH -kA, jalaSuktiH f., paNkamaRqukaH.
BIVOUAC (v.): Ph. “determined to b. there for the night” apramattAstatrEva yAminIM yApayituM kftasaMkalpAH.
BIVOUAC , s. (A guard at night) vIrAsanaM.
Blab, v. i. rahasyaM Bid 7 P. [Blab]ber, s. rahasyaBedakaH.
BLAB, BLABBER: vAvadUkaH: v. Babbler, tell-tale.
BLAB (v. t.): Binatti (Bid, c. 7.): v. To divulge: v. Also, to babble.
To BLAB , v. n. and a. rahasyaM prakAS in caus. (-kASayati -yituM), rahasyaBedaM kf.
BLAB , BLABEER, s. rahasyaBedakaH, rahasyaprakASakaH, vAcAlaH, vAvadUkaH, jalpakaH.
BLABBER-LIPPED , a. sTUlozWaH -zWA -zWaM, lambOzWaH -zWA -zWaM.

Black, a. kfzRa, SyAma, kfzRavarRa, kAla. 2 nizpraBa, timira, asita, nIla, mecaka. 3 (fig.) niMdya, Gora, dAruRa; ‘b(lack) deed’ apayaSomalinaM karma; ‘b(lack) guard’ durvfttaH, durAcAraH, aDamaH, KalaH. s. kfzRaH, kfzRavarRaH; ‘clothed in b(lack)’ nIlavastraH. [Black]en, v. t. kfzRIkf 8 U, SyAmI-nIlIkf. 2 duz c. (dUzayati), kalaMkayati (D.); See Stain. [Black]ish, a. IzatkfzRa, AnIla. [Black]ness, s. kfzRiman m., SyAmatvaM, nIlatA, kAliman m., tamas m., timiraM. [Black]smith, s. karmakAraH, lohakAraH, ayaskAraH.

BLACK (adj.): I Of colour:(1) kfzRaH (zRA, zRaM);(2) kfzRavarRaH (rRA, rRaM);(3) SyAmaH (mA, maM) or SyAmalaH (lA, laM) (=dark blue);(4) nIlaH (lA, laM) (prop. = blue);(5) kAlaH (lA, laM);(6) mecakaH (kA, kaM);(7) malinaH (nA, naM); your heart must be very b. like your exterior bahiriva malinataraM tava mano'pi Bavizyati nUnam, Gi. viii. 7.II Fig., dismal, gloomy, calami- -tious, horrible, wicked: q. v. B. and blue: v. Livid.
BLACK (subs.): I The colour:(1) kfzRaH; (2) kfzRavarRaH.III Black dress:(1) kfzRavastram, (2) kfzRavasanam.III A black man:(1) kfzRakAyaH (yA, yaM);(2) SyAmANgaH (NgI, NgaM).

BLACK , a. kfzRaH -zRA -zRaM, SyAmaH -mA -maM, -malaH -lA -laM, kAlaH -lA -laM, kAlakaH -kA -kaM, kArzRaH -rzRI -rzRaM, asitaH -tA -taM, nIlaH -lA -laM, mecakaH -kA -kaM, DyAmaH -mA -maM. — (Dark) tamasvI -svinI -svi (n), timiraH -rA -raM, anDakArayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, nizpraBaH -BA -BaM. — (Horrible) GoraH -rA -raM, dAruRaH -RA -RaM. — (Cloudy of countenance) mlAna- vadanaH -nA -naM. — (Black with crime) kfzRakarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n). — (White and black) sitAsitaH -tA -taM.

BLACK , s. (The colour) kfzRaH, kfzRavarRaM. — (A blackamoor) kfzRa- dehaH, SyAmANgaH; ‘black clothes,’ nIlavastraM, nIlAmbaraM; ‘clothed in black,’ nIlavastraH -strA -straM, nIlAmbaraH -rA -raM, SyAmavastraH -strA -straM. — (Lamp-black) dIpakiwwaM, kajjvalaM.
To BLACK , v. a. kfzRa (nom. kfzRAyate -yituM), kfzRIkf.
BLACK , a. sitetaraH -rA -raM. BLACK-LEAD, s. mftasIsakaM.
BLACK-ART: (1) indrajAlam;(2) kArmaRam: v. Magic.
BLACK-BALL (subs.): (pratyAKyAnapradarSanI) kfzRa- guwikA.
BLACK-BALL (v. t.): pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.): v. To reject.
BLACK-BERRY: PalaviSezaH. In India, some- -times applied to jambu (n.)
BLACK-BIRD: pakziBedaH. In India, the term is applied to kokilaH. (=Cuckoo).
BLACK-CATTLE: mAMsArTaM pAlitA gAvaH.
BLACK-LEAD: lohaBedaH; *aNgAralohaH.
BLACK-MOUTHED , a. durmuKaH -KI -KaM, muKaraH -rA -raM, vAgduzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
BLACK-WOOD-TREE , s. SiMSapA. BLACKSMITH, s. DamakaH.
BLACKAMOOR , s. SyAmANgaH, SyAmadehaH, kfzRadehaH, kfzRANgaH.
BLACKBEETLE , s. BramaraH, BfNgaH, aliH m.
BLACKBERRY , s. kfzRavarRaM kaRwakagulmaPalaM, SfgAlakaRwakaPalaM.
BLACKBIRD , s. kfzRavarRo maDurarAvaviSizwaH pakzipraBedaH.
BLACKEN: I To make black:(1) kAlIkaroti, b. s his face muKaM kAlIkaroti, Na. iii.;(2) kfzRIkaroti (rare);(3) SyAmIkaroti (=to make dark blue).II To darken: q. v.III To sully: q. v.
To BLACKEN , v. a. kfzRIkf, kfzRa (nom. kfzRAyate -yituM), SyAma (nom. SyAmayati -yituM), SyAmIkf. — (To darken) timira (nom. timira- yati -yituM).
To BLACKEN , v. n. SyAma (nom. SyAmAyate), nIla (nom. nIlAyate).
BLACKENED , p. p. kfzRIkftaH -tA -taM, SyAmitaH -tA -taM, kfzRIBUtaH -tA -taM, tamovftaH -tA -taM, tamoBUtaH -tA -taM, santamasaH -sA -saM.
BLACKEYED , a. asitanayanaH -nI -naM, kfzRanayanaH -nI -naM, nIlAkzaH -kzI -kzaM.
BLACKGUARD: (1) durvfttaH (ttA, ttaM);(2) durAcAraH (rA, raM): v. Rake.
BLACKGUARD , s. aDamAcAraH, durvfttaH, durAcAraH, kfzRakarmmA m. (n), duzwaH.
BLACKING (subs.): kAlI (?).
BLACKING , s. pAdukAYjanaM, masiH f. -sI, kAlI.
BLACKISH: (1) IzatkfzRaH (zRA, zRaM). IzatkAlaH (lA, laM).
BLACKISH , a. IzatkfzRaH -zRA -zRaM, IzatkAlaH -lA -laM, AkAlaH -lA -laM.

sanskrit.slp1: sIsakapraBedo yena tUlikAyAM niveSitena kfzRareKA kriyate
sanskrit.word: सीसकप्रभेदो येन तूलिकायां निवेशितेन कृष्णरेखा क्रियते
sanskrit.iast: sīsakaprabhedo yena tūlikāyāṃ niveśitena kṛṣṇarekhā kriyate

details.body: BLACKLEAD , s. sIsakapraBedo yena tUlikAyAM niveSitena kfzRareKA kriyate.
BLACKLY , adv. kfzRarvaRena, kfzRaM, dAruRaM, atiduzwatayA.
BLACKNESS: (1) kAliman (m.);(2) kfzRatvam; (3) kfzRiman (m.): v. Also, darkness.

BLACKNESS , s. kfzRatA -tvaM, kfzRimA m. (n), kAlimA m. (n), SyAmatvaM, nIlimA m. (n). — (Darkness) tamaH n. (s), tamisraM, timiraM, anDa- kAraH. — (Horribleness) GoratA, dAruRatA. — (Atrocity) atiduzwatA.
BLACKPUDDING , s. aDunAtanajanaKAditam asfgDAnyAdipUritaM SUkarapurItat.
BLACKSMITH: (1) karmakAraH;(2) karmAraH;(3) lohakAraH.
BLACKSMITH , s. lohakAraH, DmAkAraH, karmmakAraH, ayaskAraH, karmmAraH, vyokAraH.
Bladder, s. mUtrASayaH, basti m., f.
BLADDER: (1) kloman (m.);(2) mUtrASayaH;(3) tilakam (rare).
BLADDER , s. vastiH m. f. mUtrASayaH, tilakaM, kloma n. (n), klomaM.
Blade, s. (Of a sword) GArA, patraM, PalaM. 2 (Of grass) dalaM, kAMqaM, aMkuraH. 3 skaMDAsTi n.
BLADE: I The cutting part of a knife etc.; DArA.II Of grass:(1) dala (mn.);(2) kARqam (?).III A rake: q. v.

BLADE , s. (The sharp part of a weapon) PalaM, patraM, PalakaH -kaM, DArA, paraYjaH, puzkaraM; ‘the blade of a sword,’ asipatraM. — (Spire of grass) kARqaM, dalaH -laM, aNkuraH, tfRadalaM, tfRakARqaM, kisalaH, kuSaH. — (Of the shoulder) aMSaH, skanDAsTi n., BujaSiraH n. (s).
BLADED , a. kARqavAn -vatI -vat (t), maYjaritaH -tA -taM, dalavAn -vatI -vat (t).
Blain, s. sPowaH, vraRaH-RaM.
BLAIN , s. visPowaH, sPowaH, sPowakaH, vraRaM, vawI, varawI.

BLAMABLE , a. nindanIyaH -yA -yaM, nindyaH -ndyA -ndyaM, nindArhaH -rhA -rhaM, dozI -ziRI -zi (n), aparADI -DinI -Di (n), aparAdDaH -dDA -dDaM, sAparADaH -DA -DaM, garhitaH -tA -taM, dUzyaH -zyA -zyaM, garhyaH -rhyA -rhyaM, vAcyaH -cyA -cyaM.
BLAMABLE or BLAMEABLE: (1) nindanIyaH (yA, yaM);(2) nindyaH (ndyA, ndyaM);(3) nindArhaH (rhA, rhaM): v. Faulty, culpable.
BLAMABLENESS or BLAMEABLENESS: nindyatAH v. Culpability.
BLAMABLENESS , s. nindyatA, nindArhatvaM, aparADitA -tvaM, dozitvaM.
BLAMABLY , adv. sAparADaM, aparADena, nindyaprakAreRa, yaTA dozo jAyate taTA.

Blame, v. t. niMd 1 P, garh 1, 10 A, upAlaB 1 A; dozaM kzip 6 P, or Aruh c. (ropayati), See Censure, ‘I am not to b(lame)’ nAhamaparADI, na mamAyaM dozaH. s. dozaH, aparADaH. 2 garhA, AkzepaH, upAlaMBaH, niMdA, jugupsA; ‘lays the b(lame) on another’ anyasmindozaM kzipati. [Blam]able, a. niMdya, niMdanIya, garhaRIya, garhya, vAcyaH ‘he is not b(lamable) or to blame’ sa na dozAspadaM-dozapAtraM. [Blam]er, s. niMdakaH, parivAdakaH, aDikzepakaH. [Blame]less, a. aniMdya, nirdoza, nizkalaMka, viSudDa (pure). [Blame]lessness, s. aniMdyatA, anavadyatA (aho anavadyatA rUpasya M. 2), avAcyatA, dozABAvaH.

BLAME (subs.): I Censure, reprehension: q. v.: nindA.II Fault, crime dozaH, he lays the b. on another's shoulders anyasmin or anyasya skanDe sa dozaM nyasyati (as, c. 4.). Without b. = blameless: q. v.
BLAME (v. t.): nindati, vi-, (nind, c. l.): v. To censure.

To BLAME , v. a. (To lay the blame) dozam Aruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), dozIkf. — (To censure) nind (c. 1. nindati, nindituM), praRind, pratinind, vinind; tiraskf; kuts (c. 10. kutsayati -te -yituM), gup in des. (jugupsate -psituM), upAlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), garh (c. 1. garhate, garhituM,) c. 10. garhayate -yituM), vigarh, parigarh; ‘he casts the blame on him,’ tasmin dozaM kzipati.

BLAME , s. (Censure) nindA, parIvAdaH, apavAdaH, AkzepaH, GfRA, tira- skAraH, garhA, pariBAzaRaM, jugupsA, kalaNkaH, kutsA, nirvAdaH, avarRaH, upAlamBaH, upakroSaH. — (Fault) dozaH, aparADaH, vacanIyatA, vAcyatA — (Imputation of a fault) dozAropaH; ‘I am not to blame,’ nAham aparAdDaH, or sAparADaH, or nindArhaH.
BLAMED , p. p. ninditaH -tA -taM, jugupsitaH -tA -taM, garhitaH -tA -taM, tira- skftaH -tA -taM, DikkftaH -tA -taM, upAlabDaH -bDA -bDaM, avarIRaH -RA -RaM.
BLAMELESS: (1) anindyaH (ndyA, ndyaM);(2) anindanIyaH (yA, yaM);(3) nirdozaH (zA, zaM) (=faultless: q. v.);(4) nizkalaNkaH (NkA, NkaM) (=spotless: q. v.);(5) viSudDaH (dDA, dDaM) (pure: q. v.).
BLAMELESS , a. nirdozaH -zA -zaM, niraparADaH -DA -DaM, anindyaH -ndyA -ndyaM, aninditaH -tA -taM, anenAH -nAH -naH (s), avigarhitaH -tA -taM, anaGaH -GA -GaM.
BLAMELESSLY , adv. aparADaM vinA, dozavyatirekeRa, niraparADaM, anaDaM, anindyaprakAreRa.
BLAMELESSNESS: (1) anindyatA;(2) nirdozatA (=faultlessness);(3) viSudDatA (= purity).
BLAMELESSNESS , s. anindyatA, nirdozatA, niraparADatA, SudDatvaM.
BLAMER: nindakaH: v. Censurer.
BLAMER , s. nindakaH, dozAropakaH, parivAdakaH, nindAkarttA m. (rttf), kalaNkakaraH.
BLAMEWORTHY: (1) nindArhaH (rhA, rhaM);(2) nindanIyaH (yA, yaM): v. Censurable.
BLAMEWORTHY , a. nindArhaH -rhA -rhaM, nindanIyaH -yA -yaM.
Blanch, v. t. SuklIkf 8 U, DavalIkf. 2 nistuzayati (D.), tvacaM nizkfz or apanI 1 P 3 Avoid, q. v.
BLANCH (v.); I To whiten: q. v.: Davalayati (nomi.).II To peel: q. v. tvacayati (nomi.).

To BLANCH , v. a. (To whiten) SuklIkf, DavalIkf. — (To peel such things as have husks) nistuza (nom. -tuzayati -yituM), tuzIkf, tvac (nom. tvacayati -yituM), tvacaM nizkfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), tvak- paripuwanaM kf.

Bland, a. mfdu, komala, masfRa, sOmya, SlakzRa; ‘b(land) in speech’ priyaMvada. [Bland]ish, v. i. SAM(sAM)tv 10, cAwUktiBiH tuz c., anunI 1 P, upacCaMd 10. [Bland]ishment, s. vilAsaH, viBramaH. 2 priyavAkyaM, cAwUkti f., maDuraBAzitaM, upacCaMdanaM, anunayaH.
BLAND: mfdu (dvI, du): Mild, gentle.
BLAND , a. mfduH -dvI -du, snigDaH -gDA -gDaM, masfRaH -RA -RaM, meduraH -rA -raM, cikkaRaH -RA -RaM, komalaH -lA -laM, somAlaH -lA -laM. — (In speech) priyamvadaH -dA -daM.
BLANDATION , s. cAwUktiH f., cAwukAraH, komalatvaM.
To BLANDISH , v. a. (To caress, flatter) SAntv or mAntv (c. 10. sAntvayati -yituM), aBiSAntv, pariSAntv, priyaM vad (c. 1. vadati, vadituM)
BLANDISHMENT: I Of love:(1) hAvaH;(2) vilAsaH;(3) viBramaH. N. B. Applied only to women.II Sweet words:(1) priyavAkyam; (2) maDuraBAzitam.
BLANDISHMENT , s. (Gesture of love) lalitaM, hAvaH, vilAsaH, viBramaH — (Soft words) priyavAkyaM, cAwUktiH f., cAwuH m.

Blank, a. SuBra, Sukla; ‘b(lank) with fear’ BayavivarRaH-vivarRAnanaH. 2 SUnya, rikta, leKArahita. 3 ekAMta, atyaMta; ‘b(lank) despair’ ekAMtato nErASyaM. 4 anuprAsa-yamaka-hIna (verse). s. leKASUnyaM patraM. 2 SUnyatA; riktaM, SUnyaM.

BLANK (adj.): I Not filled or written on: SudDaH (dDA, dDaM) (?).II White pale or dis- -mayed: q. v.: Ph. b. verse: amitrAkzaraCandaH; b. cartridge *kevalacUrRakozaH; b. endorsement leKaka. -nAmavirahitaM huRqyAdO pfzWaliKanam.
BLANK (subs.): I A void space: Ph. don't leave so much b. etAvadaliKitaM or SudDaM (?) mA rakzIH:II A b. ticket *SudDanidarSanI.III A b. ballot *SudDaguwikA.

BLANK , a. (Empty, not written upon) SUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, riktaH -ktA -ktaM, leKASUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, aliKitaH -tA -taM. — (White) SuklaH -klA -klaM. — (Pale, depressed) pARquH -RquH -Rqu, vivarRavadanaH -nA -naM, mlAnavadanaH -nA -naM, vizaRRaH -RRA -RRaM. — (Confused) vismitaH -tA -taM, vilakzaH -kzA -kzaM, AkulaH -lA -laM. — (Without rhyme) anuprAsahInaH -nA -naM, amitrAkzaraH -rA -raM, yamakahInaH -nA -naM, CandorahitaH -tA -taM.
BLANK , s. (A void space) SUnyaM, riktaM, SUnyatvaM -tA, riktatA, SUnyasTAnaM. — (A paper without writing) leKASUnyaM patraM, — (In a lottery) mANgalyarahitA or lABarahitA guwikA, dOrBAgyaM.
To BLANK , v. a. SUnyIkf, mlAnIkf, AkulIkf, vismayAkulaM -lAM -laM kf.
Blanket, s. kaMbalaH, UrRAyuH, rallakaH.
BLANKET: (1) kambalaH;(2) rallakaH;(3) UrRAyuH.
BLANKET , s. kambalaH, rallakaH, UrRAyuH m., sahasraroma n. (n), mezakambalaH, sASUkaH, kutapaH. — (Covered with a blanket) kAmbalaH -lI -laM, kambalAcCAditaH -tA -taM.
To BLANKET , v. a. kambalena AcCad (c. 10. -CAdayati -yituM).
Blare, v. i. uccEH nad. s. uccanAdaH, udGozaH.
Blaspheme, v. t. ISvaraM niMd 1 P or avaman 4 A, or aBiSap 1 U. [Blasphem]ous, a. ISvaraniMdaka, pAzaMqIya. [Blasphem]y, s. pAzaMqatA, ISvaraniMdA.
BLASPHEME: nindati (nind, c. l.): v. To revile.

To BLASPHEME , v. a. parameSvaraM nind (c. 1. nindati, nindituM) or avaman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM) or aBiSap (c. 1. -Sapati -SaptuM) or AkruS (c. 1. -kroSati -krozwuM), ISvaranindAM kf, pAzaRqIyakaTAM kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM).
BLASPHEMER: (1) ISvaranindakaH;(2) pAzaRqaH (=heretic).
BLASPHEMER , s. ISvaranindakaH, ISvarABiSApakaH, ISvarAvamAnakft, pAzaRqaH, garhyavAdI m. (n).
BLASPHEMOUS: (1) ISvaranindakaH (kA, kaM);(2) comp. with pAzaRqa-.
BLASPHEMOUS , a. ISvaranindakaH -kA -kaM, ISvarAvamAnakaraH -rI -raM, pAza- -RqIyaH -yA -yaM.
BLASPHEMOUSLY: (1) aBavatyA (=irreligiously); (2) avajYayA (=contemptuously).
BLASPHEMOUSLY , adv. ISvaranindApUrvvakaM, ISvaranindAkrameRa, pAzaRqavat.
BLASPHEMY: (1) ISvaranindA;(2) pAzaRqatA (=heresy).
BLASPHEMY , s. ISvaranindA, ISvarAvamAnaM, ISvarABiSApaH, devanindA, pAzaRqatA.

Blast, s. vAtyA, vAtaH, vAyuvegaH, praBaMjanaH, javAnilaH. 2 DmAnaM (of horns). 3 vinASaH, kzayaH, apAyaH. v. t. vinaS c., vihan 2 P, mlAnIkf 8 U, viSF c., kzE c. (kzapayati); ‘b(last)ed by lightning’ aSani-vidyut-hata [Blast]er, s. vinASakaH.
BLAST (subs.): I A gust of wind:(1) vAtyA; (2) javAnilaH: v. Gale.II The blowing of a wind instrument: v. Blowing.III A blight: q. v.
BLAST (v. t.): I To blight: q. v.II To destroy, frustrate: q. v. unmUlayati (mUl, c. 10.). III To rend open by explosion; vidArayati (c. of da) (?).
BLAST , s. (A gust of wind) vAtaH, vAyuvegaH, vAyugulmaH, vAtarUzaH, nirGAtaH, praBaYjanaH, vyomamudgaraH. — (Puff) SvAsaH. — (Of a horn) SaNKaDmAnaM. — (Blight) vinASaH, vyAGAtaH, kzayaH.

To BLAST , v. a. (To ruin, destroy) vinaS in caus. (-nASayati yituM), kzi in caus. (kzayayati -yituM), vihan (c. 2. -hanti -hantuM). — (To make to wither) mf in caus. (mArayati -yituM), mlAnIkf, viSF in caus. (-SArayati -yituM).
BLASTED , p. p. vinASitaH -tA -taM, mAritaH -tA -taM, parimlAnaH -nA -naM, viSIrRaH -rRA -rRaM. — (By lightning) vidyudDataH -tA -taM.
BLASTER , s. vinASakaH, mArakaH, nASayitA m. (tf), viGAtI m. (n), viSAraRakft.

Blaze, v. i. jval 1 P, pra-ut-°, dIp 4 A, saM-ut-pra-°; ‘b(laz)ing’ ujjvala, pradIpta, dedIpyamAna, BAsvara, See Bright, ‘b(laze) abroad’ prakAS c., praKyA c. (KyApayati). s. praBA, arcis f., n., dIpti f., jvAlA; ‘b(laze) of light’ raSmi-aMSu-jAlaM.
BLAZE (subs.): I Lit.:(1) praBA;(2) arcisa (m.): v. Flame, light.II Fig.: Ph.: “b. of fame” yaSaHpraBA.

BLAZE (v. i.): (1) (jvalati, pra-, sampra-, (jval, c. l.), b. ing powers jvalatpratApAvaliH; N. i. 2.;(2) dIpyate, pra-, saM-, (dIp, c. 4.) the Raghu-chief b. ed with rage kudDo'dIpi raGuvyAGraH, B. vi. 32.: v. To kindle.
BLAZE , s. jvAlaH -lA, jvalaH, jvalakA, jvAlAgniH m., ulkA; ‘a blaze of light,’ raSmijAlaM, aMSujAlaM. — (Publication) prakASanaM, prakawI- karaRaM, pracAraRaM.
To BLAZE , v. n. jval (c. 1. jvalati, jvalituM), prajval, samprajval, or in freq. (jAjvalyate), dIp (c. 4. dIpyate, dIpituM), AdIp, pradIp or in freq. (dedIpyate).
To BLAZE ABROAD , v. a. prakAS in caus. (-kASayati -yituM), vikAS, pracar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM), viDuz (c. 10. -Gozayati -yituM), viKyA in caus. (-KyApayati -yituM), prakawIkf.
BLAZING , a. jvAlI -linI -li (n), jvAlaH -lI -laM, jvAlan -lantI -lat (t), ujjvalaH -lA -laM, jAjvalyamAnaH -nA -naM, jvalitaH -tA -taM, prajvalitaH -tA -taM, ucCiKaH -KA -KaM, pradIptaH -ptA -ptaM.
BLAZING , l. 1. for jvAlan, read jvalan.
Blazon, v. t. BUz 10, alaMkf 8 U. 2 praKyA c. (KyApayati), prakAS c., udGuz 10.
BLAZON (v. t.): I To display: q. v.: praTayati (c. of praT).III To deck, embellish: q. v.: maRqayatiIII To explain coat of arms vyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.).
BLAZON, BLAZONRY (subs.): I A coat of [Page075] arms: q. v.II Publication, display: q. v.: AqamBaraH (?).

To BLAZON , v. a. (To draw coats of arms) kulInapadacihnAni liK (c. 6. liKati, leKituM). — (To explain coats of arms) citraga- tAni kulInapadacihnAni vyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -KyAtuM). — (To deck) BUz (c. 10. BUzayati -yituM), pariBUz, parizkf. — (To celebrate) praKyA, viKyA. — (To display, publish) prakAS in caus. (-kASayati -yituM), [Page053-b+ 51] pracar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM).
Bleach, v. t. nirRij 3 U, DAv 1 P, 10, DavalI-kf 8 U. [Bleach]ed, a. DOta, nirRikta. [Bleach]er, s. DAvakaH, vastranirRejakaH.
BLEACH: I To whiten: q. v.: Davalayati (nomi.) II To make pale: vivarRayati (nomi.).
To BLEACH , v. a. DAv (c. 1. DAvati, DAvituM, c. 10. DAvayati -yituM), vastrARi vAyuvyApyAni kftvA SuklIkf or DavalIkf or nirRij (c. 3. -nenekti -nektuM).
To BLEACH , v. n. vAyuvyApakatvAd DavalIBU or SuklIBU.

BLEACHED , p. p. DOtaH -tA -taM, DavalitaH -tA -taM, SuklIkftaH -tA -taM, DavalIkftaH -tA -taM, DavalIBUtaH -tA -taM, vItarAgaH -gA -gaM; ‘bleached silk,’ DOtakOSeyaM, patrorRaM; ‘a pair of bleached clothes,’ udgamanIyaM.
BLEACHER , s. DAvakaH, vastraDAvakaH, vastranirRejakaH.
BLEACHING-POWDER: *viraYjakacUrRam.
Bleak, a. atiSIta (winter); SiSira, hEmaMta (tI f.), himaSIta. 2 (fig.) nirAnaMda, asuBaga.
BLEAK (adj.): I Bold, frigid: q. v.: atiSItaH (tA, taM).II Exposed to cold: expr. by circum.: these wastes are so b. *ezu KilapradeSezu himasyedfk prAdurBAvaH.
BLEAK (subs.): nAdeyaH SuklavarRaH kzudramatsyaBedaH.

BLEAK , a. (Cold) SItalaH -lA -laM, SiSiraH -rA -raM, himaH -mA -maM, hEmantaH -ntI -ntaM, -ntikaH -kI -kaM, himaSItalaH -lA -laM. — (Exposed to the weather) aBrAvakASikaH -kI -kaM, SItAvakASikaH -kI -kaM. — (Cheerless) nirAnandaH -ndA -ndaM.
BLEAKNESS: I Exposure to the wind: by circum.: v. Bleak (II).II Coldness: q. v.: SItatA.
BLEAKNESS , s. SItatA, SItalatA, SEtyaM, himatA, SItAvakASikatvaM.
To BLEAR , v. a. cullIkf, timira (nom. timirayati -yituM).
BLEAR-EYED: (1) klinnAkzaH (kzI, kzaM);(2) cullaH or cillaH (llA, llaM);(3) pillaH, (llA, llaM).
BLEAR-EYED , a. klinnAkzaH -kzA -kzaM, cullaH -llI -llaM, cillaH -llA -llaM, pillaH -llI -llaM.
BLEAREDNESS: (1) klinnAkzatA;(2) cullatA.
BLEAREDNESS , s. (Having blear eyes) cullatvaM, pillatvaM, klinnAkzatA.
Blear-eyed, a. klinnAkza, culla, cilla, pilla; ‘b(lear) eye’ cullaH &c.
Bleat, v. i. reB 1 A, meMmeM SabdaM kf 8 U, u 1 A. [Bleat]ing, s. reBaRaM, mezarutaM, uraBranAdaH.
BLEAT (v. i.): reBate (reB, c. l): v. To make noise.
BLEAT, BLEATING (subs.): (1) rAvaH or remaRam: v. Noise.(2) mezarutam (the cry of a sheep).
To BLEAT , v. n. u (c. 1. avate, otuM), mezarutaM kf, avivat SabdaM kf.
BLEATING , s. mezarutaM, mezarAvaH, mezaSabdaH, uraBranAdaH.

Bleed, v. t. raktaM-ruDiraM &c. (blood) muc c. or sru c. or mokz 10, with gen. of person or part. bled; ‘they b(leed) the wound’ kzate raktamokzaRaM kurvaMti. v. i. raktaM-ruDiraM-sru 1 P, or muc 6 P, or pravah 1 P; ‘his hand b(leed)s’ tasya hastAdruDiraM stravati; ‘b(leed)ing profusely’ ruDiraprAgBAranisyaMdin (Mal. 5); ‘to b(leed) for oneʼs country’ svadeSArTa jIvitaM tyaj 1 P. [Bleed]er, raktasrAvakaH-mocakaH. [Bleed]ing, s. raktasrAvaH, raktamokzaRaM, raktasruti f., ruDirakzaraRaM.

BLEED (v. t.): raktaM or ruDiraM or SORitaM srAvayati, vi-, A-, pari-, (c. of stra); or mokzayati (mukz, c. 10); or mocayati (c. of muc) or avasecayati (c. of sic). N. B. These verbs are cons. with gen. of the person who is bled.

BLEED (v. i.): raktaM or ruDiraM or SoRitaM sravati (sru, c. l); or cyavate (cyu, c. l), Ki.; or kzarati (kzar, c. l). M. n.; or gacCati (gam, c. l) (rare), when it stops itself after sufficient b. ing samyag gatvA yadA raktaM svayamevAvatizWate, Śr.; or pravartate (vft, c. l) (rare), if it does not b. apra- vartamAne rakte. N. B. These verbs are cons. with gen. of the person and abl. of the part which b. s: his hand b. s tasya hastAt SoRitaM sravati.
To BLEED , v. n. raktaM or SoRitaM sru (c. 1. sravati, srotuM), prasru or muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), pramuc; ‘the wound bleeds,’ kzataM SoRitaM sravati.
To BLEED , v. a. raktaM or SoRitaM sru in caus. (srAvayati -yituM) or muc in caus. (mocayati -yituM) or mokz (c. 10. mokzayati -yituM) or avasic (c. 6. -siYcati -sektuM).
BLEEDER , s. raktasrAvakaH, asfkSrAvI m. (n), raktamocakaH, sirAvyaDanakft, raktAvasecakaH.
BLEEDING (subs.): I Letting of blood;(1) raktasrAvaH, -RaM;(2) raktamokzaRam;(3) raktAvasecanam, etc.II Flowing of blood:(1) raktasru tiH; (2) raktacyutiH;(3) raktakzaraRam etc.
BLEEDING , s. (Venesection) raktaSrAvaH, asfkSrAvaH, raktamokzaRaM, asf- gvimokzaRaM, sirAmokzaH, sirAvyaDaH, raktAvasecanaM.
Blemish, s. dozaH, kalaMkaH, CidraM; ‘un-b(lemish)ed’ nizkalaMka, nirdoza. 2 apayaSas m., akIrti f. v. t. malinayati (D.), kalaMkayati (D.), duz c. (dUzayati).
BLEMISH (v. t.): (1) malinayati (nomi.);(2) dUzayati (c. of duz): v. To stain.
BLEMISH (subs.): dozaH: v. Stain, defect, fault.
To BLEMISH , v. a. malina (nom. malinayati -yituM), kalaNka (nom. kala- Nkayati -yituM), duz in caus. (dUzayati -yituM), apayaSaH kf, sadozaM -zAM -zaM kf.

God b. you ISaste kalyARaM or SuBaM vitaratu.II To glorify or praise: q. v.: Ph. b. the Lord, b. his holy name *ISo gIyatAM, tasya pavitraM nAma gIyatAm.III To consecrate: q. v.IV To favour, endow liberally: q. v.

[Blood]-shot, a. raktapUrRa, SoRitApluta. [Blood]-thirsty, a. ruDirapriya; jiGAMsu, vaDodyata. [Blood]-vessel, s. raktavAhinI, nAqI, SirA, asfgvahA, DamanI. [Blood]y, a. raktamaya (yI f.), raktAkta. 2 krUra, mArAtmaka, nfSaMsa; ‘a b(loody) battle it was’ tasmin yudDe mahAraktasrAvo'BUt.

BLOOD: I Lit.:(1) raktam;(2) ruDiram;(3) SoRitam;(4) asfj (n.);(5) asram;(6) kzatajam (rare), the cascade of fresh b; pratyagrakzatajaBarI, Vi. vii.(7) kIlAlam (rare), quenched by b. flowing saratkIlAlanirvApita, Vi. iii. Ph.: to lose b. raktaM muYcati (Buc, c. 6.); to take one's b. hanti (han, c. 2.) v. To murder.II Kindred, line- -age: q. v.: Ph. related by b. sanABi (mfn.); of whole b. sodaraH (rA, raM); half-b. q. v.III Blood- -shed: q. v.IV Temper of mind, passion: Ph. their b. was up for revenge *pratIkArArTaM tezAM kroDAgniruddidIpe; do not rouse my b. mA mAM prakopaya; murdered the child in cold b. *SAnto bAlaM jaGAna.
BLOOD (v. t.): I To bleed: q. v.II To stain with blood: ruDireRa limpati (v. To. annoint) or kaluzayati (v. To stain): Ph. b. ed scimi- tars KaNgAH SoRitasandigDAH, Ku.

BLOOD , s. asfk n. (j), lohitaM, raktaM, ruDiraM, SoRitaM, kzatajaM, asraM; ‘to lose blood, raktaMmuc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM); ‘to flow with blood,’ raktaM sru (c. 1. sravati, srotuM). — (Kindred, lineage) kulaM, vaMSaH, santAnaH, gotraM, gozWI; ‘of whole blood,’ sodaraH, sahodaraH, sodaryyaH, samA- nodaryyaH, sagarBaH, sanABiH m., ekaSarIraH; ‘of half blood,’ BinnodaraH. — (Murder) baDaH, nfhatyA, GAtanaM, mAraRaM.

To BLOOD , v. a. (To stain with blood) asfjA or SoRitena lip (c. 6. limpati, leptuM), anulip or aYj (c. 7. anakti, aMktuM) or malina (nom. malinayati -yituM). — (To let blood) raktaM or SoRitaM sru in caus. (srAvayati -yituM) or muc in caus. (mocayati -yituM).
BLOOD-BESPOTTED , a. raktamalinaH -nA -naM, SoRitokzitaH -tA -taM.
BLOOD-DRINKING , a. raktapaH -pA -paM, raktapAyI -yinI -yi (n) or ruDi- rapAyI, SoRitapaH -pA -paM, asfkpaH -kpA.
BLOOD-HOUND: kukkuraBedaH: v. Hound.
BLOOD-RED: raktaH (ktA, ktaM): v. Red.
BLOOD-SHED: raktapAtaH: v. Slaughter.
BLOOD-SHOT: (1) atiraktaH (ktA, ktaM) (=very red);(2) raktABizyandin (f. nI) (?).
BLOOD-STAINED: (1) raktAktaH (ktA, ktaM);(2) ruDira- saMliptaH (ptA, ptaM);(3) SoRitasandigDaH (gDA, gDaM); (4) asradigDaH (gDA, gDaM), R.; and sim. comp.
BLOOD-STAINED , a. asfgliptaH -ptA -ptaM, SoRitAktaH -ktA -ktaM, raktAktaH -ktA -ktaM, SoRitokzitaH -tA -taM, raktamalinaH -nA -naM.
BLOOD-SUCKER: (1) raktapAyin (f. nI);(2) asrapaH (pA, paM).
BLOOD-THIRSTY: (1) ruDirapriyaH (yA, yaM);(2) jiGAMsu (mfn.): v. Sanguinary, murderous.
BLOOD-VESSEL raktavAhinI or asfgvahA nAqI.

sanskrit.slp1: atikrUro mfgavyakukkuraBedaH sa ca GrARabalena mfgasTAnaM nayati
sanskrit.word: अतिक्रूरो मृगव्यकुक्कुरभेदः स च घ्राणबलेन मृगस्थानं नयति
sanskrit.iast: atikrūro mṛgavyakukkurabhedaḥ sa ca ghrāṇabalena mṛgasthānaṃ nayati

details.body: BLOODHOUND , s. atikrUro mfgavyakukkuraBedaH sa ca GrARabalena mfgasTAnaM nayati.
BLOODILY , adv. niDAsiyA, krUraM, nizWuraM, nEzWuryyeRa, nirddayaM.
BLOODINESS: jiGAMsA: v. Cruelty.
BLOODINESS , s. rastaparRatA. — (Disposition to kill) jiGAMsA.

BLOODLESS: I Without blood:(1) raktahInaH (nA, naM) (?);(2) gatAsu (mfn.) (=dead).II Without shedding of blood: raktapAtaM vinA Ph. by which the discharger obtains a b. victory yataH prayokturna cArihiMsA vijayaSca haste, R. v. 53.
BLOODLESS , a. nIraktAH ktA -ktaM, raktahInaH -nA -naM, niHSoRitaH -tA -taM.
BLOODLETTER , s. ktasrAnnakaH, asfkSrAvI m. (n), raktamocakaH, sirAveDakaH.
BLOODSHED , s. raktapAtaH, asfkpAtaH, baDaH, nfhatyA, ripuhatyA.
BLOODSHEDDER , s. raktapAtakaH, jiGAMsuH m., GAtakaH, hantA m. (ntf) or nihantA, baDodyataH.
BLOODSHOT , a. raktapUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, SoRitAplutaH -tA -taM. — (Redness of the vessels of the eye) raktABizyandaH; ‘having bloodshot eyes,’ raktekzaRaH -RA -RaM.
BLOODSUCKER , s. SoRitapaH, raktapAyI m. (n) or ruDirapAyI, asfkpaH. — (A leech) jalOkA, raktapA f., jalOkAH m. (s).
BLOODTHIRSTY , a. raktapipAsuH -suH -su, SoRitapriyaH -yA -yaM, jiGAMsuH -suH -su, krUraH -rA -raM, baDodyataH -tA -taM.
BLOODVESSEL , s. asfgvahA f., nAqiH f., raktapravAhakanAqiH f., SirA, rakta- vAhI m. (n).

BLOODY: I Blood-stained: q. v.II Sangui- -nary, murderous: q. v.III Attended with blood-shed: Ph. it was a b. battle asmin yudDe bahu raktaM papAta (?); that day was most b. for the Romans *tasmin divase rumIyARAM baMhizWaM raktaM papAta.
BLOODY , a. raktamayaH -yI -yaM, SoRitamayaH -yI -yaM, raktAktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Murderous) mArAtmakaH -kA -kaM, krUraH -rA -raM.
BLOODY-FLUX , s. raktAtIsAraH, raktapittaH, aDosrapittaM, sAraRaH, pravAhikA.
BLOODY-MINDED , a. mArAtmakaH -kA -kaM, jiGAMsuH -suH -su, krUracetAH -tAH -taH (s).
BLOODY-RED , a. raktavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, lohitavarRaH -rRA -rRaM.

Bloom, s. See Blossom below; ‘b(loom) of youth’ yOvanaBaraH, navayOvanaM; ‘in the b(loom)ing youth’ praTame vayasi, navayOvane. 2 rAgaH (kapolarAgaH). v. i. Pulla 1 P, vikas 1 P, sPuw 6 P. 2 varD 1 A, eD 1 A.
BLOOM (subs.): I Blossom: q. v.II Fig., the b. of youth navayOvanam; the b. (of a maiden's) cheek kapolarAgaH.

BLOOM , s. (A blossom) puzpaM, kusumaM, pallavaH, mukulaH -laM. — (Fresh- colour) navavarRaH. — (In a state of bloom) adfzwapariRAmaH. — (Bloom of youth) navayOvanaM, akzatayOvanaM; ‘in the bloom of youth,’ prOQayOvanaH -nA -naM.

To BLOOM , v. n. Pull (c. 1. Pullati, PullituM), puzp (c. 4. puzppati, puzpituM), kusuma (nom. kusumayati -yituM), vikas (c. 1. -kasati -kasituM) — (To flourish) fD (c. 5. fDnoti, arDituM), samfD; eD (c. 1. eDate, eDituM), vfD (c. 1. varDate, varDituM).
BLOOM , s. yOvanAvasTA, tAruRyAvasTA, vikasanAvasTA, sPowaH.
BLOOMING, BLOSSOMING (adj.): (1) praPullaH (llA, llaM), b. face praPullavadanam;(2) vikasat (f. ntI); (3) sPuwat (f. ntI);(4) kusumitaH (tA, taM);(5) puzpitaH (tA, taM).

BLOOMING , a. PullavAn -vatI -vat (t), praPullaH -llA -llaM, vikasan -santI -sat (t), sPuwan -wantI -wat (t), vikAsI -sinI -si (n). — (Flourishing) vardDamAnaH -nA -naM, samfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, udayI -yinI -yi (n).

Blossom, s. puzpaM, kusumaM, mukulaH-laM, prasavaH, v. i. sPuw 6 P, praPull 1 P, Bid pass.; vikas 1 P, mukulEHsaMnnadDamukulEH sannadDa a. BU. [Blossomm]ed, [Blossomm]ing, a. sPuwita, praPulla, vikasita, Binna, vikaca, sPuwitakusumaH smita.
BLOSSOM (v. i.): (1) sPuwati (sPuw, c. 6);(2) Pullati (Pull, c. l);(3) vikasati (kas, c. l); (4) puzpati (puzp, c. 4) (rare): v. To flower.
BLOSSOM (subs.): (1) puzpam (=flower: q. v.);(2) mukula (mn.) (=an opening bud.);(3) prasavaH (rare), mango b. s cUtaprasavaH, Ku.;(4) pravAlaH (?).
BLOSSOM , s. puzpaM, kusumaM, pallavaH, mukulaH -laM, kzArakaH, prasavaH.

To BLOSSOM , v. n. Pull (c. 1. Pullati, PullituM), kusuma (nom. kusumayati -yituM), sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati, sPuwituM,) (c. 1. sPowate, sPowituM), puzp (c. 4. puzpyati, puzpituM), vikas (c. 1. -kasati -kasituM).
BLOSSOMING , a. PullavAn -vatI -vat (t), puzpitaH -tA -taM, puzpavAn -vatI -vat (t), kusumitaH -tA -taM, kusumavAn -vatI -vat (t), sPuwitapuzpaH -zpA -zpaM.

Blot, s. kalaMkaH, dozaH, lakzman n., apayaSas n. 2 lopaH, vyAmarzaH. v. t. malinayati (D.), duz c. (dUzayati), kalaMkayati (D.), kfzRIkf 8 U. 2 aspazwIkf; ‘b(lot) out’ vinaS c., ucCid 7 P, vilup c., vyAmfj c., vyAmfS c., ‘b(lott)ing paper’ masISozakaH, °kaM patraM.
BLOT (subs.): kalaNkaH: v. Spot. stain, tarnish.
To BLOT , v. a. malina (nom. malinayati -yituM), malinIkf, lip (c. 6. limpati, leptuM), duz in caus. (dUzayati -yituM), kalaNka (nom. kalaNkayati -yituM), kfzRIkf. — (To make indistinct) aspazwIkf.
BLOT , s. (Erasure) lopaH, vyAmarzaH. — (Spot, stain) kalaNkaH, apakalaNkaH, kaluzaM, malaM, dozaH. — (Disgrace) apakIrttiH f., apayaSaH n. (s), akIrttiH f.

To BLOT OUT , v. a. (To efface, destroy) vinaS in caus. (-nASayati yituM), ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vilup in caus. (-lopayati -yituM). — (To erase) vyAmfz (c. 1. -marzati -marzituM), lopaM kf.
Blotch, s. kilAsaM, siDmaM; sPowaH, visPowaH vraRaH-RaM, siDman n.; ‘having b(lotch)es’ kilAsin, siDmala. v. t. malinayati (D.).
BLOTCH: (1) kilAsam (?);(2) kacCapikA (?).
BLOTCH , s. kilAsaM, siDma n. (n), sPowaH, visPowaH, vraRaM, kacCapikA.
To BLOTCH , v. a. kilAsIkf, malina (nom. malinayati -yituM).
BLOTCHY , a. kilAsI -sinI -si (n), siDmalaH -lA -laM, siDmavAn -vatI -vat (t).
BLOTTED , p. p. malinitaH -tA -taM, dUzitaH -tA -taM, kalaNkitaH -tA -taM.
BLOTTING-PAPER: *masISozakaM kAgajam.
BLOTTING-PAPER , s. masISozakaH, masISozaRayogyaM patraM.

Blow, s. A-aBi-GAtaH, prahAraH; pAtanaM, nirGAtaH; ‘Oh! the hard b(low) of Fate’ ahaha dAruRo dEvanirGAtaH (U. 2); ‘b(low) with the fist’ muzwiGAtaH-prahAraH; ‘to strike a b(low)’ muzwinA taq 10 or han 2 P or prahf 1 P or aBi-A-han 2 P; yuv 4 A, yudDArTaM saMmil 6 P. 2 sPuwanaM, vikAsaH, PullanaM. v. i. See Blossom; oft. by smi 1 A; ‘b(low)n Pātala flower’ smitapAwalaM. 2 vA 2 P, vah 1 P, pravah. 3 Svas 2 P, uCvas, viniSvas. v. t. ud-han 2 P, ud-DU 9 U, ut-kzip 6 P, vah. 2 ut-, Svi c., sPAy c. (sPAvayati); ‘dust b(low)n by wind’ anilodDataM rajaH. 3 (As an instrument) DmA 1 P, muKamArutena pUr 10, (snAnaSaMKAnAmApUryamARAnAM Ka. 16); ‘b(low) hot and cold’ nigrahAnugrahO (yugapat) prakawayati (D.). [Blow] away, ud-han, udDf, utkzip. [Blow] out, nirvA c. (nirvApayati). [Blow] up, vi-ut-DU, sahasA unmUl 10. [Blow] upon, vIj 10. [Blow]ing, s. vikAsaH, vyAkoSaH, sPuwatA, protPullatA. 2 nAdaH; DmAnaM. [Blow]-pipe, s. DamanI; veRuDamanI.

BLOW (subs.): I With the fist:(1) muzwi- prahAraH, gives a b. on the nose DoRAyAM muzwiprahAraM dadAti, Mr. ii.(2) muzwiGAtaH;(3) BujAhatiH, Ki. To strike a b.: muzwinA hanti (han, c. 2.) or tAqayati (taq, c. 10.).II. B. in general: prahAraH: v. Stroke.III Fig. Infliction of evil: Ph. “gave a death-b. to the constitution” *SAsanapraRAlyA vinASaM kalpayAmAsa; “fortune's b. s” dEvanirDAtaH, U.

BLOW (v. i.): I To blossom: q. v.: sPuwati, pra-, (sPuw, c. 6.).II As air:(1) vAti, pra- (vA, c. 2.);(2) vahati, pra-, (vah, c. l.), Ku. xvii. 26.III To breathe hard or quick.: v. To breathe, to part.IV To sound as a wind instrument: Ph. horns blew pUrRAH perASca sasvanuH: B.: v. To sound.

BLOW (v. t.): I To b. the fire: Damati, saBA-, pra-, upa-, (DmA, c. l.) M. iv. 53.II To drive, to impel: q. v.: Ph. the tempest blew the ship ashore *vAtyA potaM vicikzepa (kzip, c. 6.) tawe; dust b. n by the wind anilodDataM (DU, c. 9.) or anilotTApitaM (c. of sTA) rajaH.III To sound a wind instrument:(1) Damati, saBA-, blew the shell jalajaM daDmO R.;(2) pUrayati or muKamArutena pUrayati (pUr, c. 10.), blew horns kAhalAH pUrayAYcakruH, B. xiv. 3.IV To spread, pub- -lish: q. v.: Ph.: to b. the nose nAsikAM Damati; one who does so nAsikanDamaH. To b. hot and cold: anugrahanigrahO prakawayati (nomi.).

BLOW , s. (A stroke) prahAraH, AGAtaH, aBiGAtaH, GAtaH, pAtaH, pAtanaM, daRqaH, hatiH f., AhatiH f. — (A blow with the fist) muzwipAtaH; ‘a blow which reduces to powder,’ nizpezaH. — (Blooming of flowers) PulliH f., PullatiH f., sPuwanaM, vikASaH. — (The act of a fly which infects meat by depositing eggs) makzakayA aRqapra- savena KAdyamAMsadUzaRaM.

To BLOW , v. n. (As the wind) vA (c. 2. vAti, vAtuM), pravA. — (To breathe) Svas (c. 2. Svasiti, SvasituM), ucCvas, SvAsapraSvAsaM kf. — (To pant) kfcCreRa Svas, viniSvas, duHSvAsaM kf, yazwiprARaH -RA -RaM BU. — (As a flower) Pull (c. 1. Pullati, PullituM), sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati, sPuwituM), puzp (c. 4. puzpyati, puzpituM).

To BLOW , v. a. DmA (c. 1. Damati, DmAtuM), samADmA, praDmA, upaDmA; ‘he blew his horn,’ SaNKaM daDmO; ‘fire blown by the wind,’ vAyunA DmAyamAno'gniH. — (To blow away) apaDmA, viDmA. — (To blow out) nirvA in caus. (-vApayati -yituM). — (To blow upon) vIj (c. 10. vIjayati -yituM), anuvIj, udvIj, upavIj; ‘blown upon by sacred breezes,’ puRyErvAyuBir anuvIjitaH. — (To puff upon, to cool) Put kf, PUtkAraM kf. — (To blow the nose) nAsikaM DmA. — (One who blows his nose) nAsikanDamaH.
To BLOW , v. a. l. 7. for nAsikaM, read nAsikAM.
BLOW AWAY: vi-DUnoti or DUnayati or DUnAti (DU, c. 5., 10. &. 9.): v. To drive away.
BLOW INTO: PUtkaroti.
BLOW OUT: nirvApayati (c. of vA): Ph. if you allow me, I will b. the dust from your eye yadyanu- manyase tadahamenAM vadanamArutena viSadAM karavARi, Sa. iii.
BLOW OVER: SAmyati, pra-, upa-, (Sam, c. 4): v. To cease, pass away.
BLOW UP: I To swell, inflate: q. v.II By explosion: no equiv.: udDUnayati (DU, c. 10) may be used.III To destroy: unmUlayati (mUl, c. 10).
BLOW-PIPE: DamanI.
BLOW-PIPE , s. nAqiH f. — (One who uses it) nAqinDamaH.
BLOWER: (1) DamakaH;(2) DmAtA.
BLOWING (subs.): I Of a wind instrument: (1) DmAtam (rare):(2) nAdaH: v. sound:II Of a flower, etc.:(1) vikASaH;(2) PulliH. In other senses, v. To blow.
BLOWING , part. (As a flower) sPuwan -wantI -wat (t), vikASI -SinI -Si (n), PullavAn -vatI -vat (t). — (The act) PulliH f., sPuwanaM, prasPowanaM, vikASaH.

BLOWN , p. p. (As a flower) PullaH -llA -llaM, utPullaH -llA -llaM, praPullaH -llA -llaM, sPuwaH -wA -waM, vyAkoSaH -SA -SaM, vikasitaH -tA -taM, vikacaH -cA -caM, prasPuwaH -wA -waM. — (Inflated) ADmAtaH -tA -taM.
BLOWZY , a. AtapadagDavadanaH -nI -naM, sUryyatejasA vikftavarRaH -rRA -rRaM.
Blubber, s. tiBimedas n. v. i. atirodanAt ucCUnamuKa a. (KI f.) BU. [Blubber]ed, a. ucCUna, sPIta.
BLUBBER (subs.): timyAdiyAdasAM medas (n.): v. Fat.
BLUBBER , s. timimedaH n. (s), timivasA, timitElaM, vfhanmInamedaH n. (s).
To BLUBBER , v. n. yaTA gaRqO Svayatas taTA rud (c. 2. roditi, rodituM), atiSayakrandanAd ucCUnamuKo BU.
Bludgeon, s. laguqaH, gadA.
BLUDGEON: laguqaH: v. Club.
BLUDGEON , s. laguqaH, pariDaH, pariGAtanaM, gadA. — (Armed with) laguqahastaH.
Blue, a. nIla, SyAma. s. nIlaH, nIliman m., nIlavarRaH. [Blu]ish, a. AnIla, izannIla.
BLUE (adj.): (1) nIlaH (lA, laM);(2) SyAmaH (mA, maM) (=dark b.); asitaH (tA, taM) (poet).
BLUE (subs.): (1) nIlaH;(2) nIlavarRaH. B. s.; i. e. low spirits: v. Melancholy.
BLUE , s. (The colour) nIlaH, nIlavarRaH.
BLUE , a. nIlaH -lA -laM, nIlavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, SyAmaH -mA -maM.
To BLUE , v. a. nIlIkf. — (To become blue) nIla (nom. nIlAyate).
BLUE-BIRD: *nIlapakzI.
BLUE-BOTTLE: latABedaH; makzikABedaSca.
BLUE-EYED: nIlAkzaH (kzI, kzaM).
BLUE-EYED , a. nIlanayanaH -nI -naM, nIlAkzaH -kzI -kzaM.
BLUEBOTTLE , s. nIlaSarIraH sTUlamakzikApraBedaH, varvvaRA.
BLUENESS , s. nElyaM, nIlatA -tvaM, SyAmatA.
Bluff, a. sTUla; See Big. 2 rUkza, paruza, ugra.
BLUFF , a. (Big) sTUlaH -lA -laM. — (Harsh) rUkzaH -kzA -kzaM, paruzaH -zA -zaM, ugraH -grA -graM, karkaSaH -SA -SaM. — (Not pointed) GanAgraH -grA -graM. — (Exposed to wind) vAtAvakASikaH -kI -kaM.
BLUFFNESS , s. rUkzatA, kArkaSyaM, paruzatvaM, GanatvaM.
BLUISH: (1) AnIlaH (lA, laM);(2) IzannIlaH (lA, laM).
BLUISH , a. AnIlaH -lA -laM, IzannIlaH -lA -laM, IzatSyAmaH -mA -maM.

Blunder, s. pramAdaH, sKalitaM, dozaH. v. i. pramad 4 P, sKal 1 P, Bram 1, 4 P. [Blunder]er, s. pramAdin m., sKalanaSIlaH. [Blunder]ing, a. pramAdin, pramatta, anavaDAna, adakza. [Blunder]ingly, adv. sapramAdaM, sKalanapUrvaM.
BLUNDER (v. i.): pramAdyati (mad, c. 4): v. To err, mistake.
BLUNDER (subs.): (1) pramAdaH;(2) sKalitam;(3) BramaH: v. Mistake.
To BLUNDER , v. n. pramad (c. 4. -mAdyati -madituM), sKal (c. 1. sKalati, sKalituM), Bram (c. 1. Bramati, c. 4. BrAmyati, BramituM), anavaDAnaM kf.
BLUNDER , s. pramAdaH, sKalitaM, sKalanaM, dozaH, BramaH, karmmadozaH, anavaDAnaM, aSudDaM.
BLUNDERBUSS: *AyatacCidraviSizwaH kzudrabandukaviSezaH.
BLUNDERBUSS , s. anekaSo lohagulikAprakzepaRI viSAlamuKaviSizwA nAqiH f.
BLUNDERER: (1) pramAdin (f. nI);(2) pramattaH (ttA, ttaM);(3) BrAntacittaH (ttA, ttaM).
BLUNDERER , s. pramAdI m. (n), pramAdakarttA m. (rttf), dozakarttA m. (rttf), sKalanaSIlaH.

A collection: q. v. samavAyaH, a b. of men janasamavAyaH.VI The main or central part: Ph. the b. of a carriage yAnamaDyam (?); the b. of a tree prakARqaH; the b. of an army balasamudAyaH (?).

(n), vigrahaH, saMhananaM, tanuH f. -nUH f., karaRaM; ‘a dead body,’ mftaSarIraM, SavaH, kuRapaH; ‘a little body,’ SarIrakaM. — (Substance) mUrttiH f.; ‘the body of cloth,’ vastrayoniH m. — (A person) puruzaH, janaH, manuzpaH, lokaH. — (A collective mass) samUhaH, samavAyaH, saNGAtaH, samudAyaH, maRqalaM, saNGaH, vfndaM, nivahaH, oGaH; ‘a body of men,’ janasamUhaH; ‘a body of water,’ payorASiH m., vArirASiH m.; ‘in a body,’ saNGaSas, saNgamya, samUhya. — (A society of men) saMsargaH, samAgamaH, paNktiH f. — (A corporate body) SreRI. — (A collegiate or religious body) ASramaH. — (Strength) balaM. — (The main part) praDAnaBAgaH; ‘body of a tree,’ prakARqaH, skanDaH; ‘the body or interior of a building,’ prAsAdAByantaraM, antarvfhaM, antarBavanaM, BavanodaraM, BavanagarBaH. — (A body of troops) gulmaH, sEnyadalaM, sEnikaH; ‘a body of reserve,’ pratigrahaH; ‘body to body,’ aNgANgi.
