details.body: To BROOD-OVER , v. a. cintAkulIBU, cintAvyagraH -grA -graM BU, avasannena manasAcint (c. 10. cintayati -yituM), yaTA mahadduHKaM jAyate taTA suciraM cint.
To BROOD-OVER , v. a. durmanas (nom. durmanAyate). BRUISE, s. nIlI -likA.
BROODING (subs.): Ph. b. on eggs aRqasevA (?).
BROODING , s. (The act of sitting on eggs) kulAyanilAyaH.
BROODY , a. kulAyanilAyI -yinI -yi (n).
Brook, s. kusarit f., srotas n., kzudranadI, kzudra-alpa-sarit. v. t. sah 1 A, kzam 1 A, mfz 4 P, 10.
BROOK (subs.): (1) sarit or kusarit;(2) kzudra- nadI.
BROOK (v. t.): marzayati (mfz, c. 10.): v. To endure.
BROOK , s. alpanadI, alpasarit f., kusarit f., kzudrasarit f., alpasrotaH n. (s).
To BROOK , v. a. and v. n. sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), vizah, kzam (c. 1. kzamate, kzantuM), saNkzam; tij in des. (titikzate -kzituM), mfz (c. 4. mfzyati -te, marzituM, c. 10. marzayati -yituM).
BROOKLIME , s. nadIkUlapriyaH or kacCaruho nIlapuzpaviSizwa ozaDiBedaH.
Broom, s. saMmArjanI, SoDanI. ‘b(room) stick-staff’ mArjanIdaMqaH; dIrGa-kfSa-yazwiH.
BROOM: I A brush:(1) sammArjanI;(2) SoDanI. II A shrub: latAviSezaH.
BROOM , s. (For cleaning) mArjanI, sammArjanI, SoDanI f., vimArgaH, UhanI, samUhanI. — (A shrub) JuRwapraBedas tasya ca kzudraviwapA mArja- nInirmmARe kadApi prayujyante.
BROOMSTAFF , s. mArjanIdaRqaH, SoDanIdaRqaH, vimArgayazwiH m.
BROOMSTICK: sammArjanIdaRqaH (?).
Broth, s. sUpaH, yU(jU)zaM.
BROTH: (1) mAMsarasaH (of meat), Śr.;(2) yUzaH (of dal).
BROTH , s. jUzaM, yUzaM, sUpaH, nizkvATaH.
Brothel, s. veSaH, veSyAlayaH, gaRikAgfhaM.
BROTHEL: (1) veSyAlayaH;(2) veSyAgfham;(3) veSaH;(4) veSyAjanasamASrayaH.
BROTHEL , s. veSyAjanasamASrayaH, gaRikAgfhaM, veSyASrayaH, veSyAgfhaM, veSyAlayaH, veSyAveSma n. (n), keligfhaM.

Brother, s. BrAtf m., sodaraH, sahodaraH, sodaryaH. 2 baMDuH, sahakArin m., saMsargin m.; ‘spiritual brethren’ ekaguravaH. [Brother]hood, s. BrAtfBAvaH-tvaM, sOBrAtraM. 2 sAhacaryaM, baMDutA, saMsargaH, samAjaH. [Brother]ly, a. BrAtrIya, BrAtfsadfSa (SI f.); ‘b(rother)-in-law’, s. SyAlaH, devf m., devaraH (husbandʼs brother).
BROTHER: (1) BrAtA (a full or a step-b. and also used fig. like the English word);(2) sahodaraH or sodaraH or sodaryaH or sagarBaH (=a full b.); elder b.: agrajaH; younger b. anujaH.

BROTHER , s. BrAtA m. (tf). — (Of whole blood) sodaraH, sahodaraH, sodaryyaH, samAnodaryyaH, sagarBaH, sagarByaH, sanABiH m., svayoniH m., sahajaH. — (Of half blood) BinnodaraH. — (Half-brother, step-mother's son) vEmAtreyaH, vimAtfjaH. — (Brother in law, husband's brother) devA m. (vf), devaraH. — (Wife's brother) SyAlaH. — (Brother's wife) BrAtfjAyA, prajAvatI. — (Brother and sister) BrAtfBaginyO m. du., BrAtarO m. du. — (Any one closely united) banDuH m., bAnDavaH, sajAtiH m., samAnagotraH, sahAyaH, sahakArI m. (n), saMsargI m. (n); ‘a brother in arms,’ sahayuDvA m. (n).
BROTHER-IN-LAW: () SyAlaH (=wife's brother); (2) devaraH (=husband's younger brother);(3) BrAtfSvaSuraH (=husband's elder brother);(4) BaginIpatiH (sister's husband).
BROTHERHOOD: I The state of being a brother: BrAtftvam. Proper b. sOBrAtram R. xvi. I.II. An association of men: v. Fraternity, society.
BROTHERHOOD , s. BrAtftvaM, sOBrAtraM. — (Association) saMsargitvaM, samAMSitA, sahakAritA, sAhacaryyaM, sAhityaM, banDutA, saMsargaH.
BROTHERLESS , a. aBrAtfkaH -kA -kaM, BrAtfhInaH -nA -naM.
BROTHERLY (adj.): I Pertaining to brothers:(1) BrAtrIyaH (yA, yaM),(2) comp. with BrAtf, etc.II Becoming brothers:(1) BrAtfsanniBaH (BA, BaM);(2) BrAtfrUpaH (pA, paM).
BROTHERLY (adv.): (1) BrAtfvat;(2) BrAtf- sanniBam.
BROTHERLY , a. BrAtfkaH -kA -kaM, BrAtrIyaH -yA -yaM, BrAtfsanniBaH -BA -BaM.
BROTHERLY , adv. BrAtfvat, sodaravat, BrAtfrUpeRa, prAtfkaprakAreRa.
BROTHERLY , adv. for prAtfkaprakAreRa, read BrAtfkaprakAreRa.

BROUGHT , p. p. nItaH -tA -taM, AnItaH -tA -taM, upAnItaH -tA -taM, AhftaH -tA -taM. — (Brought forth) prasUtaH -tA -taM, jAtaH -tA -taM, utpAditaH -tA -taM, utpannaH -nnA -nnaM. — (Brought up) gfhItavidyaH -dyA -dyaM, labDavidyaH -dyA -dyaM, vinItaH -tA -taM, varDitaH -tA -taM.

Brow, s. kawakaH, utsaMgaH; See Edge. 2 BrUH, BrUlatA; ‘knit the b(row)s’ BrUBaMgaM kf 8 U, BrUkuwiM baMD 9 P, BrUkuwiracanAM kf. 3 lalAwaM; vadanaM, AnanaM. [Brow]beat, v. t. BrUBaMgeRa-kawAkzeRa-tarj 10, or nirIkz 1 A. Bound, a. kirIwin.
BROW (subs.): I The eye b.:(1) BrUH, to knit the b. s BrUkuwiM baDnAti (banD, c. 9.) or BrUBaNgaM karoti;(2) BrUlatA.II The forehead: q. v.: lalAwam.III Edge of a steep place: v. Edge, precipice.

BROW , s. (The forehead) lalAwaM, mUrdDA m. (n), goDiH m. — (The countenance) vadanaM, muKaM, AnanaM. — (The arch of hair over the eye) BUH f., BUlatA. — (The edge of any high place) SElakawakaH, girimUrdDA m. (n), utsaNgaH, nitambaH, giripfzWaM.
BROWBEAT: BrUkuwiM baDvA or BrUBaNgaM kftvA BIzayate (c. of BI): Ph. b. ing me mayyeva BrUkuwIDaraH saMvfttaH Vi.: v. To terrify.
To BROWBEAT , v. a. BUBaNgena or saBUBaNgaM or saBrukuwImuKaM or kawAkzeRa or sadarpaM nirIkz (c. 1. -Ikzate -IkzituM); ‘brow-beaten,’ kawAkzitaH -tA -taM.
BROWBOUND , a. kirIwI -winI -wi (n), kirIwaDArI -riRI -ri (n).
Brown, a. kapiSa, piSaMga (gI f.), piMgala, kapila, SyAva. [Brown]ish, a. IzatkapiSa, ApiMgala. [Brown]ness, s. kapiSaH, piMgalavarRaH.
BROWN (adj.): (1) kapiSaH (SA, SaM);(2) SyAvaH (vA, vaM);(3) piSaNgaH (NgI, NgaM);(4) piNgalaH (lA, laM): v. Tawny, dark.
BROWN (v. t.) I To make brown: kapiSayati (nomi.).II To brown (meat) in cooking: AraktaH (ktA, ktaM) karoti (?).

BROWN , a. SyAvaH -vA -vaM, kapiSaH -SA -SaM, kapilaH -lA -laM, piNgalaH -lA -laM, piSaNgaH -NgA -NgaM, tAmraH -mrI -mraM, tAmravarRaH -rRA -rRaM. — [Page067-b+ 51] (Browned, made brown) kapiSitaH -tA -taM.
BROWNISH , a. IzatkapiSaH -SA -SaM, IzatpiNgalaH -lA -laM, AtAmraH -mrI -mraM.
BROWNNESS , s. kapiSaH, kapiSavarRaH, piNgalatA, SyAvaH, tAmravarRaH.
BROWNSTUDY , s. samADAnaM, antarDyAnaM, anyamanaskatvaM, cintAvyagraBAvaH, cintAkulatA.
Browse, v. t. ad 2 P, carv 10, laMG 1 A, (pallavAn laMGitumAgacCati M. 4), Bakz 10, saMdaMS 1 P. [Brows]ing, s. kisalayaH-yaM, navapallavaH-vaM; navatfRaM, SAdvalaM.
BROWSE (v. t.): (1) atti (ad, c. 2.):(2) Bakzati (Bakza, c. l.): v. To eat.
BROWSE (v. i.): carati (car, c. l.). B. on= browse (v. t.): q. v.
BROWSE (subs.): (1) kisalayam;(2) pallavam;(3) navapallavam.
BROWSE , s. kisalaH -laM, kisalayaM, navapallavaM, pallavaM, gavAdanaM, CAgAdanaM, CAgAdiBakzaRIyaM navaSAKAgulmAdi.
To BROWSE , v. n. CAgAdivat kisalaSAKAdi Bakz (c. 1. Bakzati, BakzituM) or KAd (c. 1. KAdati, KAdituM), car (c. 1. carati, carituM).
BROWSICK , a. vizaRavadanaH -nI -naM, aDomuKaH -KI -KaM, natamUrdDA -rdDA -rdDa (n).
BROWSING , s. navakisalayaM, navapallavaM, navatfRaM, yavasaH, SAqvalaM, patrayOvanaM, mfgaBojanIyaM navANkuralatAdi.
Bruin, s. fkzaH, BallUkaH.
Bruise, v. t. apakf 8 U, kzaR 8 P, prahAreRa hiMs 7 P. 2 mfd 9 P, piz 7 P. s. kzataM, apakAraH, prahAraH, AGAtaH. 2 piccitavraRaH.
BRUISE (subs.): Gfzwam, Ni.; kzatam (=hurt).
BRUISE , s. kzataM, parikzataM, azWIlA, prahArakzataM, prahArArttiH f.; prahAraH, AGAtaH.

To BRUISE , v. a. (Hurt by a blow) prahAreRa hiMs (c. 7. hinasti, hiMsituM) or kzataM kf, or kzaR (c. 8. kzaRoti, kzaRituM), azWIlAM kf. — (Reduce to powder, crush) cUrR (c. 10. cUrRayati -yituM), mfd (c. 9. mfdnAti, marddituM), avamfd, vimfd, cUrRIkf.
To BRUISE , v. a. kzud (c. 7. kzuRatti, kzottuM). BRUISED, p. p. kzuRRaH -RRA -RRaM.
BRUISED , p. p. prahArArttaH -rttA -rttaM, kzataH -tA -taM, parikzataH -tA -taM, vikzataH -tA -taM, cUrRitaH -tA -taM, cUrRIkftaH -tA -taM, mardditaH -tA -taM.
BRUISER , s. (Boxer) JallaH, mallayoDaH, pARiGAtaH, bAhupraharaRaH, bAhuyoDI m. (n).
Bruit, s. DvaniH. 2 vArtA, janapravAdaH. v. t. KyA c. (KyApayati), Guz 10.
BRUIT , s. (Noise) SabdaH, DvaniH m. — (Rumour) pravAdaH, janapravAdaH, samAcAraH, saMvAdaH, kiMvadantI, vArttA.
To BRUIT , v. a. Guz in caus. (Gozayati -yituM), AGuz, viGuz, KyA in caus. (KyApayati -yituM), AKyA, prakAS in caus. (-kASayati -yituM).
BRUMAL , a. hEmantaH -ntI -ntaM, -mantikaH -kI -kaM, SItakAlInaH -nA -naM.
Brunette, s. SyAmA, SyAmavarRA.
BRUNETTE: (1) SyAmA;(2) SyAmANgI.
BRUNETTE , s. SyAmA, SyAmalA, SyAvANgI, tAmramuKI, kapiSamuKI.
Brunt, s. BAraH; ‘b(runt) of battle’ raRaDurA; saMGawwaH, praTamAkramaH; prahAraH, AGAtaH.
BRUNT , s. (Attack) AkramaH, aBikramaH, praTamAkramaH, saNGawwaH, aBimarddaH, balAtkAraH. — (Blow) AGAtaH, prahAraH, samAGAtaH.

Brush, s. AGarzaRI; lomamayI mArjanI or SoDanI. 2 tUlikA, SalAkA, vartiMkAvartikA. 3 saMGawwaH, samAGAtaH. v. t. mfj 2 P, Gfz 1 P, GarzaRena SuD c. 2 mfdu taq 10, laGugatyA prahf 1 P. v. i. (by) laGu Gfz. 2 apaDAv 1 P, visfp 1 P. [Brush]wood, s. gulmaH, jaMgalaM. [Brush]y, a. lomaSa.
BRUSH (subs.): I Clothes -b.: *vastraSoDanI. II Shoe -b. *pAdukAsammArjanI.III Painter's b.:(1) tUlI, -likA;(2) IzikA;(3) SalAkA; (4) kUrccaH;(5) vartikA.IV The brushy tail of a fox: bAlaDiH.

BRUSH (vt.): I To take the dirt of:(1) mArzwi (mfj, c. 2.);(2) SoDayati (c. of SuD) II To touch gently: Garzati (Gfz, c. l.). III To b. off or away: nizkAsayati (c. of kas): v. To remove.IV To b. up: v. To furnish.

BRUSH , s. AGarzaRI, nirGarzaRakaH, mArjanI, SUkaralomamayI mArjanI, SoDanI, vimArgaH, kUrccaH, kUrccakaM. — (Painter's brush) IzikA, tUlikA, varttikA, leKyacUrRikA. — (Tail of a fox) lomaSAbAlaH. — (A rude encounter) saNGawwaH, samAGAtaH, balAtkAraH.

To BRUSH , v. a. (To rub or clean with a brush) mfj (c. 2. mArzwi, mArzwuM, c. 1. mArjati, mArjituM), apamfj, pramfj, parimfj, avamfj, sammfj, AGfz (c. 1. -Garzati -GarzituM), AGarzaRIdvAreRa SuD in caus. (SoDayati -yituM), prakzal (c. 10. -kzAlayati -yituM). — (To strike lightly) Gfz, laGu or lAGavena taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM).

To BRUSH , v. n. (To brush by, pass hastily by) laGugatyA atikramya paravastraM Gfz (c. 1. -Garzati -GarzituM). — (To brush off, hasten off) apaDAv (c. 1. -DAvati -DAvituM). — (To skim lightly, glide) visfp (c. 1. sarpati -rsaptuM -sraptuM).
BRUSH-MAKER , s. mArjanIkAraH, AGarzaRIkAraH.
BRUSHED , p. p. AGarzitaH -tA -taM, mArjjitaH -tA -taM, AGawwitaH -tA -taM.
BRUSHER , s. mArjjanakft, AGarzaRakft, prakzAlakaH, mArjanIdvArA SoDanakft.
BRUSHWOOD: (1) SAKAgrARi (n. pl.) (?);(2) inDanam (=fuel).
BRUSHWOOD , s. jaNgalaH, gulmaH, JAwaH -waM, JuRwaH, prastAraH, inGanaM.
BRUSHY , a. lomaSaH -SA -SaM, dfQalomA -mA -ma (n), stabDaromA -mA -ma (n).
Brusque, a. avinIta. 2 asaMbadDa. 3 anavahita.
BRUTAL: (1) nfSaMsaH (sA, saM);(2) krUraH (rA, raM): v. Cruel, savage.

BRUTAL , a. (Like a brute) SOvApadaH -dI -daM, paSuSIlaH -lA -laM, paSuvyavahAraH -rA -raM, paSusadfSaH -SI -SaM, amAnuzaH -zI -zaM. — (Crucl) nirddayaH -yA -yaM, krUraH -rA -raM, krUrAcAraH -rA -raM, nizWuraH -rA -raM.
BRUTALITY: (1) nfSaMsatA(2) krOryam: v. Cruelty, inhumanity.
BRUTALITY , s. paSutvaM -tA, tiryyaktvaM, paSuSIlatA, amanupyatA, krUrAcAratA.
BRUTALIZE: (1) nfSaMsIkaroti;(2) krUrIkaroti.
To BRUTALIZE , v. a. paSUkf, paSuSIlaM -lAM -laM kf, SOvApadIkf.
BRUTALLY: (1) nfSaMsam;(2) krUram;(3) paSuvat.
BRUTALLY , adv. paSuvat, paSurUpeRa, paSuvyavahArAnusAreRa, atikrOryyeRa, nirddayaM.

Brute, s. paSuH, tiryas m. 2 nfpaSuH, durvfttaH, krUrAcAraH. a. a-vi-cetana, ajYAna. 2 krUrakarman, asaBya [Brut]al, [Brut]ish, a. nfSaMsa, krUra, paSu in comp.; See Cruel. 2 paSuSIla, pASava (vI f.), paSusadfSa (SI f.), paSutulya. [Brut]ally, adv. paSuvat; nirdayaM; atikrOryeRa.
BRUTE (subs.): I A beast: q. v.: paSuHII A brutal man:(1) paSuH;(2) piSAcaH (=fiend). Ph. human b. nfpaSuH; puruzapaSuH, etc.
BRUTE (adj.): I Irrational: q. v.II Un- -civilised: q. v. Ph. by mere b. force *kevalaM paSusADAraRena balena.
BRUTE , s. paSuH m., jantuH m., tiryyaN (Yc), prARI m. (n). — (A savage) puruzapaSuH m., durAcAraH, durvfttaH, krUrAcAraH, asaByajanaH.

BRUTE , a. (Irrational) ajYAnI -ninI -ni (n), aprAjYaH -jYA -jYaM. — (Savage) krUrakarmmaSAlI -linI -li (n), asaByaH -ByA -ByaM. — (Sense- less) vicetanaH -nA -naM, vimUQAtmA -tmA -tma (n). — (Bestial) SOvApadaH -dI -daM, pASavaH -vI -vaM.
BRUTISH , a. paSusadfSaH -SI -SaM, jaqaH -qA -qaM, mUQaH -QA -QaM. See BRUTAL.
BRUTISHLY , adv. paSuvat, jaqavat, mUQavat. See BRUTALLY.
BRUTISHNESS , s. paSutvaM, jaqatA, mUQatA, krOryyaM, durAcAratA, nEzWuryyaM.
BRYONY: A plant: piluparRI.
BRYONY , s. tuRqikerI, raktaPalA, vimbikA, pIluparRI.
Bubble, s. budbudaH, qibiMkA. 2 (fig.) asAraM vastu, mAyA, vaMcakaH, mohaH, mAyAjAlaM. v. i. budbudAyate (D.). v. t. See Cheat.
BUBBLE (subs.): I Of water:(1) budDu daH; (2) qimbikA Wilson.II Fig.: Ph. man is a b. budvudaniBo manuzya:III A delusive scheme: budvudaH (?).
BUBBLE (v. i.): budvudAyate (nomi.). B. ing: udvudvudaH (dA, daM).
BUBBLE , s. budbudaH, jalabudbudaH, qimbikA, sPAraH, gaRqaH, PenAgraM. — (Any thing unreal, a trifle) avastu n., asAravastu n., svalpavizayaH. — (A cheat) vaYcakaH, kapawI m. (n).
To BUBBLE , v. n. budbuda (nom. budbudAyate -yituM), Pena (nom. PenAyate -yituM), utsecanaM kf.
To BUBBLE , v. a. (To cheat) vaYc in caus. (vaYcayate -yituM), pralaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), vipralaB, Cal (c. 10. Calayati -yituM).
BUBBY , s. stanaH, stanakuwmalaM, kucaH, vakzojaM, urasijaH.
Bubo, s. graMTi f.
BUBO , s. vfGnaH, upadaMSaH, sPowaH, visPowaH.
BUBO , s. vidArI -rikA. BUG, s. raktapAyI m., raktapaH.
BUCCANIER or BUCCANEER, s. AmerikAdeSIyaH samudrayAyI dasyuviSezaH.
Buck, s. hariRaH, mfgaH. 2 vastraDAvanArTaM jalaM. 3 suBagaMmanyaH. v. t. vastra DAv 1 P.
BUCK: (1) mfgaH (of deer);(2) ajaH (of goats); (3) SaSakaH (of hare).

BUCK , s. (Male of the deer) pummfgaH; ‘male of the rabbit,’ puMSaSakaH; ‘male of the goat,’ puMSCAgaH. — (Liquor in which clothes are washed) vastraDAvanArTaM jalaM. — (Clothes washed in that liquor) pUrvvoktajalaDAvitaM vastraM. — (A fop) darSanIyamAnI m. (n), suveSI m. (n), rUpagarvvitaH.
To BUCK , v. a. (To wash clothes) vastrARi DAv (c. 1. DAvati, DAvituM) or prakzal (c. 10. -kzAlayati -yituM).
BUCK-BASKET , s. tariH f., pewaH, pewakaH, peqA, piwakaH.
Bucket, s. araGawwaH, udaMcanaM, GawIyaMtraM. 2 pAtraM, droRI, secanI-naM.
BUCKET: I For drawing up water:(1) araGawwaH;(2) udGAwanam;(3) udaYcanam, D. vi.; (4) GawIyantram.II For carrying water:(1) droRI;(2) secanI.
BUCKET , s. sektraM, pAtraM, droRI, sekapAtraM, secanaM -nI. — (Bucket of a well) nIrottolanapAtraM, udGAwanaM, GawIyantraM.
Buckle, s. kuqupaH, gaMqakaH. v. t. kuqupena baMD 9 P; ‘to be b(uckl)ed to’ parAyaRa-Asakta a. BU 1 P. [Buckl]er, s. PalakaH-kaM, carman n.
BUCKLE (subs.): banDaviSezaH; *gaRqakaH.
BUCKLE (v.): *gaRqakitaH; (tA, taM) karoti. B. to: v. To apply.

BUCKLE , s. dravyadvayasaMlagnIkaraRArTaM kIlayuktaM DAtumayacakraM, vastrAYcalapAdu- kAbanDanAdisaNgrahaRArTaM maDyasTakIlaviSizwaH kuqupaviSezaH, upAnadbanDana- kuqupaH, kuqupaH, nidarSanamudrA. — (A curl, crisp) alakaH, karkarAlaH.
To BUCKLE , v. a. pUrvvoktakuqupadvAreRa banD (c. 9. baDnAti, bandDuM) or saMlagnIkf.

To BUCKLE TO , v. n. (To a business) AsTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), anuzWA; sev (c. 1. sevate, sevituM), parAyaRaH -RA -RaM or AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM BU. — (To engage in close fight) niyudDaM kf, bAhuyudDaM kf.
BUCKLER: PalakaH: v. Shield.
BUCKLER , s. carmma n. (n), PalakaH -kaM — (Armed with) PalakapARiH, PalakI m. (n).
Buckram, s. sTUlapawwaM-pawaH.
BUCKRAM: sTUlapawwaviSezaH.
BUCKRAM , s. dfQavastraviSezaH, stabDakzOmapawaviSezaH, stabDIkftavastraM, sTUlapawwaM, sTUlaSAwiH m., pawI. — (Stiff, formal) kaWinaH -nA -naM, dfQaH -QA -QaM.
BUCKSKIN: (1) mfgacarman (n.);(2) hariRAjinam.
BUCKSKIN , a. mfgAjinamayaH -yI -yaM, mfgacarmmanirmmitaH -tA -taM.
BUCKTHORN: raNgapradAyI vfkzajAtiBedaH.
BUCKTHORN , s. recakaPaladAyI vfkzapraBedaH.
BUCKWHEAT: SasyaBedaH.
BUCKWHEAT , s. Sasyakzetraruha ozaDipraBedaH.
BUCOLICS: gopAdivizayakaM kAvyam.
BUCOLICS , s. pl. gomezAdivizayaM gItaM, paSupAlanAdivizayakaM kAvyaM.
Bud, s. kalikA, kOrakaH-kaM, mukulaH-laM, kuqmalaH; jAlaM, koSaH-zaH, prarohaH, aMkuraH, pallavaH-vaM. [Budd]ed, v. t. See under Blossom.

BUD (subs.) I An undeveloped flower:(1) koraka (mn.);(2) kaliH, -kA;(3) mukula (mn.) (=half-open b.);(4) kuqma (dma) laH;(5) jAlam, -kam;(6) kozaH or koSaH.II An undeveloped branch, etc.:(1) aNkuraH;(2) prarohaH.
BUD (v. i): Ph. although the mangoes have b. ded late. cUtAnAM ciranirgatApi kalikA, Sa. vi. Expr. similarly by the verbs: udgacCati (gam, c. l.), udBinatti (Bid, c. 7.), udeti (i, c. 2.), etc.
BUD (v. t.): *aNkuraM niveSayati (c. of viS) (with loc.).
BUD , s. mukulaH -laM, kuwmalaH -laM, kuqmalaH, jAlakaM, kzArakaH, kalikA, prarohaH, aNkuraH, pallavaH -vaM, kozaH, korakaH -kaM, mukulodgamaH.
To BUD , v. n. sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati, sPuwituM), Pull (c. 1. Pullati, PullituM), vikas (c. 1. -kasati -kasituM), aNkura (nom. aNkurayati -yituM).
BUDDED , p. p. sPuwitaH -tA -taM, vikasitaH -tA -taM, vyAkoSaH -SA -SaM, [Page068-b+ 51] kuqmalitaH -tA -taM, aNkuritaH -tA -taM, prasPuwaH -wA -waM, PullavAn -vatI -vat (t).

BUDDHA , s. (The name applied to the ninth incarnation of Viṣṇu, and to the founder of the Buddhist religion) budDaH, SAkyamuniH m., SAkyasiMhaH, gOtamaH, muniH m., munIndraH, SAstA m. (stf), SrIGanaH, sarvvArTasidDaH, SOdDodaniH m., arkabanDuH m., mAyAdevIsutaH.
BUDDING , a. udBijjaH -jjA -jjaM, prarohI -hiRI -hi (n), PullavAn -vatI -vat (t).
Budge, v. i. pracal 1 P, apasf 1 P, ni-parA-vft 1 A, tyaj 1 P.
To BUDGE , v. n. cal (c. 1. calati, calituM), pracal; apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM).
Budget, s. SARapuwaH, dfti f. 2 kozaH, saMgrahaH, saMcayaH. 3 AyavyayagaRanA, °patraM.
BUDGET: I A bag, stock, store: q. v.II Of revenue: *AgABivarzasya rAjasvasya viBAvitAyavyaya- gaRanA.

BUDGET , s. (Bag) SARapuwaH, puwaH, kozaH, dftiH f., ADAraH, syUtaH. — (Stock, store) kozaH, sAmagryaM, saNgrahaH, saYcayaH. — (The statement made by the chancellor of the exchequer) koSADISena prajApratiniDisaBAyAm AgAmisaMvatsaraM praty Ayavyayayor jYApanapatraM.
Buff, s. mahizacarman n. 2 pAMquvarRaH.
BUFF (subs.): mahizAdeH parizkftacarmaH: v. Leather.
BUFF (adj.): I Made of b.: *parizkftacarmamayaH (yI, yaM).II Light yellow: ApItaH (tA, taM).
BUFF , s. (Leather made of the skin of the buffalo) mahizacarmma n. (n), mahizAjinaM. — (A light yellow colour) IzatpItaH, pARquvarRaH.
Buffalo, s. mahizaH; ‘she-b(uffalo)’ mahizI; ‘b(uffalo) milk’ mAhizaM payaH.
BUFFALO: (1) mahizaH;(2) sEriBaH (rare). A she- b.: mahizI. B. -horn: gavalam. B. -milk: mAhizaM dugDam, Bha.
BUFFALO , s. mahizaH -zI f., kAsaraH, gavalaH, lulApaH, vAhadvizan m. (t), sEriBaH.
Buffer, s. AGAta-BaMjakaH or moGIkArakaH.
Buffet, s. muzwiprahAraH, karAGAtaH, capewikA. 2 kuSUlaH. v. t. muzwinA taq 10 or prahf 1 P.
BUFFET (subs.): I A side-board: q. v.II A blow: q. v. muzwyAGAtaH.
BUFFET (v. t.): I Lit.: muzwinA or capewena hanti (han, c. 2.) or praharati (hf, c. l.).II To contend with: q. v.
BUFFET , s. (A blow) muzwyAGAtaH, muzwiDAtaH, karADAtaH, pARiDAtaH, bAhupraharaRaM, capewAGAtaH, capewikA. — (A cupboard) kuSUlaH, kozWaH.
To BUFFET , v. a. muzwinA or pARinA or capewena han (c. 2. hanti, hantuM) or prahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM).
BUFFETER , s. praharttA m. (rttf), pARiGAtaH, bAhupraharaRaH, karAGAtakft.
Buffoon, s. vidUzakaH, vEhAsikaH, BaMqaH. [Buffoon]ery, s. parihAsaH, hAsyaM, narman n.
BUFFOON: (1) BaRqaH;(2) vEhAsikaH;(3) vidUzakaH
BUFFOON , s. BaRqaH, vEhAsikaH, vidUzakaH, parihAsavedI m. (n), narmmasacivaH.
BUFFOONERY: BARqam.
BUFFOONERY , s. BARqaM, vEhAsikakarmma n. (n), vihAsaH, hAsyaM, parihAsaH, narmma n. (n).
Bug, s. matkuRaH, uddaMSaH; ‘b(ug) bear’ mahABayAspadaM, BayahetuH.
BUG: (1) matkuRaH;(2) yUkaH (f. kA), P. i. 9.; (3) kiwiBaH.
BUG , s. matkuRaH, ukuRaH, uNkuRaH, okaRaH, uddaMSaH, kiwiBaH, talpakIwaH.
BUGBEAR: (1) BUtaH (ghost);(2) trAsajananaH (nI, naM) (=terrific), he was a b. to the station sa purasya trAsajanana AsIt.
BUGBEAR , s. BayAnakaM or santrAsajanakaM yatkiYcit, Bayahetu n., trAsadAyI -yinI -yi (n), trAsakaraH -rI -raM.
BUGGY , a. (Full of bugs) matkuRapUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, samatkuRaH -RA -RaM.
Bugle, s. kohalaH-lA, vyADaSfMgaM-vizARaM. 2 SfMga, vizARaM.
BUGLE: (1) kAhalaH, -lA (a kind of horn); (2) peraH (another kind), B.
BUGLE , s. SaNKaH -NKaM, mfgavyaSaNKaH, vyADavAditaM SfNgaM or vizARaM.
BUGLOSS , s. Kilaruha ozaDipraBedaH, gojihvA.

Build, v. t. nirmA 3 A or c. (mApayati), prakxp c., viDA 3 U, virac 10; ‘b(uild) upon’ samAlaMb 1 A, A-samA-Sri 1 U. [Build]er, s. nirmAtf m., viDAyakaH. 2 sTapatiH, Silpin m., dArukarman m. [Build]ing, s. nirmARaM, viDAnaM. 2 BavanaM, gfhaM, harmyaM.

BUILD: (1) nir-mimIte (mA, c. 3.), built the city of Mathurā on the banks of the Yamunā upakUlaM sa kAlindyA nirmame maTurAM purIm, R. xv. 28.; (2) vidaDAti or Datte (DA, c. 3.), where (Kuvera) built the city... vyaDatta yasmin puram, Ki. v. 35.: v. To make.

To BUILD , v. a. nirmmA (c. 2. -mAti -mAtuM or in caus. -mApayati -yituM or c. 4. -mIyate), nici (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), kf in caus. (kArayati -yituM); ‘to build castles in the air,’ gagaRakusumAni kf.
BUILD UPON: avalambya or ASritya sfjati (sfj, c. 6.) or nirmimIte (?).
To BUILD UPON , v. a. (To rely upon) avalamb (c. 1. -lambate -lambituM), samAlamb, saMSri (c. 1. -Srayati -te -SrayituM), samASri, upASri.
BUILDER: (1) nirmAtA;(2) viDAtA (rare);(3) kartA (maker: q. v.).
BUILDER , s. nirmmAtA m. (tf), nirmmARakarttA m. (rttf), kArakaH, nicetA m. (tf), viDAyakaH. — (Of houses) sTapatiH m. gfhakArakaH, gfhakArI m. (n).
BUILDING (subs.): I The act of b.:(1) nirmARam;(2) nirmitiH (rare);(3) viDAnam (rare). II A structure:(1) Bavanam;(2) gfham: v. Edifice, house.
BUILDING , s. (The act of building) nirmmARaM, nirmmApaRaM, nicayanaM, gfhakaraRaM. — (The fabric built) prAsAdaH, gfhaM, BavanaM, harmyaM.
BUILT , p. p. nirmmitaH -tA -taM, kAritaH -tA -taM, nicitaH -tA -taM.
Bulb, s. kaMdaH-daM, golamUlaM. [Bulb]ous, a. kaMdin, kaMdaviSizwa. 2 kaMdAkfti.
BULB: No exact equiv.: kanda (mn.) may be used.
BULB , s. kandaH -ndaM, golamUlaM, sTUlakandaH, vfhatkandaH.
BULBOUS: Ph. b. root kanda (mn.) (?).
BULBOUS , a. kandI -ndinI -ndi(n), golamUlaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, kandAkftiH -tiH -ti.
Bulge, v. i. bahirlaMb 1 A, udarAkAreRa pralaMb.
To BULGE , v. n. (To founder) dArusPowanAt potapArSve jalaM gfhItvA majj (c. 6. majjati, majjituM). — (To bag down, jut out) puwarUpeRa lamb (c. 1. lambate lambituM), vahirlamb.
BULGE OUT: pralambate (laBm, c. l.): v. To swell out.
Bulk, s. pramARaM, parimARaM, mAtrA. 2 sTUlatA, bfhattvaM. 3 praDAna-aDika-BAgaH, BUyas m. [Bulk]y, a. See Big.

BULK: I Dimension: q. v. Ph.: Of great b. sTUlakAyaH (yA, yaM) (of animals) or mahA or bfhatpramARaH (RA, RaM), Ku.II The majority, the principal portion. Ph.: the b. of the people bahutaralokAH.III A projecting part of a building: alindaH (?).

BULK , s. (Bigness) sTUlatA, sTOlyaM, vfhattvaM, parimARaM, sTUlAkAratA. — (The greatest part of a thing) praDAnaBAgaH, aDikaBAgaH, bahuta- raBAgaH. — (Part of a building jutting out) vahirlambo harmyaBAgaH.
BULKHEAD , s. nOkAByantare pArSvApArSvi sTApitA kAzWamayI BittiH.
BULKINESS , s. sTUlatA, vfhattvaM, sTUlakAyatA. See BULK.
BULKY: (1) bfhat (f. tI);(2) sTUlaH (lA, laM); v. Big, large.
BULKY , a. sTUlaH -lA -laM, vfhan -hatI -hat (t), mahAkAyaH -yA -yaM, mahANgaH -NgI -NgaM, sTUlakAyaH -yI -yaM, vfhadaNgaH -NgI -NgaM, sTUlAkAraH -rA -raM.
Bull, Bullock, s. vfzaH, vfzaBaH, balIvardaH, fzaBaH, anaquh m., ukzan m., kakudmat m. 2 vAgdozaH, mahAsKalitaM, suspazwo vacanaviroDaH.

BULL: I The animal:(1) vfzaH;(2) vfzaBaH [Page093] (3) fzaBaH;(4) balIvardaH,(5) ukzan (m.);(6) kakudmat (m.) (=the humped b.);(7) puNgavaH; (8) anaquh (m.).II The constellation:(1) vfzaH;(2) vfzarASiH.III An edict of the Pope: (*popasya) AdeSaH.IV An absurd blunder: (1) pramAdaH;(2) sKalitam.

BULL , s. vfzaBaH, vfzaH, puNgavaH, fzaBaH, gOH m. (go), balIvarddaH, ukzA m. (n), sOraBeyaH, gonATaH, kakudmAn (t), anaqvAn m. (-quh), BadraH; ‘a cow which is fit for the bull,’ kAlyA, upasaryyA; ‘one which has gone to the bull,’ vfzaBeRa AkrAntA, sanDinI; ‘one which is bulling,’ sanDinI, vfzasyantI. — (A letter published by the pope) mahADarmmADyakzeRa prakASitam AjYApatraM. — (A blunder) sKalitaM, pramAdaH, vAgdozaH.

sanskrit.slp1: kukkuravfzaBayor yudDaM yatra manuzyAH krIqArTaM vfzaBam AkramituM
sanskrit.word: कुक्कुरवृषभयोर् युद्धं यत्र मनुष्याः क्रीडार्थं वृषभम् आक्रमितुं
sanskrit.iast: kukkuravṛṣabhayor yuddhaṃ yatra manuṣyāḥ krīḍārthaṃ vṛṣabham ākramituṃ

details.body: BULL-BAITING: kukkurErvfzaBAtrAsanam.
BULL-BAITING , s. kukkuravfzaBayor yudDaM yatra manuzyAH krIqArTaM vfzaBam AkramituM kukkurAn pracodayanti.
BULL-DOG: bfhanmuKaH kukkuraBedaH; *vfzakukkuraH.
BULL-DOG , s. vfzaBAkramaRAya Sikzito'tiSayakrUrasvaBAvo vfhanmuKaH kukkuraBedaH.
BULL-FINCH: pakzipraBedaH.
BULL-FINCH , s. vAganukaraRaSIlaH kzudrapakziBedaH.
BULL-HEAD , s. sTUlabudDiH m., sTUlaDIH m., durbudDiH m., mUQaH, mUrKaH, jaqaH.
BULLACE , s. amlarasaviSizwaH PalapraBedaH.
Bullet, s. sIsakagulikA.
BULLET: gulikA.
BULLET , s. aDunAtanayodDfBiH sevitA sIsakagulikA yA 'ntaragnibalena nAqiCidrAd atidUre niHsAryyate, dUraveDinI gulikA, sIsakagulikA.
Bulletin, s. SarIrasTitijYApakaM patraM.
BULLETIN: (1) GozaRA;(2) rAjAjYayA pracArito rAjasvAsTyAdivizayakaH samAcAraH.
BULLETIN , s. rAjAjYayA pracAritaM samAcArapatraM, rAjakIyacikitsakEH prakASitaM rogArttamahIpateH SarIrasTitijYApanapatraM.
Bullion, s. hiraRyaM; rUpyaM.
BULLION: (1) koSaH;(2) hiraRyam (gen. = gold); (3) rajatam (gen. = silver).
BULLION , s. hiraRyaM, rUpyaM, amudritaM suvarRaM rUpyaM vA, koSaH.
BULLITION , s. (The act or state of boiling) kvaTanaM, kvATaH, utsecanaM.
BULLOCK: (1) balIvardaH;(2) vfzaH: v. Bull.
BULLOCK , s. jAtokzaH, vfzaBaH, vfzaH, puNgavaH, aBinavavayasko vfzaBaH.
BULL'S EYE: I A window: gavAkzaH.II A centre of a target: lakzyam.III A police man's lantern: pradIpaBedaH.
BULL'S EYE , s. (A kind of window) gavAkzaH.
Bully, s. piMqISUraH, SUraMmanya; dAMBikaH, kalahakArin m. v. t. tarj 10, Barts 10 A; Ahve 1 A.
BULLY (subs.): (1) piRqISUraH (?);(2) tarjanapawuH (?).
BULLY (v. t.): (1) tarjayati (tarj, c. 10.) (=thre- -aten);(2) udvejayati (c. of vij) (=to fri- -ghten).
BULLY , s. (A blustering coward) SUrammanyaH, damBI m. (n), dAmBikaH, kumBaH, viwaH, piRqISUraH, BartsanakArI m. (n), tarjanakft, kalahakAraH.
To BULLY , v. a. Barts (c. 10. Bartsayati -te -yituM), tarj (c. 1. tarjati, tarjituM), tiraskf, muKarIkf.
BULRUSH: jalajatfRapraBedaH; nalaBedaH (?).
BULRUSH , s. parvvahIno dUrbbApraBedaH, nalaH, SaraH.
Bulwark, s. vapraH-praM, prAkAraH. 2 ASrayaH, SaraRaM, saMSrayasTAnaM, AlaMbaH; rakzaRasADanaM.
BULWARK: I A rampart:(1) vapraH;(2) prAkAraH.II Fig.: Any means of defence;(1) saMSrayaH;(2) ASrayaH;(3) SaraRam;(4) AlambaH.
BULWARK , s. vapraH, prAkAraH, prAcIraM, durgaM, parikUwaM. — (Shelter, pro- tection) ASrayaH, saMSrayaH, SaraRaM, AlambaH, upastamBaH.
Bum, s. nitaMbaH, kawiproTaH.
BUM , s. nitambaH, sPicO f. du., kawiproTaH.
BUMBAILIFF , s. grAhakaH, AsedDA m. (dDf), AseDakarttA m. (rttf), rAjapuruzaH.
BUMBLE-BEE , s. GvanamodI m. (n).
Bump, s. sPowaH, gaMqaH, SoPaH. v. i. Svi 1 P. 2 Beat, q. v.
BUMP (subs.): I A swelling: q. v. gaRqaH (?). II A thump: q. v.
BUMP , s. (A swelling) sPowaH, visPowaH, SvayaTuH m., SoPaH, SoTaH, gaRqaH, gaRqakA, ABogaH.
To BUMP , v. a. (To strike) taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), tud (c. 6. tudati, tottuM), han (c. 2. hanti, hantuM), prahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM).
To BUMP , v. n. (To swell) Svi (c. 1. Svayati, SvayituM). — (To make a noise) AsPowanaM kf.
BUMP , s. gulmaH. BUNDLE, s. vAsanaM.
Bumper, s. atipUrRaM pAtraM; cazakaH; ‘b(umper) crops’ atipracuraH SasyAgamaH; ‘b(umper) house’ janAkIrRaM prekzAgfhaM.
BUMPER: cazakam, “fill the b. s to the brim” *AmuKaM cazakARi pUryata.
BUMPER , s. AkarRaM or DAraparyyantaM pUritaM pAtraM, atipUrRaM BAjanaM.
Bumpkin, s. vfzalaH, jAnapadaH, grAmyajanaH.
BUMPKIN: grAmikaH: v. Rustic.
BUMPKIN , s. grAmyajanaH, grAmikaH, grAmevAsI m. (n), vfzalaH, jAnapadaH, prAkftajanaH.
Bumptious, a. sAvalepa, avalipta.
BUN: pizwakaH: v. Cake.
Bunch, s. gucCaH, stabakaH. 2 piMqaH, gaMqaH. 3 graMTiH, SeKaraH-raM. 4 powwalI, saMGAtaH, saMhatadravya. v. i. (out) piMqIBU 1 P.
BUNCH: A protuberance, hunch: q. v. II Of fruit: gucCaH.III A bundle: q. v.: a b. of keys: *tAlIgucCaH.

BUNCH , s. (A hard lump) piRqaH -RqaM, gaRqaH, gaRqakA. — (A cluster) gucCaH, gucCakaH, stavakaH; ‘a bunch of grapes,’ drAkzAstavakaH. — (A number of things tied together) kUrccaH, powwalI. — (A knot, a tuft) granTiH m., cUqA, SeKaraH.
To BUNCH OUT , v. n. piRqIBU, piRqAkAraH -rA -raM as, pralamb (c. 1. -lambate -lambituM).
BUNCHY , a. piRqAkAraH -rA -raM, stavakamayaH -yI -yaM, gucCAkAraH -rA -raM.
Bundle, s. BAraH, kUrcaH, powalikA, gucCaH, saMGAtaH; ‘b(undle) of goods’ BAMqakaM. v. t. (up) gucCIkf 8 U, ekatra samAhf 1 P.
BUNDLE (subs.): (1) kUrcaH (as of grass);(2) gucCaH (?);(3) powwalI (of clothes).
BUNDLE , s. kUrccaH, kUrcCa, BAraH, kftakUrcCaH, gucCaH, gucCakaH, powalikA, powwalI, vIwikA; ‘a bundle of goods,’ BARqakaM; ‘bundle off,’ dUram apasara, apEhi.
BUNDLE OFF (v.): I Trans: prasTApayati (c. of sTA).II Intrans.: pratizWate (sTA, c. l.).
To BUNDLE UP , v. a. kUrccaM kf, kUrccIkf, gucCIkf, powalikAM kf.
BUNDLED UP , p. p. kftakUrcCakaH -kA -kaM, kftapowalikaH -kA -kaM, kftagucCaH -cCA -cCaM.
Bung, v. t. CidraM niruD 7 U or piDA 3 U. [Bung]hole, s. pAtracCidraM, pAtraDArA.
BUNG (subs.): no equiv.: *muKapiDAnam.
BUNG , s. pAtramaDye CidrapratibanDakaM tarutvaNmirmmitaM dravyaM, yavasuraBAjane CidrAvaroDanArTaM kAzWaKaRqaM, BARqaCidrastamBanakAzWaM, pAtraCidrapiDAnaM.
To BUNG , v. n. CidraM or ranDraM or DArAM piDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM) or pratibanD (c. 9. -baDnAti -bandDuM) or niruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM) or stamB in caus. (stamBayati -yituM).
BUNG-HOLE: *muKam; madyaBARqamuKam: v. Hole.
BUNG-HOLE , s. pAtraCidraM, pAtraranDraM, pAtraDArA, BARqaSuziraM, yavasuraBAjanaCidraM.
Bungalow, s. harmyaM.
Bungle, v. i. adakzatayA kAryaM nirvah c., pramad 4 P, sKal 1 P. s. pramAdaH, sKalitaM, dozaH. [Bungl]er, s. adakzaH, pramAdin m., anipuRaH. [Bungl]ingly, adv. sapramAdaM, pramAdataH, adakzatayA.
BUNGLE (subs.): (1) pramAdaH;(2) sKalitam: v. Blunder.

To BUNGLE , v. n. pramAdyatas or adakzaprakAreRa or anAptaM kiYcit kAryyaM nirvvah in caus. (-vAhayati -yituM), pramad (c. 4. -mAdyati -madituM), sKal (c. 1. sKalati, sKalituM), Bram (c. 4. BrAmyati, BramituM), dozaM kf.
BUNGLE , s. pramAdaH, dozaH, BramaH, durRayaH, CidraM, sKalanaM, sKalitaM.
BUNGLED , p. p. durRItaH -tA -taM, durzawitaH -tA -taM, dUzitaH -tA -taM.
BUNGLER , s. akftI m. (n), anAptaH, anipuRaH, adakzaH, apawuH m., pramAdI m. (n), sKalanmatiH m.
BUNGLINGLY , adv. pramAdyatas, pramAdena, anAptaM, adakzatayA, sadozaM, sKalanena.
BUNN , s. mizwApUpaH, pizwakaH, piRqaH, goDUmacUrRamizwAnnAdinirmmitaH pizwakaH.
BUNT , s. puwaH, puwakaM, kramaSo vistIryyamARaM ranDraM, kramaSo vivAraH.
Bunter, s. akulInA strI.
BUNTER , s. kutsitakarmmajIvinI, vfzalI, banDakI, duzwA.
Bunting, s. DvajapawaH, ketuvasanaM. s. taraRaH, plavaH.
BUNTING: I A bird: pakziviSezaH.II Stuff for flags: DvajanirmARopayogI pawaviSepaH.
BUNTING , s. patAkAnirmmARayogyo or DvajavasanakaraRayogyo viralapawaviSezaH, DvajapawaH, ketuvasanaH.
Buoy (up), v. t. uttaMB 9 P, udDf 1 P, 10, AlaMb 1 A. 2 plu c. s. taraRaH, plavaH. [Buoy]ancy, s. laGutA, lAGavaM, plavanaSIlatA.
BUOY (subs.): nAvikeByaH saNkawasTalapradarSakaM jalopari plavamAnaM cihram; *plavaH.
BUOY , s. samudragARAM paTadarSanArTaM or pracCannasEkataSilAdiBayasTAnasUcanArTaM jalopari plavamAnaM kAzWaKaRqaM. — (For mooring vessels) kUpakaH.
BUOY UP (v. t.): I To keep afloat:(1) plAvayati (c. of plu) (?);(2) unmajjayati (c. of. masj) (?).II To support or sustain: q. v.
BUOY UP (v. i.): Ph. merit will b. at last *na Kalu guRAH pracCannAstizWanti.

To BUOY UP , v. a. (To keep afloat) unmajj in caus. (-majjayati -yituM), plu in caus. (plAvayati -yituM), utpat in caus. (-pAtayati -yituM). — (To bear up, support) Df in caus. (DArayati -yituM), sanDf, aBiDf, stamB in caus. (stamBayati -yituM), uttamB, saMstamB, Alamb (c. 1. -lambate -lambituM).
BUOYANCY: I Lit.:(1) plavanaSIlatA (?);(2) laGutA (=lightness).II Fig.: Cheerfulness, vivacity: q. v.: ullAsaH.
BUOYANCY , s. plavanaSIlatA, utpatizRutA, laGutA, lAGavaM, laGimA m. (n).
BUOYANT: I Lit.:(1) plavanaSIlaH (lA, laM) (?); (2) laGu (mfn.) (=light).II Fig.: Cheerful vivacious: q. v.
BUOYANT , a. plavanaSIlaH -lA -laM, taraRaSIlaH -lA -laM, laGuH -GuH -Gu, utpatizRuH -zRuH -zRu.
BUR , s. aNkuSAkAralomaviSizwo vastrAnubanDanaSIlo vakzyamARakzudragulmasambanDI dalapiRqaH.
BURBOT: matsyaviSezaH.

Burden, s. BAraH, BaraH, Dur f. (rAjyaDurA); ‘beast of b(urden)’ DuryaH, DurIRaH. 2 DruvakaM, anupada. 3 pIqAkara a. (rI f.), pIqAhetuH, BAraBUta a. v. t. BAraM nyas 4 P or niviS c. [Burden]ed, a. BArAkrAMta, AropitaBAra. [Burden]some, a. durvaha, durBara, durudvaha. 2 pIqAkara, duHKAvaha.
BURDEN (v. t.): I Lit.: v. To load:II Fig.: To oppress: q. v.: pIqayati (pIq, c. 10.).

BURDEN (subs.): I Load:(1) BAraH, b. of state rAjyaBAraH, K.; what b. is great to the able ko'tiBAraH samarTAnAm, H. iii.;(2) Dur (f.), a beast of b. DuryaH or DuroRaH;(3) BaraH, all b. placed on a worthy minister yogyasacive nyastaH samasto BAraH. Ra. i. Ph. the b. of proof: pramARaBAraH.II Taxes, pecuniary imposts: q. v.: unable to bear the b. s karaBArAsahAH, V. p.III The capacity of a ship: Ph. a boat of 100 maunds b. *SatamaRa- vAhinI nOH.IV. B. of a song:(1) Druvakam; (2) anupadam.

BURDEN , s. BAraH, DurA, DUH (Dur) f. — (Something grievous) pIqAkaraH -rA -raM; ‘burden-bearing,’ BAravAhanaH -nA -naM, DuranDaraH -rA -raM, BArasahaH -hA -haM, DurvvahaH -hA -haM, BAraharaH -rA -raM. — (Beast of burden) BAravAhanaH, DurIRaH, DurIyaH, DuryyaH, DOreyaH -yI -yaM. — (Of a song) DuvakA, kaTitapadaM, AvarttanIyaSlokaH, parivarttakaSlokaH.

To BURDEN , v. a. BAraM nyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM) with loc. c. or dA (c. 3. dadAti, dAtuM); ‘to lay a burden on the shoulder,’ BAraM skanDe nyas or niviS in caus. (-veSayati -yituM) or samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM).
BURDEN , s. (Of a song) DrupadaM, DruvA, anupadaM.
BURDENED , p. p. BAravAn -vatI -vat (t), BArI -riRI -ri (n), DurIRaH -RA -RaM, BArAkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, BAragrastaH -stA -staM, BArayuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
BURDENSOME: (1) durvahaH or durudvahaH (hA, haM);(2) durBaraH (rA, raM);(3) atiBArikaH (kA. kaM) (Lit. and Fig.) Mu. vi.;(4) duHsahaH (hA, haM) (Fig.).

BURDENSOME , a. (Troublesome to be borne) durBaraH -rA -raM, duHsahaH -hA -haM, durvvahaH -hA -haM, durudvahaH -hA -haM. — (Grievous, oppressive) pIqAkaraH -rA -raM, kazwakaraH -rA -raM, duHKI -KinI -Ki (n).
BURDOCK: gulmaBedaH.
BURDOCK , s. pUrvvoktadalapiRqaviSizwaH kzudragulmapraBedaH.
Bureau, s. ADAraH. 2 leKanasTAnaM, leKanasADanADAraH.
BUREAU: I A desk: q. v.II A department: viBAgaH (?).
BUREAU , s. (A chest, receptacle) AgAraM, ADAraH, niDAnaM, gopanasTAnaM. BARqAgAraM. — (An office for writing, &c.) leKyasTAnaM, granTakuwI.
Bureaucratic, a. aniyaMtritaSAsana.
BURG or BURGH, s. mahAsaBAyAM pratiniDipreraRADikArayuktA nagarI, karvvawaH -waM, nagaraM -rI, puraM -rI.
BURGESS: I A burgher: q. v.II A repre- -sentative of a borough in Parliament: *nagara- pratiniDiH or simp. pratiniDiH (when the sense is clear).
BURGESS , s. (A citizen) pOrajanaH, nagarajanaH, pOraH, nagarasTaH. — (A representative of a city) nagarapratiniDiH m., nagarapratiBUH m., nagarajanapratiniDiH m., prajApratiniDiH m.
Burgh, s. nagaraM, puraM. [Burgh]er, Burgess, s. nagarajanaH; pAraH. 2 nagarapratiniDiH, purapratiniDiH. [Burgh]ership, s. nagarajanADikAraH, pOrADikAra.
BURGHER: (1) *nAgaraH;(2) pOraH (=citizen).
BURGHER , s. nagarajanADikAraBogI m. (n), praDAnanagarajanaH, muKyapOrajanaH, nagarasaBAsad m.
BURGHERSHIP , s. nagarajanADikAraH, nagarajanapadaM, nagarasaBAsadaDikAraH.
Burglar, s. saMDicOraH, gfhaBaMgakft m., kuqyacCedin m., saMDicCedakaH. [Burglar]y, s. BitticOryaM, gfhaBaMgaH.

BURGLAR: (1) sanDicOraH or sanDihArakaH (a b. who enters by making a hole under the walls of a house);(2) kuqyacCedin (m.) (by making a passage through a wall);(3) kapAwaGnaH (by breaking or opening a door): (4) KanikaH or KAnilaH (rare) (=sanDicOraH); (5) kujamBa (mBi) laH (rare).
BURGLAR , s. BitticOraH, kuqyacCedI m. (n), kapAwaGnaH, gfhaBaNgakft, gfharanGrakft, sanGicOraH, kArucOraH, vandicOraH, vandIkAraH, vandigrAhaH, KAnilaH, kujamBalaH, suruNgAhiH m., suruNgAkft.
BURGLARIOUS: Ph. b. entry *jihIrzayA or cucora- yizayA paragfhapraveSaH.

sanskrit.slp1: kftvA kuqyaM vA CitvAnyena vA prakAreRa paragfhapraveSaH
sanskrit.word: कृत्वा कुड्यं वा छित्वान्येन वा प्रकारेण परगृहप्रवेशः
sanskrit.iast: kṛtvā kuḍyaṃ vā chitvānyena vā prakāreṇa paragṛhapraveśaḥ

details.body: BURGLARY: rAtrO cOryAdyanyAyyakarmacikIrzayA sanDiM kftvA kuqyaM vA CitvAnyena vA prakAreRa paragfhapraveSaH.
BURGLARY , s. gfhaBaNgaH, gfhaBaNgAparAGaH, kuqyacCedaH, BitticOryyaM.
Burgomaster, s. nagarADyakzaH.
BURGOMASTER , s. nagarADizWAtA m. (tf), nagarADyakzaH, purADyakzaH, praDAna- nagarajanaH, muKyapOrajanaH, nagaravyavahArezu niyuktaH, nagarADipatiH, purA- DikArI m. (n).
BURIAL: niDAnam. B. ground: *niDAnasTalI.

BURIAL , s. BUmiKananaM, niKananaM, BUmO niKananaM, SmaSAne sTApanaM, SmaSA- nayApanaM, BUmisamarpaRaM, pretanirhAraH. — (Funeral rites) pretakarmma n. (n), pretakAryyaM, mftakasatkarmma n. (n), satkriyA.
BURIAL-GROUND , s. SmaSAnaM, pretavanaM, pitfvanaM, pretagfhaM, mftaSarIrasTAnaM.
BURIED , p. p. niKAtaH -tA -taM, BUminiKAtaH -tA -taM, SmaSAnaSAyI -yinI -yi (n), SmaSAnasTApitaH -tA -taM, SmaSAnasamarppitaH -tA -taM.
BURIER , s. pretanirhArakaH, pretahAraH, mftapAH m., SavavAhakaH.
BURIN: An engraver's tool: takzaRI (?).
BURINE , s. takzaRapantraM, takzaRI, taNkaH, vraScanaH, SElaBittiH f.
Burke, v. t. SvAsaniroDena han 2 P or vyA-pad c. or mf. 2 tvaritaM saMpad c.
To BURL , v. a. lohasandaMSadvArA or turIdvArA nizpravARapawaM SlakzRIkf.
Burlesque, a. parihAsakara (rI f.), hAsajanana (nI f.), parihAsya. s. parihAsaH, BAMqaM, narman n. v. t. See Laugh.
BURLESQUE (adj.): hAsyakaraH (rI, raM) or hAsya- janakaH (kA, kaM).
BURLESQUE (subs.): hAsyakaraprabanDaH.
BURLESQUE (v. t.): Ph. to b. my gait *upahAsArTaM mama gatim anukaroti (kf, c. 8.): v. To imitate.
BURLESQUE , a. parihAsakaraH -rA -raM, hAsyaH -syA -syaM, hAsyajanakaH -kA -kaM, prahAsI -sinI -si(n), avahAsyaH -syA -syaM, hAsotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, narmmadaH -dA -daM.
BURLESQUE , s. BARqaM, parihAsaH, parIhAsaH, prahAsaH, prahasitaM, upahAsaH, apahAsaH, narmma n. (n), wawwarI, parihAsavAkyaM, utprAsanaM.
To BURLESQUE , v. a. apahas (c. 1. -hasati -hasituM), avahas, prahas, upahas, upahAsAspadaM kf.
BURLINESS , s. sTUlatA, sTOlyaM, vfhattvaM, sTUlaSarIratA, vfhadaNgatvaM.
BURLY: sTUlaH (lA, laM): v. Stout.
BURLY , a. sTUlaH -lA -laM, sTUlaSarIraH -rA -raM, vfhatkAyaH -yI -yaM, mahANgaH -NgI -NgaM, vfhadaNgaH -NgI -NgaM.

Burn, v. t. dah 1 P, pluz 1 P, jval c. (jvalayati), tap 1 P or c., uz 1 P, dIp c. v. i. jval 1 P, dah pass., tap 4 A, dIp 4 A; ‘b(urn) after’ utkaMW 1 A, spfh 10; ‘b(urn) out’ Sam 4 P; ‘b(urn) up’ nirdah. s. dAhavraRaH-aMkaH. 2 See ‘Brook’. [Burn]er, s. dAhakaH, tApakaH dIpakaH. [Burn]ing, s. dAhaH, dahanaM, plozaH, tApaH, jvalanaM; ‘b(urning) ground’ SmaSAnaM. a. dAhaka, tApaka. 2 caMqa, praKara; ‘b(urning) glass’ sUryakAMtaH, sUryopalaH.

BURN (v. t.): (1) dahati (dah, c. l.), I am b. ing Lankā in your presence tava pratyakzaM laNkA mayA dahyate, Ma. n. v.; but (it) is b. ing me mAM punardahatyeva, Sa. iii.; b. t rice dagDAnnam, b. t wood dagDakAzWam; half b. t dagDAdagDaH (gDA, gDaM), D.;(2) plozati (pluz, c. l.) (rare), half b. t arDapluzwaH (zwA, zwaM), Vi. vi. 4;(3) jvalayati (c. of jval) (to inflame), internal heat is b. ing my body jvalayati tanUmantardAhaH, U. iii.

BURN (v. i.): I To be on fire, to blaze: q. v. jvalati (jval, c. l.), the light is b. ing jvalati pradIpaH Mr. ii. To be inflamed with passion: (1) dahyate (pass of dah), my heart b. ing from contumely mama parimavAnaladahyamAnaM cetaH, Ve. iii.; (2) tapyate (pass. of tap), who is b. ing with grief yaH Sokena tapyate, U. iv.;(3) dIpyate (dIp, c. 4.) (of rage only), b. t with rage krudDo'dIpi, B. Ph. my limbs are b. ing jvalanti me'NgAni.
BURN (subs.): dAhajaM or dAhena janitaM kzatam (hurt) or vraRam (wound).
BURN , s. agnikftaM kzataM, agnikzataM, santApaH, saMjvaraH, dAhaH, agnidAhaH.

To BURN , v. a. dah (c. 1. dahati, dagGuM), anudah, Adah, nidah, nirdah, paridah, pradah, sampradah; tap (c. 1. tapati, taptuM) or in caus. (tApayati -yituM), santap in caus., uz (c. 1. ozati, ozituM), dIp in caus. (dIpayati -yituM), AdIp, uddIp, upadIp, pradIp, sandIp; sanDukz in caus. (-Dukzayati -yituM); jval in caus. (jvAlayati -yituM), prajval, pluz (c. 1. plozati, plozituM).

To BURN , v. n. dah (c. 4. dahyati, dagDuM or in pass. dahyate), samparidah, dIp (c. 4. dIpyate, dIpituM), AdIp, pradIp, sampradIp, vidIp, sandIp, tap in pass. (tapyate or c. 1. tapati, taptuM), pratap, jval (c. 1. jvalati, jvalituM), prajval, sanDukz (c. 1. -Dukzate -DukzituM); ‘to be inflamed with passion, &c.,’ dah in pass. (dahyate); ‘with anger,’ kopa- dIptaH -ptA -ptaM BU; ‘to burn after,’ utkaRW (c. 1. -kaRWate -kaRWituM), aBikANkz (c. 1. -kANkzati -kANkzituM).
BURN DOWN, BURN OUT (v. t.): dEti: v. To burn up.
BURN OUT (v. i.): SAmyati (Sam, c. 4.): v. To go out, to be extinguished.
BURN UP: (1) nir-dahati (dah, c. l.), as if b. ing up with his fiery look nirdahanniva dahanagarBayA dfSA, D.; (2) BasmIkaroti (=reduce to ashes).
BURNABLE , a. dahanIyaH -yA -yaM, dAhyaH -hyAM -hyaM, dagDavyaH -vyA -vyaM, jvalanIyaH -yA -yaM, dIpanIyaH -yA -yaM, tapanIyaH -yA -yaM.
BURNER: (1) dagDA;(2) dAhakaH B. (of a lamp): *dAhavarDanI.
BURNER , s. dAhakaH, dagDA m. (gDf), dAhanakft, agnidaH, tApakaH, dIpakaH.
BURNET , s. anUpakzetraruhaH kzudragulmapraBedaH.
BURNING (subs.): I Active: consuming with fire:(1) dAhaH;(2) dahanam;(3) plozaH (rare).II Passive: being on fire: jvalanam (also of the b. of the face, etc.)
BURNING (adj.): I Active: expr. by a comp. with dAhaH b. power dAhataktiH; b. fever, dAhajvaraH. II Passive: jvalat (f. ntI): v. Burn (v. i.) III Scorching, hot: q. v. Ph. b. scent: ugraganDaH.
BURNING , s. dAhaH, dAhanaM, jvalanaM, dIpanaM, tApaH, plozaH, ozaH.

BURNING , a. dAhakaH -kA -kaM, tApakaH -kA -kaM, dIpanaH -nA -naM, nEdAGaH -GI -GaM, jvAlI -linI -li (n). — (That is on fire) dahyamAnaH -nA -naM, dahyan -hyantI -hyat (t), jvalan -lantI -lat (t), dAhavAn -vatI -vat (t). — (Vehement) tEjasaH -sI -saM, caRqaH -RqA -RqaM.
BURNING GLASS: *dAhakakAcaH.
BURNING-GLASS , s. sUryyatejaHsaMvardDanArTaM tadaMSusaNgrahaRayogyaM kAcapatraM, dIptopalaH, arkASmA m. (n).
BURNING-GROUND: (1) SmaSAnam;(2) SavasAnam (rare).
Burnish, v. t. pramfj 2 P (pramfzwaM cAmIkaraM); tij c., parizkf 8 U. [Burnish]er, s. tejakaH, DAvakaH.
BURNISH (v. t.): (1) pramArjayati (mfj, c. 10.); (2) DAvati (DAv, c. l): v. To polish.
To BURNISH , v. a. tij in caus. (tejayati -yituM), nizwap in caus. (nizwApayati -yituM), kAntiM dA (c. 3. dadAti, dAtuM), parizkf, niSo (c. 4. -Syati -SAtuM).
BURNISHED , part. tejitaH -tA -taM, tEjasaH -sI -saM, sunizwaptaH -ptA -ptaM, nirDOtaH -tA -taM, pramfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, niSAtaH -tA -taM, niSitaH -tA -taM, parizkftaH -tA -taM.
BURNISHER , s. tejakaH, DAvakaH, mArjjanakft, kAntidAyakaH.
BURNISHING , s. tejanaM, mArjjanaM, parizkAraH, DAvanaM.

BURNT , a. and part. dagDaH -gDA -gDaM, agnidagDaH -gDA -gDaM, pluzwaH -zwA -zwaM, vipluzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pruzwaH -zwA -zwaM, jvalitaH -tA -taM, taptaH -ptA -ptaM, santaptaH -ptA -ptaM, uzitaH -tA -taM; ‘burnt up,’ uttaptaH -ptA -ptaM; ‘burnt as a sacrifice,’ vazawkftaH -tA -taM; ‘burnt brick,’ pakvezwakA.
BURNT-OFFERING: (1) homaH (?);(2) vazawkAraH (?); (3) yAgaH (?): v. Sacrifice.
BURNT-OFFERING , s. homaH, vazawkAraH, vEtAnikaM, vEtAnaM.
BURR , s. (Lobe of the ear) karRalatikA, pAlikA, karRapAlikA.
Burrow, s. bilaM, vivaraM, gartaH-rtA. v. i. bile-garte-vas 1 P.
BURROW (subs.): (1) vivaram;(2) bilam;(3) gartaH: v. Hole.
BURROW (v. i): I Excavate a hole: vivaraM or bilaM karoti (kf, c. 8.).II To live in it: vivara or bilaM kftvA nivasati (vas, c. l.). Any b. ing animal: bileSayaH.
BURROW , s. (Hole) garttaH, vivaraM, vilaM, KAtaM, SvaBraM.
To BURROW , v. n. garttaM or vivaraM kf, gartte vas (c. 1. vasati, vastuM).
BURROWING , a. vilavAsI -sinI -si (n), garttavAsI -sinI -si (n).
Bursar, s. DanADyakzaH, kozADipatiH. 2 SizyavfttyupajIvin m. [Bursar]y, s. kozaH, DanAgAraM. 2 Sizyavftti f.
BURSAR: I A treasurer: q. v.II The holder of a bursary: *vfttiBuj (mfn.)
BURSAR , s. vidyAlaye DanADikArI m. (n), DanADyakzaH, kozADyakzaH.
BURSARSHIP , s. arTADikAraH, DanADikAraH, DanADyakzADikAraH, kozADyakzapadaM.
BURSARY: I A treasury: q. v.II A chari- -table foundation: *vfttiH.
BURSARY , s. vidyAlaye DanagfhaM, DanAgAraH, kozaH, DanakozWakaM.
BURSE , s. baRiksamAgamacatvaraM, SrezWicatvaraM, paRAyASAlA, nigamasTAnaM.

Burst, v. i. sPur 6 P, dal 1 P, vi-dF-SF pass., Bid-BaMj pass.; ‘b(urst) in pieces’ SakalIBU, KaMqaSo Bid pass.; ‘b(urst) into tears’ sahasA roditumAreBe, sahasA prAvartatASruDArA. v. t. Bid-BaMj 7 P, sPuw c., dF 9 P, 10, SakalIkf 8 U, dal c. (dalayati); ‘she b(urst) herself’ hfdayasPowanena mftA. s. sPowanaM, vidalanaM, BaMgaH, BedaH, ‘there was a b(urst) of applause’ saMBUya praSaMsAgiraH udatizWan; ‘b(urst) of laughter’ awwahAsaH, uccErhAsaH.

BURST (v. i.): sPuwati (sPuw, c. 6.), my heart i b. ing sPuwati hfdayam, U. iii.; (2) vidalati (dal c. l.) (=split), M. n.;(3) viSIryate (pass of SF) (=to split), a b. ing rock viSIryaBAnASma. Ki. xvi. 51.;(4) dIryate, vi-, (pass. of dF [Page095] (to rend), my heart b. mamAdIryata hfdayam, to b. into tears roditumAraBate (raB, c. l.), K.; to b. with laughter or b. out laughing prahasitum AraBate; to b. forth (Lit.): nizkrAmati (kram, c. l.) or nirgacCati (gam, c. l.); to b. forth (=to break out): udBinatti (Bid c. l.); tears b. forth aSruDArA prAvartata (vft c. l.) or aSrURi niragacCan; to b. open: v. (n), kAryyaM, arTaH. — (Employment) vyApAraH, vyavasAyaH, vyavahAraH, kAryyodyogaH, niyogaH, pravfttiH f., pravarttanaM, caritaM, sambanDaH. — (Something to be done) kftyaM, karttavyaM, kAryyaM. — (Object) vizayaH, arTaH, prayojanaM. — (A point, case) arTaH, padaM. — (Means of livelihood, profession) vfttiH f., varttanaM, jIvikA, AjIvanArTaM. — (Point, matter of discussion) sTalaM; ‘a man of business, one who knows the proper ways of acting,’ kriyAviDijYaH, kAryye kuSalaH, dfzwakarmmA m. But, prep. anya, itara, fte with abl. vinA; vihAya, muktvA (acc.). adv. eva, kevalaM, mAtraM. conj. tu, punaH, (not at beginning); in ‘not only but’ api takes the place of ‘but’; na kevalaM rUpe SilpepyadvitIyA mAlavikA (M. 2); ‘b(ut) for’ (= if it were not) yadi na; ‘all b(ut)’ See Almost; ‘next b(ut) one’ ekAMtara a.

BUT: I Except: anyaH (nyA, nyaM) (with abl.), this is the doing of none b. Aghoraghanta nADora- DaRwAdanyasya karmEtat..., Ma. v. Ph. his life was nothing else b. a tissue of atrocious deeds *bIBatsa- karmasantatireva tasya jIvitamAsIt; b. for the king, which of your younger brothers would forgive rAjA nacennizedDA syAt kaH kzameta tavAnujaH, Ve. i.; all b. finished sampUrRaprAyaH (yA, yaM), in the last page b. one, *upAntyapfzWAyAm; b. by going to London, *laRqanamagatvA.II Only: q. v.: Ph. b. for a moment kzaRamAtram. R.III. Denoting contrast or opposition:(1) tu (never at the beginn- -ing of a clause), deep anxiety grinds my heart, b. it does not burst into two parts dalati hfdayaM gAQodvego dviDA na tu Bidyate, U. iii.;(2) tu is often ommittedomitted, by sweet, b. false words maDurABiranf- tavAgBiH, Sa. v.; of what avail is (a servant) loyal, b. unwise and timid aprAjYena ca kAtareRa ca guRaH syAt sAnurAgeRa kaH, Mu. i.; internal heat is burning my body, b. does not reduce it to ashes jvalayati tanumantardAhaH karoti na BasmasAt, U. iii.; (3) kintu or parantu (at the beginning) your union is easy. B. the report is, she said... [Page096] samAgamo vAmayatnasADyaH kintu sA kila samagirat... D. ii.;(4) punaH, it is like it, b. not the same sadfSa ezaH . na punaH saH, Mr. Ph. (a) b. also:(1) api (indecl.): not only he who speaks ill of the great, b. also he who hears is a participator of the sin na kevalaM yo mahato'paBAzate SfRoti tasmAdapiyaH sapApaBAk, Ku. v. 83.;(2) apitu (rare), U. ii.; (3) kintu (rare), not only to bring, b. also to bend (the bow) na kevalamAnayanAya kintvAnamanAya, Pr.;(4) b. yet taTApi, surely this is so, b. yet seeing the action of some foolish men vAQamevaM taTApi pravfttAnyupalaBya kezAYcinmandamatInAm, S.IV. Equiv. to that... not: Ph. there is none b. fears him na ko'pi yastasmAnna biBeti: there is not a day b. he comes to my house *nEko'pi divaso gacCati yadA sa mama gfhaM nAgacCati.

BUT , conj. (As an adversative) kintu, tu, parantu, punar, aTavA. — (Except) fte with abl., vinA with acc. or inst., anyaH with abl.; as, ‘any one but the father,’ pitur anyaH. — (But for, without) vyatirekeRa, antareRa, vinA; as, ‘but for sin every [Page071-b+ 51] thing flourishes,’ pApaM vinA sarvvaM Palati. — (But yet, howbeit) taTApi. — (Only) kevalaM, mAtraM. — (All but) alponaH -nA -naM, IzadUnaH -nA -naM; ‘next but one,’ ekAntaraH -rA -raM. — (If it were not, unless) yadi na. — (Moreover) kiYca, aparaYca, aDikantu. — (On the other hand) punar. — (Otherwise than) anyaTA with abl. ‘But’ may often be omitted in Sanskrit, or expressed by another form of sentence; as, ‘he will not gain his end but by doing that,’ tad akftvA prAptArTo na Bavizyati; ‘I do not doubt but I am to blame,’ sAparADo'smi iti na saMSayaH; ‘but a short time since,’ na cirAt; ‘there is none but fears him,’ sarvve tasmAd biByati; ‘she does nothing but grieve,’ sA nirantaraM Socati; “who but a child weeps,” ko rodity abAliSaH.

BY , prep. (By the side of) expressed by upa prefixed; as, ‘he sits by me,’ mAm upAste; ‘a tank by a well,’ upakUpajalASayaH. — (Beside, denoting passage) expressed by ati prefixed; as, ‘he passes by me,’ mAm atyeti. — (Denoting the agent, instrument, cause, means or manner) expressed by the instr. case; as, ‘by him,’ ‘by that,’ ‘on that account,’ ‘by that means,’ ‘in that manner,’ may all be expressed by tena. In modern Sanskrit the instrument and agent are often expressed by dvArA or dvAreRa and karttfka; as, ‘to hit with a stick,’ kAzWadvArA or kAzWadvAreRa taq; ‘sacrifices by sages,’ fzikarttfkayajYAH. ‘By,’ in some of these senses, may often be expressed by the indec. part.; ‘a man may be happy by doing penance,’ tapas taptvA suKI Bavet. — (According to) anurUpaM, anusAreRa; ‘by rule,’ viDivat, viDitas, yaTAviDi. — (As soon as, not later than) maDye; as, ‘by next year,’ AgAmivatsaramaDye. — (The quantity at one time) expressed by the affix Sas; as, ‘by thousands,’ sahasraSas; ‘by twos and threes,’ dviSas triSas; ‘by companies,’ paMktiBiH. — (Successive [Page072-b+ 50] action) expressed by prati or anu, or by repeating the word; as, ‘man by man,’ pratipuruzaM; ‘day by day,’ pratidivaRaM or anudivasaM or divase divase. — (By himself, alone) ekAntatas, niBftaM, rahasi, rahIBUtaH -tA -taM. — (In swearing or adjuring) expressed by the instr. c.; as, ‘swear not at all, neither by heaven, nor by earth,’ kamapi SapaTaM mA 'kArzwa svargeRa na pfTivyA na; ‘by name,’ nAmnA, nAmatas, nAmaDeyatas; ‘by force,’ balAt, balAtkAreRa, prasahma; ‘by chance,’ dEvAt; ‘by day,’ divA.
